5.62.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ sa niścayaṃ kṛtvā pārthivo dvijasattamāḥ ..
nātyajattāṃ tathokto'pi daivajñairviṣakanyakām ..
dīyamānāmapi prītyā na ca gṛhṇāti bhūbhujā .. 1 ..
5.62.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं स निश्चयं कृत्वा पार्थिवो द्विजसत्तमाः ..
नात्यजत्तां तथोक्तोऽपि दैवज्ञैर्विषकन्यकाम् ..
दीयमानामपि प्रीत्या न च गृह्णाति भूभुजा .. 1 ..
5.62.m: Sūta said: / Having formed this resolve, O best of twice-born, / the king did not abandon that poison-maiden, even though advised to do so by astrologers. / And though offered with love, no king would take her.

5.62.s:
śarmaṇaṣṭhīvanaṃ yasmāttayā svapiturāhitam ..
śarmiṣṭheti suvikhyātā tataḥ sā hyabhavadbhuvi .. 2 ..
5.62.d:
शर्मणष्ठीवनं यस्मात्तया स्वपितुराहितम् ..
शर्मिष्ठेति सुविख्याता ततः सा ह्यभवद्भुवि .. 2 ..
5.62.m: Because she spat out comfort for her own father, / she therefore became widely renowned on earth as Śarmiṣṭhā.

5.62.s:
etasminnaṃtare tasya śatravaḥ pṛthivīpateḥ ..
sarvataḥ pīḍayāmāsa rāṣṭraṃ krodhasamanvitāḥ. ..3..
5.62.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे तस्य शत्रवः पृथिवीपतेः ..
सर्वतः पीडयामास राष्ट्रं क्रोधसमन्विताः. ..3..
5.62.m: In the meantime, the enemies of that lord of the earth, / filled with rage, harassed his realm on all sides.

5.62.s:
athā sau pārthivaḥ kruddhaḥ svasainyaparivāritaḥ ..
yuddhāya niryayau sthānānmṛtyuṃ kṛtvā nivartane ..4..
5.62.d:
अथा सौ पार्थिवः क्रुद्धः स्वसैन्यपरिवारितः ..
युद्धाय निर्ययौ स्थानान्मृत्युं कृत्वा निवर्तने ..4..
5.62.m: Then that king, infuriated and surrounded by his army, / marched out from his residence for battle, having resolved upon death before retreating.

5.62.s:
tataḥ saṃprāpya tāñchatrūṃścakāra sa mahāhavam ..
caturaṃgena sainyena yamarāṣṭravivardhanam .. 5..
5.62.d:
ततः संप्राप्य ताञ्छत्रूंश्चकार स महाहवम् ..
चतुरंगेन सैन्येन यमराष्ट्रविवर्धनम् .. 5..
5.62.m: Then, having met those enemies, he waged a great battle / with his fourfold army, increasing the realm of Yama.

5.62.s:
tataśca daśame prāpte śatrubhiḥ sa mahīpatiḥ ..
nihato divase sarvairveṣṭayitvā samantataḥ .. 6 ..
5.62.d:
ततश्च दशमे प्राप्ते शत्रुभिः स महीपतिः ..
निहतो दिवसे सर्वैर्वेष्टयित्वा समन्ततः .. 6 ..
5.62.m: And then, when the tenth day arrived, that ruler of the earth / was slain by all the enemies, who had encircled him on all sides.

5.62.s:
tatastasya narendrasya hataśeṣāśca ye narāḥ ..
bhayārtāste drutaṃ jagmuḥ svapuraṃ prati duḥkhitāḥ .. 7 ..
5.62.d:
ततस्तस्य नरेन्द्रस्य हतशेषाश्च ये नराः ..
भयार्तास्ते द्रुतं जग्मुः स्वपुरं प्रति दुःखिताः .. 7 ..
5.62.m: Then those men of that lord of men who survived the slaughter / fled swiftly in grief toward their own city, afflicted by fear.

5.62.s:
tepi śatrugaṇāḥ sarve saṃprahṛṣṭā jigīṣavaḥ ..
tatpuraṃ veṣṭayāmāsustatputrocchedanāya vai .. 8 ..
5.62.d:
तेपि शत्रुगणाः सर्वे संप्रहृष्टा जिगीषवः ..
तत्पुरं वेष्टयामासुस्तत्पुत्रोच्छेदनाय वै .. 8 ..
5.62.m: All those hosts of enemies as well, exultant and eager to conquer, / besieged that city in order to destroy his sons.

5.62.s:
etasminnaṃtare paurāḥ sarve śokaparāyaṇāḥ ..
jagarhuḥ paruṣairvākyairduṣṭāṃ tāṃ viṣakanyakām ..9..
5.62.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे पौराः सर्वे शोकपरायणाः ..
जगर्हुः परुषैर्वाक्यैर्दुष्टां तां विषकन्यकाम् ..9..
5.62.m: In the meantime, all the citizens, given over to grief, / reviled that wicked poison-maiden with harsh words:

5.62.s:
asyā doṣeṇa pāpāyā mṛtaśca sa mahīpatiḥ..
tathā rāṣṭrasya vidhvaṃse bhaviṣyati puraḥ kṣayaḥ .. 6.62.10 ..
uktaḥ sa nṛpatiḥ pūrvaṃ brāhmaṇairjñānibhistadā ..
tyajaināṃ bahudoṣāḍhyāṃ ninditāṃ viṣakanyakām ......
na tena tatkṛtaṃ vākyamapi teṣāṃ hitaiṣiṇām ..
snehapāśanibaddhena dayāḍhyena mahātmanā...2..
5.62.d:
अस्या दोषेण पापाया मृतश्च स महीपतिः..
तथा राष्ट्रस्य विध्वंसे भविष्यति पुरः क्षयः .. 6.62.10 ..
उक्तः स नृपतिः पूर्वं ब्राह्मणैर्ज्ञानिभिस्तदा ..
त्यजैनां बहुदोषाढ्यां निन्दितां विषकन्यकाम् ......
न तेन तत्कृतं वाक्यमपि तेषां हितैषिणाम् ..
स्नेहपाशनिबद्धेन दयाढ्येन महात्मना...2..
5.62.m:
'By the fault of this sinful girl the ruler of the earth is dead, / and through the destruction of the realm, the ruin of the city will take place.
That king was previously told by wise brahmins: / "Abandon this despised poison-maiden full of many evils." / The word of those well-wishers was not heeded by him, / that great-souled man bound by cords of affection and filled with pity.

5.62.s:
tasmādadyāpi pāpaiṣā vadhyatāmāśu kanyakā ..
niryāsyatāṃ purādasmādyāvanna syātpurakṣayaḥ .. 13 ..
5.62.d:
तस्मादद्यापि पापैषा वध्यतामाशु कन्यका ..
निर्यास्यतां पुरादस्माद्यावन्न स्यात्पुरक्षयः .. 13 ..
5.62.m: Therefore, even today, let this sinful girl be slain at once, / or let her be driven out of this city before the destruction of the city occurs!'

5.62.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
sāpi śrutvā janoktāṃstānapavādānpṛthagvidhān ..
vairāgyaṃ paramaṃ gatvā niṃdāṃ cakre tathātmanaḥ .. 14 ..
tato rātrau viniṣkramya bhayaśokasamanvitā ..
pratasthe'raṇyamāsādya maraṇe kṛtaniścayā ...5..
5.62.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
सापि श्रुत्वा जनोक्तांस्तानपवादान्पृथग्विधान् ..
वैराग्यं परमं गत्वा निंदां चक्रे तथात्मनः .. 14 ..
ततो रात्रौ विनिष्क्रम्य भयशोकसमन्विता ..
प्रतस्थेऽरण्यमासाद्य मरणे कृतनिश्चया ...5..
5.62.m:
Sūta said: / Hearing those various reproaches uttered by the people, / she fell into supreme detachment and censured herself:
Then, having departed in the night, filled with fear and grief, / she set out upon reaching the forest, resolved upon death.

5.62.s:
atha dṛṣṭaṃ tayā kṣetraṃ hāṭakeśvarajaṃ mahat ..
tapasvibhiḥ samākīrṇaṃ cittāhlādakaraṃ param .. 16 ..
5.62.d:
अथ दृष्टं तया क्षेत्रं हाटकेश्वरजं महत् ..
तपस्विभिः समाकीर्णं चित्ताह्लादकरं परम् .. 16 ..
5.62.m: Then she beheld the great sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara, / crowded with ascetics and supremely gladdening to the mind.

5.62.s:
atha tasyāḥ smṛtirjātā pūrvajanmasamudbhavā ..
caṃḍālatve mayā pūrvaṃ gaurekā vitṛṣīkṛtā .. 17 ..
5.62.d:
अथ तस्याः स्मृतिर्जाता पूर्वजन्मसमुद्भवा ..
चंडालत्वे मया पूर्वं गौरेका वितृषीकृता .. 17 ..
5.62.m: Then memory of her past birth arose in her: / 'Formerly, when I was a Caṇḍāla, I quenched the thirst of a single cow.

5.62.s:
tatprabhāvādahaṃ jātā supuṇye nṛpamaṃdire ..
kṣetrasyāsya prabhāvena tasmādatraiva me sthitiḥ .. 18 ..
5.62.d:
तत्प्रभावादहं जाता सुपुण्ये नृपमंदिरे ..
क्षेत्रस्यास्य प्रभावेन तस्मादत्रैव मे स्थितिः .. 18 ..
5.62.m: By the power of that, I was born in the most holy palace of a king / through the power of this sacred field; therefore, my stay shall be right here.'

5.62.s:
sūta uvāca .. ..
anyadehāṃtare hyāsīccaṃḍālī sā vigarhitā ..
bahuprasūtisaṃyuktā daridreṇa kadarthitā .. 19 ..
5.62.d:
सूत उवाच .. ..
अन्यदेहांतरे ह्यासीच्चंडाली सा विगर्हिता ..
बहुप्रसूतिसंयुक्ता दरिद्रेण कदर्थिता .. 19 ..
5.62.m: Sūta said: / Indeed, in another body she was a reviled Caṇḍāla woman, / bearing many children and distressed by poverty.

5.62.s:
atha sā bhramamāṇā'tra kṣetre prāptā tṛṣārditā ..
madhyaṃdinagatesūrye jyeṣṭhamāse sudāruṇe .. 6.62.20 ..
5.62.d:
अथ सा भ्रममाणाऽत्र क्षेत्रे प्राप्ता तृषार्दिता ..
मध्यंदिनगतेसूर्ये ज्येष्ठमासे सुदारुणे .. 6.62.20 ..
5.62.m: Then, wandering about, she arrived at this sacred field afflicted by thirst, / when the sun was at midday in the terribly harsh month of Jyeṣṭha.

5.62.s:
athāpaśyatstokajalāṃ sā tatra laghukūpikām ..
tṛṣārtāṃ kapilāṃ gāṃ vartamānāṃ tadāṃ tike .. 21 ..
5.62.d:
अथापश्यत्स्तोकजलां सा तत्र लघुकूपिकाम् ..
तृषार्तां कपिलां गां वर्तमानां तदां तिके .. 21 ..
5.62.m: Then she saw a small shallow well with little water, / and near it, a tawny cow afflicted by thirst.

5.62.s:
tato dayāṃ samāśritya tyaktvā snehaṃ sutodbhavam ..
ātmanaśca tathā prāṇāngāṃ vitṛṣṇāmathākarot .. 22 ..
5.62.d:
ततो दयां समाश्रित्य त्यक्त्वा स्नेहं सुतोद्भवम् ..
आत्मनश्च तथा प्राणान्गां वितृष्णामथाकरोत् .. 22 ..
5.62.m: Then, resorting to compassion, abandoning her affection for her children / and likewise her own life, she quenched the thirst of the cow.

5.62.s:
jalābhāve tathā sā ca samastairbālakaiḥ saha ..
vaivasvatagṛhaṃ prāptā gobhaktidhṛtamānasā .. 23 ..
5.62.d:
जलाभावे तथा सा च समस्तैर्बालकैः सह ..
वैवस्वतगृहं प्राप्ता गोभक्तिधृतमानसा .. 23 ..
5.62.m: And in the absence of water, she, along with all her children, / reached the abode of Yama, her mind steadfast in devotion to the cow.

5.62.s:
tato nṛpagṛhe jātā tatprabhāvāddvijottamāḥ ..
pūrvakarmavipākena saṃjātā viṣa kanyakā .. 24 ..
5.62.d:
ततो नृपगृहे जाता तत्प्रभावाद्द्विजोत्तमाः ..
पूर्वकर्मविपाकेन संजाता विष कन्यका .. 24 ..
5.62.m: Then she was born in the house of a king by the power of that, O best of twice-born; / through the fruition of past karma, she became a poison-maiden.

5.62.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
kena karmavipākena saṃjātā viṣakanyakā ..
svakulocchedanakarī sarvaṃ sūta bravīhi naḥ .. 25 ..
5.62.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
केन कर्मविपाकेन संजाता विषकन्यका ..
स्वकुलोच्छेदनकरी सर्वं सूत ब्रवीहि नः .. 25 ..
5.62.m: The seers said: / Through the fruition of what karma did she become a poison-maiden / who brought about the destruction of her own family? Tell us all, O Sūta!

5.62.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
caṃḍālatve tayā viprā vartaṃtyā bhramamāṇayā ..
devatāyatane dṛṣṭā gaurī hemamayī śubhā .. 26 ..
5.62.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
चंडालत्वे तया विप्रा वर्तंत्या भ्रममाणया ..
देवतायतने दृष्टा गौरी हेममयी शुभा .. 26 ..
5.62.m: Sūta said: / O brahmins, while living and wandering as a Caṇḍāla woman, / she saw an auspicious golden image of Gaurī in a temple.

5.62.s:
tatastāṃ vijane prāpya gatvā deśāṃtaraṃ mudā..
yāvatkaroti khaṃḍāni vikrayārthaṃ suniṃditā ..
tāvadanveṣamāṇāstāṃ saṃprāptā nṛpasevakāḥ ..27..
5.62.d:
ततस्तां विजने प्राप्य गत्वा देशांतरं मुदा..
यावत्करोति खंडानि विक्रयार्थं सुनिंदिता ..
तावदन्वेषमाणास्तां संप्राप्ता नृपसेवकाः ..27..
5.62.m: Then, having taken it in a solitary place and gone to another country with delight, / as the highly despised woman was cutting it into pieces to sell it, / royal servants arrived searching for it.

5.62.s:
atha te tāṃ samālokya bhartsayitvā muhurmuhuḥ..
saṃtāḍya lakuṭāghātairloṣṭaghātaiśca muṣṭibhiḥ .. 28 ..
5.62.d:
अथ ते तां समालोक्य भर्त्सयित्वा मुहुर्मुहुः..
संताड्य लकुटाघातैर्लोष्टघातैश्च मुष्टिभिः .. 28 ..
5.62.m: Then, seeing her, threatening her repeatedly, / and beating her with blows of sticks, clods of earth, and fists,

5.62.s:
tataḥ suvarṇamādāya tyaktvā tāṃ rudhiraplutām ..
avadhyaiṣeti saṃciṃtya svapuraṃ prati te gatāḥ ..29..
5.62.d:
ततः सुवर्णमादाय त्यक्त्वा तां रुधिरप्लुताम् ..
अवध्यैषेति संचिंत्य स्वपुरं प्रति ते गताः ..29..
5.62.m: they took the gold and, abandoning her drenched in blood, / thinking 'She is a woman and should not be killed,' they went to their own city.

5.62.s:
yattayā pārvatī spṛṣṭā tato vai khaṇḍaśaḥ kṛtā ..
tena karmavipākena saṃjātā viṣakanyakā .. 6.62.30 ..
tataḥ saṃsmṛtimāsādya pūrvajanmasamudbhavām ..
māhātmyaṃ jaladānasya gopītasya vicārya ca ..
cakāra kūpikāsthāne taḍāgaṃ vimalodakam ..3...
5.62.d:
यत्तया पार्वती स्पृष्टा ततो वै खण्डशः कृता ..
तेन कर्मविपाकेन संजाता विषकन्यका .. 6.62.30 ..
ततः संस्मृतिमासाद्य पूर्वजन्मसमुद्भवाम् ..
माहात्म्यं जलदानस्य गोपीतस्य विचार्य च ..
चकार कूपिकास्थाने तडागं विमलोदकम् ..3...
5.62.m:
Because Pārvatī was touched by her and then cut into pieces, / through the fruition of that karma she was born as a poison-maiden.
Then, regaining the memory of her past birth / and considering the majesty of the gift of water drunk by a cow, / she built a pond with pure water in the place of that small well,

5.62.s:
samudrapratimaṃ cāru padminīkhaṃḍamaṃḍitam ..
matsyakacchapasaṃkīrṇaṃ śiśumāravirājitam .. 32 ..
5.62.d:
समुद्रप्रतिमं चारु पद्मिनीखंडमंडितम् ..
मत्स्यकच्छपसंकीर्णं शिशुमारविराजितम् .. 32 ..
5.62.m: resembling an ocean, beautiful, adorned with lotus beds, / teeming with fish and tortoises, and shining with dolphins,

5.62.s:
sevitaṃ bahubhirhaṃsairbakaiścakraiḥ samaṃtataḥ ..
agādhasalilaṃ puṇyaṃ sevitaṃ jalajaṃtubhiḥ .. 33 ..
5.62.d:
सेवितं बहुभिर्हंसैर्बकैश्चक्रैः समंततः ..
अगाधसलिलं पुण्यं सेवितं जलजंतुभिः .. 33 ..
5.62.m: resorted to on all sides by many swans, cranes, and cakra birds, / unfathomable in depth, holy, and frequented by aquatic creatures.

5.62.s:
prāsādaṃ tatsamīpasthaṃ sādhu dṛṣṭimanoharam ..
kārayitvātisaṃbhaktyā kailāsaśikharopamam .. 34 ..
5.62.d:
प्रासादं तत्समीपस्थं साधु दृष्टिमनोहरम् ..
कारयित्वातिसंभक्त्या कैलासशिखरोपमम् .. 34 ..
5.62.m: Having a temple built near it, lovely and charming to the sight, / resembling the peak of Kailāsa, with supreme devotion,

5.62.s:
tatastatra tapastepe gaurīṃ saṃsthāpya bhaktitaḥ..
tadagre vratamāsthāya yathoktaṃ śāstra saṃbhavam.. 35 ..
5.62.d:
ततस्तत्र तपस्तेपे गौरीं संस्थाप्य भक्तितः..
तदग्रे व्रतमास्थाय यथोक्तं शास्त्र संभवम्.. 35 ..
5.62.m: she then performed austerities there, having installed Gaurī with devotion, / and undertaking before her the vow prescribed according to the scriptures.

5.62.s:
prātaḥ snātvā tu hemaṃte gaurīṃ saṃpūjya bhaktitaḥ..
balipūjopahāraiśca vipradānādibhistathā .. 36 ..
5.62.d:
प्रातः स्नात्वा तु हेमंते गौरीं संपूज्य भक्तितः..
बलिपूजोपहारैश्च विप्रदानादिभिस्तथा .. 36 ..
5.62.m: Bathing in the morning during the Hemanta season and worshipping Gaurī with devotion / through offerings of bali, worship, gifts, and donations to brahmins,

5.62.s:
tataśca śiśire prāpte sāyaṃ prātaḥ samāhitā ..
ekāṃtaropavāsaiḥ sā snānaṃ cakre nṛpātmajā .. 37 ..
5.62.d:
ततश्च शिशिरे प्राप्ते सायं प्रातः समाहिता ..
एकांतरोपवासैः सा स्नानं चक्रे नृपात्मजा .. 37 ..
5.62.m: and then, when Śiśira arrived, composed in mind morning and evening, / the king's daughter performed her bath while observing alternate-day fasts.

5.62.s:
vasaṃte nṛtyagītaiśca toṣayāmāsa pārvatīm ..
ṣaṣṭhakālāśanā sādhvī sasyadānaparā yaṇā .. 38 ..
5.62.d:
वसंते नृत्यगीतैश्च तोषयामास पार्वतीम् ..
षष्ठकालाशना साध्वी सस्यदानपरा यणा .. 38 ..
5.62.m: In spring she pleased Pārvatī with dances and songs; / eating at the sixth mealtime, the virtuous woman devoted herself to giving grain. 38

5.62.s:
pañcāgnisādhakā grīṣme phalāhāraṃ tapasvinī ..
cakāra śraddhayopetā vṛkabhūmipateḥ sutā .. 39 ..
5.62.d:
पञ्चाग्निसाधका ग्रीष्मे फलाहारं तपस्विनी ..
चकार श्रद्धयोपेता वृकभूमिपतेः सुता .. 39 ..
5.62.m: Practicing the five fires in summer, eating only fruit, / the ascetic daughter of the king of Vṛka performed [her rites] endowed with faith. 39

5.62.s:
varṣāsu ca jalāhārā bhūtvā sā viṣa kanyakā ..
ākāśe śayanaṃ cakre parityaktakuṭīrakā .. 6.62.40 ..
vāyubhakṣā satī cā'tha sā'nayaccharadaṃ tataḥ ..
kṛtajapyaparā nityaṃ pārvatīgatamānasā ..4...
5.62.d:
वर्षासु च जलाहारा भूत्वा सा विष कन्यका ..
आकाशे शयनं चक्रे परित्यक्तकुटीरका .. 6.62.40 ..
वायुभक्षा सती चाऽथ साऽनयच्छरदं ततः ..
कृतजप्यपरा नित्यं पार्वतीगतमानसा ..4...
5.62.m:
And during the rains, that poison maiden, subsisting only on water, / abandoned her hut and made her bed in the open sky. 40
Feeding only on air, the chaste woman then spent the autumn / constantly devoted to recitations, her mind fixed on Pārvatī. 41

5.62.s:
evamārādhayaṃtyāśca tasyā devīṃ gireḥ sutām ..
jagāma sumahānkālo na lebhe phalamīhitam ..42..
5.62.d:
एवमाराधयंत्याश्च तस्या देवीं गिरेः सुताम् ..
जगाम सुमहान्कालो न लेभे फलमीहितम् ..42..
5.62.m: As she thus worshipped the goddess, the daughter of the mountain, / a very great time passed, but she did not obtain the desired fruit. 42

5.62.s:
mukhaṃ valibhirākrāntaṃ palitairaṃkitaṃ śiraḥ..
kanyābhāvepi vartaṃtyā na ca tuṣṭā harapriyā .. 43 ..
5.62.d:
मुखं वलिभिराक्रान्तं पलितैरंकितं शिरः..
कन्याभावेपि वर्तंत्या न च तुष्टा हरप्रिया .. 43 ..
5.62.m: Her face was overcome with wrinkles, her head was marked with gray hair, / yet though she remained in the state of maidenhood, the beloved of Hara was not pleased. 43

5.62.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya tatparīkṣārthameva sā ..
śakrāṇīrūpamāsthāya tataḥ sandarśanaṃ gatā ..44..
5.62.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य तत्परीक्षार्थमेव सा ..
शक्राणीरूपमास्थाय ततः सन्दर्शनं गता ..44..
5.62.m: Then at some time, solely for the purpose of testing her, / she took the form of Śakrāṇī and came into her view. 44

5.62.s:
sudhāvadātaṃ sūryābhaṃ kailāsaśikharopamam ..
supralaṃbakaraṃ mattaṃ caturdaṃtaṃ mahāgajam .. 45 ..
5.62.d:
सुधावदातं सूर्याभं कैलासशिखरोपमम् ..
सुप्रलंबकरं मत्तं चतुर्दंतं महागजम् .. 45 ..
5.62.m: Mounted upon a great elephant, white as nectar, radiant like the sun, resembling the peak of Kailāsa, / with a long hanging trunk, in rut, and endowed with four tusks, 45

5.62.s:
samāsthāya vṛtā strībhirdevānāṃ sarvato diśam ..
dadhatī mukuṭaṃ mūrdhni hārakeyūrabhūṣitā .. 46 ..
5.62.d:
समास्थाय वृता स्त्रीभिर्देवानां सर्वतो दिशम् ..
दधती मुकुटं मूर्ध्नि हारकेयूरभूषिता .. 46 ..
5.62.m: surrounded in all directions by the wives of the gods, / wearing a diadem on her head, adorned with necklaces and armlets, 46

5.62.s:
pāṃḍureṇātapatreṇa dhriyamāṇena mūrdhani ..
sevyamānā'psarobhiśca stūyamānā ca kinnaraiḥ .. 47 ..
5.62.d:
पांडुरेणातपत्रेण ध्रियमाणेन मूर्धनि ..
सेव्यमानाऽप्सरोभिश्च स्तूयमाना च किन्नरैः .. 47 ..
5.62.m: with a white umbrella held over her head, / served by apsarases and praised by kinnaras, 47

5.62.s:
gandharvairgīyamānāsīttataḥ provāca sādaram ..
varaṃ yacchāmi te putri prārthayasva yathepsitam .. 48 ..
5.62.d:
गन्धर्वैर्गीयमानासीत्ततः प्रोवाच सादरम् ..
वरं यच्छामि ते पुत्रि प्रार्थयस्व यथेप्सितम् .. 48 ..
5.62.m: and sung about by gandharvas, she then said respectfully: / “I grant you a boon, daughter; ask whatever you desire! 48

5.62.s:
anena tapasā tuṣṭā puṣkalena tavādhunā ..
ahaṃ bhāryā surendrasya śacīti parikīrtitā ..
trailokye'pi svayaṃ prāptā dayāṃ kṛtvā tavopari .. 49 ..
5.62.d:
अनेन तपसा तुष्टा पुष्कलेन तवाधुना ..
अहं भार्या सुरेन्द्रस्य शचीति परिकीर्तिता ..
त्रैलोक्येऽपि स्वयं प्राप्ता दयां कृत्वा तवोपरि .. 49 ..
5.62.m: Pleased now by this abundant tapas of yours, / I, the wife of the lord of the gods, celebrated as Śacī, / have arrived in person across the three worlds out of compassion for you. 49

5.62.s:
tvayā mahattapastaptaṃ dhyāyaṃtyā haravallabhām ..
tapasā tuṣṭimāyātā bhavānī na suniṣṭhurā .. 6.62.50 ..
5.62.d:
त्वया महत्तपस्तप्तं ध्यायंत्या हरवल्लभाम् ..
तपसा तुष्टिमायाता भवानी न सुनिष्ठुरा .. 6.62.50 ..
5.62.m: A great tapas has been performed by you while meditating on the beloved of Hara; / yet Bhavānī, being very harsh, has not been pleased by [your] tapas.” 50

5.62.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
sā tasyā vacanaṃ śrutvā śakrāṇyā viṣakanyakā ..
namaskṛtvā'tha tāmūce kṛtāṃjalipuṭā sthitā .. 51 ..
5.62.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
सा तस्या वचनं श्रुत्वा शक्राण्या विषकन्यका ..
नमस्कृत्वाऽथ तामूचे कृतांजलिपुटा स्थिता .. 51 ..
5.62.m: Sūta said: / Hearing that speech of Śakrāṇī, the poison maiden, / having bowed, standing with folded hands, then spoke to her: 51

5.62.s:
.. viṣakanyovāca .. ..
nāhaṃ tvatto varaṃ devi prārthayāmi kathañcana ..
tathānyāsāmapīṃdrāṇi devatānāmasaṃśayam.. 52 ..
5.62.d:
.. विषकन्योवाच .. ..
नाहं त्वत्तो वरं देवि प्रार्थयामि कथञ्चन ..
तथान्यासामपींद्राणि देवतानामसंशयम्.. 52 ..
5.62.m: The poison maiden said: / “O goddess, I do not ask for a boon from you in any way; / nor, Indrāṇī, undoubtedly, from other deities. 52

5.62.s:
apyahaṃ narakaṃ raudraṃ pragacchāmīṃdravallabhe ..
harakāṃtā samādeśānna svarge'pi tavājñayā .. 53 ..
5.62.d:
अप्यहं नरकं रौद्रं प्रगच्छामींद्रवल्लभे ..
हरकांता समादेशान्न स्वर्गेऽपि तवाज्ञया .. 53 ..
5.62.m: Even if I go to the terrible hell, O beloved of Indra, / it shall be by the command of the beloved of Hara, not to heaven by your command! 53

5.62.s:
anādimadhyaparyyantā jñānaiśvaryasama nvitā ..
yā devī pūjyate devairvaraṃ tasyā vṛṇomyaham.. 54 ..
5.62.d:
अनादिमध्यपर्य्यन्ता ज्ञानैश्वर्यसम न्विता ..
या देवी पूज्यते देवैर्वरं तस्या वृणोम्यहम्.. 54 ..
5.62.m: Without beginning, middle, or end, endowed with knowledge and sovereignty, / she is the goddess worshipped by the gods; I choose a boon from her! 54

5.62.s:
yāmārādhayate viṣṇurbrahmā rudraśca vāsavaḥ ..
vāṃchitārthaṃ sadā devīṃ varaṃ tasyā vṛṇo myaham .. 55 ..
5.62.d:
यामाराधयते विष्णुर्ब्रह्मा रुद्रश्च वासवः ..
वांछितार्थं सदा देवीं वरं तस्या वृणो म्यहम् .. 55 ..
5.62.m: She whom Viṣṇu, Brahmā, Rudra, and Indra constantly worship / for their desired ends—from that goddess I choose a boon! 55

5.62.s:
yayā vyāptamidaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram ..
strīrūpairvividhairdevyā varaṃ tasyā vṛṇomyaham .. 56 ..
5.62.d:
यया व्याप्तमिदं सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् ..
स्त्रीरूपैर्विविधैर्देव्या वरं तस्या वृणोम्यहम् .. 56 ..
5.62.m: By whom, the goddess, all this threefold world of moving and unmoving things is pervaded / through diverse female forms—from her I choose a boon!” 56

5.62.s:
.. śrīdevyuvāca .. ..
ahaṃ bhāryā surendrasya prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī ..
mamājñāṃ pālayanti sma devadānavapannagāḥ .. 57 ..
5.62.d:
.. श्रीदेव्युवाच .. ..
अहं भार्या सुरेन्द्रस्य प्राणेभ्योऽपि गरीयसी ..
ममाज्ञां पालयन्ति स्म देवदानवपन्नगाः .. 57 ..
5.62.m: The holy goddess said: / “I am the wife of the lord of the gods, dearer [to him] than life; / the gods, Dānavas, and serpents obey my command! 57

5.62.s:
kiṃnarā guhkā yakṣāḥ kiṃ punarmartyadharmiṇaḥ ..
tasmāttvaṃ kiṃ na gṛhṇāsi varaṃ mattaḥ kutāpasi .. 58 ..
5.62.d:
किंनरा गुह्का यक्षाः किं पुनर्मर्त्यधर्मिणः ..
तस्मात्त्वं किं न गृह्णासि वरं मत्तः कुतापसि .. 58 ..
5.62.m: As do kinnaras, Guhyakas, and yakṣas—what then of mortals? / Therefore, why do you not receive a boon from me, you wicked ascetic? 58

5.62.s:
tannūnaṃ vajraghātena cūrṇayiṣyāmi te śiraḥ ..
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā tāpasyatha tato dvijāḥ .. 59 ..
5.62.d:
तन्नूनं वज्रघातेन चूर्णयिष्यामि ते शिरः ..
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा तापस्यथ ततो द्विजाः .. 59 ..
5.62.m: Surely, then, I will shatter your head with a blow of the vajra!” / Hearing that speech of hers, O twice-born ones, the female ascetic then, 59

5.62.s:
dhairyamālaṃbya tāṃ prāha bhūya eva sureśvarīm ..
svāminī tvaṃ hi devānāṃ satyametadasaṃśayam .. 6.62.60 ..
5.62.d:
धैर्यमालंब्य तां प्राह भूय एव सुरेश्वरीम् ..
स्वामिनी त्वं हि देवानां सत्यमेतदसंशयम् .. 6.62.60 ..
5.62.m: relying on fortitude, spoke once more to the queen of the gods: / “You are indeed the mistress of the gods; this is true without doubt. 60

5.62.s:
yasyāḥ prāptaṃ tvayaiśvaryaṃ parā tāṃ toṣayāmyaham ..
svalpamapyaparādhaṃ te na karomi sureśvari .. 61 ..
5.62.d:
यस्याः प्राप्तं त्वयैश्वर्यं परा तां तोषयाम्यहम् ..
स्वल्पमप्यपराधं ते न करोमि सुरेश्वरि .. 61 ..
5.62.m: I please the Supreme Goddess from whom your sovereignty has been obtained. / I have not committed even the slightest offense toward you, O queen of the gods! 61

5.62.s:
tathāpi vadhayogyāṃ māṃ manyase vikṣipāyudham ..
anyaccāpi vaco mahyaṃ śakrāṇi śṛṇu sādaram .. .. 62 ..
5.62.d:
तथापि वधयोग्यां मां मन्यसे विक्षिपायुधम् ..
अन्यच्चापि वचो मह्यं शक्राणि शृणु सादरम् .. .. 62 ..
5.62.m: Even so, if you deem me fit to be killed, cast your weapon! / Hear also another word from me with care, O Śakrāṇī: 62

5.62.s:
tacchutvā kuru yacchreyo vicintya manasā tataḥ ..
na tvaṃ na te patiḥ śakro na cānyepi surāsurāḥ ..
māṃ niṣūdayituṃ śaktāḥ pārvatyāṃ śaraṇaṃ gatām .. 63 ..
5.62.d:
तच्छुत्वा कुरु यच्छ्रेयो विचिन्त्य मनसा ततः ..
न त्वं न ते पतिः शक्रो न चान्येपि सुरासुराः ..
मां निषूदयितुं शक्ताः पार्वत्यां शरणं गताम् .. 63 ..
5.62.m: having heard it, reflect in your mind and then do whatever is best. / Neither you, nor your husband Indra, nor other gods and asuras / are able to destroy me, who have sought refuge in Pārvatī! 63

5.62.s:
tasmāddrutaṃ divaṃ gaccha mā tvaṃ kopaṃ vṛthā kuru ..
sanmārge vartamānāyāṃ mama sarvasureśvari .. 64 ..
5.62.d:
तस्माद्द्रुतं दिवं गच्छ मा त्वं कोपं वृथा कुरु ..
सन्मार्गे वर्तमानायां मम सर्वसुरेश्वरि .. 64 ..
5.62.m: Therefore, go quickly to heaven; do not become angry in vain / toward me who abide on the good path, O mistress of all the gods!” 64

5.62.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ sā tāṃ śacīmuktvā duḥkhitā viṣakanyakā ..
cintayāmāsa tadidaṃ maraṇe kṛtaniścayā .. 65 ..
5.62.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं सा तां शचीमुक्त्वा दुःखिता विषकन्यका ..
चिन्तयामास तदिदं मरणे कृतनिश्चया .. 65 ..
5.62.m: Sūta said: / Having spoken thus to Śacī, the sorrowful poison maiden, / resolved on death, reflected on this: 65

5.62.s:
na prasīdati me devī yasmātparvatanaṃdinī ..
tasmānmāṃ yadi śakrāṇī naiṣā vyāpādayiṣyati .. 66 ..
5.62.d:
न प्रसीदति मे देवी यस्मात्पर्वतनंदिनी ..
तस्मान्मां यदि शक्राणी नैषा व्यापादयिष्यति .. 66 ..
5.62.m: “Since the goddess, the daughter of the mountain, is not pleased with me, / therefore, if this Śakrāṇī will not kill me, 66

5.62.s:
tannūnaṃ jvalanaṃ dīptaṃ sevayiṣyāmi satvaram ..
athāpaśyatkṣaṇenaiva taṃ cairāvaṇavāraṇam .. 67 ..
5.62.d:
तन्नूनं ज्वलनं दीप्तं सेवयिष्यामि सत्वरम् ..
अथापश्यत्क्षणेनैव तं चैरावणवारणम् .. 67 ..
5.62.m: then surely I will quickly resort to the blazing fire!” / Then in a mere moment she saw that elephant Airāvaṇa 67

5.62.s:
dugdhakuṃdendusaṃkāśaṃ saṃjātaṃ sahasā vṛṣam ..
tasyopari sthitāṃ devīṃ śaṃbhunā saha pārvatīm .. 68 ..
5.62.d:
दुग्धकुंदेन्दुसंकाशं संजातं सहसा वृषम् ..
तस्योपरि स्थितां देवीं शंभुना सह पार्वतीम् .. 68 ..
5.62.m: suddenly turn into a bull resembling milk, a jasmine flower, and the moon; / and atop it, the goddess Pārvatī standing together with Śambhu, 68

5.62.s:
caturbhujāṃ prasannāsyāṃ divyarūpasamanvitām ..
śuklamālyāṃbaradharāṃ candrārdhakṛtamastakām .. 69 ..
5.62.d:
चतुर्भुजां प्रसन्नास्यां दिव्यरूपसमन्विताम् ..
शुक्लमाल्यांबरधरां चन्द्रार्धकृतमस्तकाम् .. 69 ..
5.62.m: four-armed, with a gracious face, endowed with a divine form, / wearing white garlands and garments, with the crescent moon on her head. 69

5.62.s:
tataḥ samyaksamālokya jñātvā tāṃ parvatātmajām ..
viṣakanyā stutiṃ cakre praṇipatya muhurmuhuḥ .. 6.62.70 ..
5.62.d:
ततः सम्यक्समालोक्य ज्ञात्वा तां पर्वतात्मजाम् ..
विषकन्या स्तुतिं चक्रे प्रणिपत्य मुहुर्मुहुः .. 6.62.70 ..
5.62.m: Then, beholding fully and recognizing her as the daughter of the mountain, / the poison maiden bowed repeatedly and offered praise: 70

5.62.s:
namaste devadeveśi namaste sarvavāsini ..
sarvakāmaprade satye jarāmaraṇavarjite .. 71 ..
5.62.d:
नमस्ते देवदेवेशि नमस्ते सर्ववासिनि ..
सर्वकामप्रदे सत्ये जरामरणवर्जिते .. 71 ..
5.62.m: “Homage to you, ruler of the god of gods! Homage to you who dwell in all! / Grantor of all desires, truth itself, devoid of old age and death! 71

5.62.s:
śakrādayo'pi devāste paramārthena no viduḥ ..
svarūpavarṇanaṃ kartuṃ kiṃ punardevi mānuṣī .. 72 ..
5.62.d:
शक्रादयोऽपि देवास्ते परमार्थेन नो विदुः ..
स्वरूपवर्णनं कर्तुं किं पुनर्देवि मानुषी .. 72 ..
5.62.m: Even the gods, Indra and the rest, do not know in ultimate truth / how to describe your true nature; what then of a human woman, O goddess? 72

5.62.s:
yasyāḥ sarvaṃ mahīvyomajalāgnipavanātmakam ..
brahmāṃḍamaṃgasaṃbhūtaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam .. 73 ..
5.62.d:
यस्याः सर्वं महीव्योमजलाग्निपवनात्मकम् ..
ब्रह्मांडमंगसंभूतं सदेवासुरमानुषम् .. 73 ..
5.62.m: For she whose limbs have given rise to the entire cosmic egg, / consisting of earth, space, water, fire, and wind, along with gods, asuras, and humans, 73

5.62.s:
na tasyā janmani brahmā na nāśāya maheśvaraḥ ..
pālanāya na goviṃdastāṃ tvāṃ stoṣyāmyahaṃ katham..74..
5.62.d:
न तस्या जन्मनि ब्रह्मा न नाशाय महेश्वरः ..
पालनाय न गोविंदस्तां त्वां स्तोष्याम्यहं कथम्..74..
5.62.m: Brahmā is not [sufficient] for her birth, Maheśvara not for her destruction, / nor Govinda for her preservation; how then shall I praise you? 74

5.62.s:
tathāṣṭaguṇamaiśvaryaṃ yasyāḥ svābhāvikaṃ param ..
nirastātiśayaṃ loke spṛhaṇīyatamaṃ sadā .. 75 ..
5.62.d:
तथाष्टगुणमैश्वर्यं यस्याः स्वाभाविकं परम् ..
निरस्तातिशयं लोके स्पृहणीयतमं सदा .. 75 ..
5.62.m: Likewise, she whose supreme eightfold sovereignty is natural [to her], / surpassing all others in the world, and ever most desirable; 75

5.62.s:
yasyā rūpāṇyanekāni samyagdhyānaparāyaṇāḥ ..
dhyāyaṃti munayo bhaktyā prāpnuvaṃti ca vāṃchitam .. 76 ..
5.62.d:
यस्या रूपाण्यनेकानि सम्यग्ध्यानपरायणाः ..
ध्यायंति मुनयो भक्त्या प्राप्नुवंति च वांछितम् .. 76 ..
5.62.m: whose manifold forms the sages, wholly devoted to true meditation, / contemplate with devotion and attain their desire; 76

5.62.s:
hṛdi saṃkalpya yadrūpaṃ dhyānenārcaṃti yoginaḥ ..
samyagbhāvātmakaiḥ puṣpairmokṣāya kṛta niścayāḥ .. 77 ..
5.62.d:
हृदि संकल्प्य यद्रूपं ध्यानेनार्चंति योगिनः ..
सम्यग्भावात्मकैः पुष्पैर्मोक्षाय कृत निश्चयाः .. 77 ..
5.62.m: having formed whose image in their heart, yogins worship with meditation, / with flowers made of pure devotion, resolved upon liberation— 77

5.62.s: tāṃ devīṃ mānuṣī bhūtvā kathaṃ staumi maheśvarīm .. 78 ..
5.62.d: तां देवीं मानुषी भूत्वा कथं स्तौमि महेश्वरीम् .. 78 ..
5.62.m: how, being a human woman, can I praise that goddess, the Great Sovereign?” 78

5.62.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
parituṣṭāsmi te putri varaṃ prārthaya suvrate ..
asaṃdigdhaṃ pradāsyāmi yatte hṛdi sadā sthitam .. 79 ..
5.62.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
परितुष्टास्मि ते पुत्रि वरं प्रार्थय सुव्रते ..
असंदिग्धं प्रदास्यामि यत्ते हृदि सदा स्थितम् .. 79 ..
5.62.m: The goddess said: / “I am well pleased with you, daughter! Ask for a boon, O woman of virtuous vows! / Without doubt, I will grant what ever resides in your heart.” 79

5.62.s:
.. viṣakanyovāca .. ..
bharturarthe mayā devi kṛto'yaṃ tapaudyamaḥ ..
tatkiṃ tena kariṣyāmi sāṃprataṃ jarayāvṛtā .. 6.62.80 ..
5.62.d:
.. विषकन्योवाच .. ..
भर्तुरर्थे मया देवि कृतोऽयं तपौद्यमः ..
तत्किं तेन करिष्यामि सांप्रतं जरयावृता .. 6.62.80 ..
5.62.m: The poison maiden said: / “This exertion of tapas was undertaken by me for the sake of a husband, O goddess; / what shall I do with that now, covered as I am with old age?” 80

5.62.s:
tasmādatrā''śrame sākaṃ tvayā stheyaṃ sadaiva tu ..
hitāya sarvanārīṇāṃ vacanānmama pārvati .. 81 .. ..
5.62.d:
तस्मादत्रा'ऽश्रमे साकं त्वया स्थेयं सदैव तु ..
हिताय सर्वनारीणां वचनान्मम पार्वति .. 81 .. ..
5.62.m:
"Therefore, at my word, O Pārvatī, you must always dwell
here in this hermitage for the welfare of all women."

5.62.s:
.. śrīdevyuvāca .. ..
adyaprabhṛtyahaṃ bhadre śreṣṭhe'sminnāśrame śubhe ..
svamāśramaṃ kariṣyāmi yatte hṛdi samāśritam .. 82 ..
5.62.d:
.. श्रीदेव्युवाच .. ..
अद्यप्रभृत्यहं भद्रे श्रेष्ठेऽस्मिन्नाश्रमे शुभे ..
स्वमाश्रमं करिष्यामि यत्ते हृदि समाश्रितम् .. 82 ..
5.62.m:
The goddess said:
"From this day forward, gentle lady, in this excellent and auspicious hermitage,
I shall make my own hermitage, as rests in your heart.

5.62.s:
māghaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ yā 'tra snānaṃ kariṣyati ..
nārī sā matprasādena lapsyate vāṃchitaṃ phalam .. 83 ..
5.62.d:
माघशुक्लतृतीयायां या ऽत्र स्नानं करिष्यति ..
नारी सा मत्प्रसादेन लप्स्यते वांछितं फलम् .. 83 ..
5.62.m:
Whatever woman takes a ritual ablution here on the third lunar day of the bright half of Māgha
shall obtain the desired fruit by my grace.

5.62.s:
api kṛtvā mahāpāpaṃ nārī vā puruṣo'thavā ..
yatra snātvā prasādānme vipāpmā saṃbhaviṣyati .. 84 ..
5.62.d:
अपि कृत्वा महापापं नारी वा पुरुषोऽथवा ..
यत्र स्नात्वा प्रसादान्मे विपाप्मा संभविष्यति .. 84 ..
5.62.m:
Even if having committed a great sin, a woman or a man
who bathes here shall become freed from sin by my grace.

5.62.s:
atra ye phaladānaṃ ca prakariṣyaṃti mānavāḥ ..
saphalāḥ sakalāsteṣāmāśāḥ syurnātra saṃśayaḥ .. 85 ..
5.62.d:
अत्र ये फलदानं च प्रकरिष्यंति मानवाः ..
सफलाः सकलास्तेषामाशाः स्युर्नात्र संशयः .. 85 ..
5.62.m:
Whatever people give gifts of fruit here,
all their desires will bear fruit; of this there is no doubt.

5.62.s:
api hatvā striyaṃ martyo yo'tra snānaṃ kariṣyati..
māghaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ vipāpmā sa bhaviṣyati .. 86 ..
5.62.d:
अपि हत्वा स्त्रियं मर्त्यो योऽत्र स्नानं करिष्यति..
माघशुक्लतृतीयायां विपाप्मा स भविष्यति .. 86 ..
5.62.m:
Even if having slain a woman, a mortal who bathes here
on the third lunar day of the bright half of Māgha shall become freed from sin.

5.62.s:
yā tatra kanyakā bhadre snānaṃ bhaktyā kari ṣyati ..
tasmindine patiśreṣṭhaṃ lapsyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 87 ..
5.62.d:
या तत्र कन्यका भद्रे स्नानं भक्त्या करि ष्यति ..
तस्मिन्दिने पतिश्रेष्ठं लप्स्यते नात्र संशयः .. 87 ..
5.62.m:
Whatever maiden, O gentle one, bathes there with devotion
on that day shall obtain an excellent husband; of this there is no doubt."

5.62.s:
..sūta uvāca .. ..
evamuktvā tato gaurī tāṃ ca pasparśa pāṇinā ..
tataśca tatkṣaṇājjātā divyarūpavapurddharā .. 88 ..
5.62.d:
..सूत उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्त्वा ततो गौरी तां च पस्पर्श पाणिना ..
ततश्च तत्क्षणाज्जाता दिव्यरूपवपुर्द्धरा .. 88 ..

5.62.s:
vṛddhatvena parityaktā divyamālyānulepanā ..
pīnonnatakucābhogā pramattagajagāminī .. 89 ..
5.62.d:
वृद्धत्वेन परित्यक्ता दिव्यमाल्यानुलेपना ..
पीनोन्नतकुचाभोगा प्रमत्तगजगामिनी .. 89 ..
5.62.m:
Free of old age, adorned with heavenly garlands and unguents,
with full and high breasts, walking like an intoxicated elephant,

5.62.s:
tatastāṃ sā samādāya vidhāya nijakiṃkarīm ..
kailāsaṃ parvataśreṣṭhaṃ jagāma harasaṃyutā .. 6.62.90 ..
5.62.d:
ततस्तां सा समादाय विधाय निजकिंकरीम् ..
कैलासं पर्वतश्रेष्ठं जगाम हरसंयुता .. 6.62.90 ..
5.62.m:
taking her and making her her own handmaid,
she then went with Hara to Kailāsa, the best of mountains.

5.62.s:
tataḥprabhṛti tattīrthaṃ śarmiṣṭhātīrthamucyate ..
prakhyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu sarvapātakanāśanam .. 91 ..
5.62.d:
ततःप्रभृति तत्तीर्थं शर्मिष्ठातीर्थमुच्यते ..
प्रख्यातं त्रिषु लोकेषु सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 91 ..
5.62.m:
From that time forward, that sacred ford is called the Śarmiṣṭhātīrtha,
renowned in the three worlds, destroying all sins.

5.62.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena tatra snānaṃ samācaret ..
māghaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ yathāvaddvijasattamāḥ .. 92 ..
5.62.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन तत्र स्नानं समाचरेत् ..
माघशुक्लतृतीयायां यथावद्द्विजसत्तमाः .. 92 ..
5.62.m:
Therefore, with every effort one should perform ritual ablution there
on the third lunar day of the bright half of Māgha according to rule, O best of brahmins.

5.62.s:
etatpavitramāyuṣyaṃ sarva pātakanāśanam ..
strītīrthasaṃbhavaṃ nṝṇāṃ māhātmyaṃ yanmayoditam .. 93 ..
5.62.d:
एतत्पवित्रमायुष्यं सर्व पातकनाशनम् ..
स्त्रीतीर्थसंभवं नॄणां माहात्म्यं यन्मयोदितम् .. 93 ..
5.62.m:
This māhātmya of the sacred ford of women, productive of longevity,
purifying, and destroying all sins, which has been spoken by me for men—

5.62.s:
yaścaitatprātarutthāya sadā paṭhati mānavaḥ ..
sa sarvām̐llabhate kāmānmanasā vāṃchitānsadā ..94..
5.62.d:
यश्चैतत्प्रातरुत्थाय सदा पठति मानवः ..
स सर्वाम्̐ल्लभते कामान्मनसा वांछितान्सदा ..94..
5.62.m:
the person who rises early in the morning and recites this always
continually attains all desires wished for in the mind.

5.62.s:
tathā parvaṇi saṃprāpte yaścaitatpaṭhate naraḥ ..
śṛṇoti cāśu bhaktyā yaḥ sa yāti śivamaṃdiram..95..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye śarmiṣṭhātīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dviṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 62 ..
5.62.d:
तथा पर्वणि संप्राप्ते यश्चैतत्पठते नरः ..
शृणोति चाशु भक्त्या यः स याति शिवमंदिरम्..95..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे श्रीहाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये शर्मिष्ठातीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्विषष्टितमोऽध्यायः .. 62 ..
5.62.m:
Likewise, when a sacred day arrives, the man who recites this
or listens with devotion swiftly goes to the abode of Śiva.
Thus ends the sixty-second chapter, named the Description of the Māhātmya of Śarmiṣṭhātīrtha, in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Śrī Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [section] of the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.63.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
atha someśvarākhyaṃ ca tatra liṃgaṃ suśobhanam ..
asti khyātaṃ triloke'tra svayaṃ somena nirmitam .. 1 ..
5.63.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अथ सोमेश्वराख्यं च तत्र लिंगं सुशोभनम् ..
अस्ति ख्यातं त्रिलोकेऽत्र स्वयं सोमेन निर्मितम् .. 1 ..
5.63.m:
Sūta said:
Now, there is a very splendid liṅga named Someśvara
renowned in the three worlds, fashioned by Soma himself.

5.63.s:
somavāreṇa yastatra vatsaraṃ yāvadarcayet ..
kṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā sa rogeṇa dāruṇenāpi mucyate ..2..
5.63.d:
सोमवारेण यस्तत्र वत्सरं यावदर्चयेत् ..
क्षणं कृत्वा स रोगेण दारुणेनापि मुच्यते ..2..
5.63.m:
He who worships it there on Mondays for a year,
devoting [even] a moment to it, is freed even from terrible disease,

5.63.s:
yakṣmaṇāpi na saṃdehaḥ kiṃ punaḥ kuṣṭhapūrvakaiḥ ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena rogārttastaṃ prapūjayet ..3..
5.63.d:
यक्ष्मणापि न संदेहः किं पुनः कुष्ठपूर्वकैः ..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन रोगार्त्तस्तं प्रपूजयेत् ..3..
5.63.m:
even from consumption, without a doubt, not to mention leprosy and the like.
Therefore, one afflicted with illness should worship it with every effort.

5.63.s:
tadārādhya purā somaḥ kṣayavyādhisamanvitaḥ ..
babhūva nīrugdeho'sau yathā pāṃḍyo narādhipaḥ .. 4 ..
5.63.d:
तदाराध्य पुरा सोमः क्षयव्याधिसमन्वितः ..
बभूव नीरुग्देहोऽसौ यथा पांड्यो नराधिपः .. 4 ..
5.63.m:
Having worshipped it in ancient times, Soma, afflicted with the disease of consumption,
became free of disease in his body, as did the king of the Pāṇḍyas.

5.63.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
oṣadhīnāmadhīśasya kathaṃ somasya sūtaja ..
kṣayavyādhiḥ purā jātā upaśāṃtiṃ kathaṃ gataḥ ..5..
5.63.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
ओषधीनामधीशस्य कथं सोमस्य सूतज ..
क्षयव्याधिः पुरा जाता उपशांतिं कथं गतः ..5..
5.63.m:
The seers said:
How did Soma, the lord of medicinal plants, O son of Sūta,
contract the disease of consumption in former times, and how did he find relief?

5.63.s:
etannaḥ sarvamācakṣva vistareṇa mahāmate..
tathā tasya mahīpasya pāṃḍyasyāpi kathāṃ śubhām .. 6 ..
5.63.d:
एतन्नः सर्वमाचक्ष्व विस्तरेण महामते..
तथा तस्य महीपस्य पांड्यस्यापि कथां शुभाम् .. 6 ..
5.63.m:
Tell us all this in detail, O highly wise one,
and also the auspicious story of that king of the Pāṇḍyas.

5.63.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
dakṣasya kanyakāḥ pūrvaṃ saptaviṃśatisaṃkhyayā ..
upayeme niśānātho devāgnigurusaṃnidhau .. 7 ..
5.63.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
दक्षस्य कन्यकाः पूर्वं सप्तविंशतिसंख्यया ..
उपयेमे निशानाथो देवाग्निगुरुसंनिधौ .. 7 ..
5.63.m:
Sūta said:
In former times, the lord of the night married the daughters of Dakṣa,
twenty-seven in number, in the presence of the gods, fire, and the guru.

5.63.s:
nakṣatrasaṃjñitā loke kīrtyaṃte yā dvijottamaiḥ ..
daivajñairaśvinīpūrvā rūpaudāryaguṇānvitāḥ ..8..
5.63.d:
नक्षत्रसंज्ञिता लोके कीर्त्यंते या द्विजोत्तमैः ..
दैवज्ञैरश्विनीपूर्वा रूपौदार्यगुणान्विताः ..8..
5.63.m:
They are celebrated as the Nakṣatras in the world by the best of brahmins
and astrologers, beginning with Aśvinī, endowed with beauty, generosity, and virtues.

5.63.s:
atha tāsāṃ samastānāṃ madhye tasya niśāpateḥ ..
rohiṇī vallabhā jajñe prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī .. 9 ..
5.63.d:
अथ तासां समस्तानां मध्ये तस्य निशापतेः ..
रोहिणी वल्लभा जज्ञे प्राणेभ्योऽपि गरीयसी .. 9 ..
5.63.m:
Then, among all of them, Rohiṇī became beloved
to that lord of the night, dearer to him than his very life.

5.63.s:
tataḥ samaṃ parityajya sarvāstā dakṣakanyakāḥ ..
rohiṇyā saha saṃyuktaḥ saṃbabhūva divāniśam .. 6.63.10 ..
5.63.d:
ततः समं परित्यज्य सर्वास्ता दक्षकन्यकाः ..
रोहिण्या सह संयुक्तः संबभूव दिवानिशम् .. 6.63.10 ..
5.63.m:
Abandoning all those daughters of Dakṣa equally,
he united with Rohiṇī day and night.

5.63.s:
tatastāḥ kāma saṃtaptā daurbhāgyena samanvitāḥ ..
procurduḥkhānvitā dakṣaṃ gatvā bāṣpaplutānanāḥ .. 11 ..
5.63.d:
ततस्ताः काम संतप्ता दौर्भाग्येन समन्विताः ..
प्रोचुर्दुःखान्विता दक्षं गत्वा बाष्पप्लुताननाः .. 11 ..
5.63.m:
Tormented by desire and afflicted with misfortune,
they then went in sorrow, their faces bathed in tears, and said to Dakṣa:

5.63.s:
vayaṃ yasmai tvayā dattāḥ patnyarthaṃ tāta pāpine..
ṛtumātramapi prītyā so'smākaṃ na prayacchati .. 12 ..
5.63.d:
वयं यस्मै त्वया दत्ताः पत्न्यर्थं तात पापिने..
ऋतुमात्रमपि प्रीत्या सोऽस्माकं न प्रयच्छति .. 12 ..
5.63.m:
"To that sinner to whom we were given as wives by you, O father,
he does not out of affection grant us even the time suitable for conception.

5.63.s:
tasmātprāṇānvihāsyāmaḥ saṃpraviśya hutāśanam ..
avilaṃbānmahābhāga satyaṃ brūmastavāgrataḥ ..3 .. 13 ..
5.63.d:
तस्मात्प्राणान्विहास्यामः संप्रविश्य हुताशनम् ..
अविलंबान्महाभाग सत्यं ब्रूमस्तवाग्रतः ..3 .. 13 ..
5.63.m:
Therefore, entering the fire, we shall abandon our lives
without delay, O blessed one; we speak the truth before you."

5.63.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tāsāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dakṣo duḥkhasamanvitaḥ ..
sarvāstāḥ svayamādāya jagāma śaśisaṃnidhau .. 14 ..
5.63.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तासां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा दक्षो दुःखसमन्वितः ..
सर्वास्ताः स्वयमादाय जगाम शशिसंनिधौ .. 14 ..
5.63.m:
Sūta said:
Hearing their words, Dakṣa was filled with grief.
Taking all of them himself, he went to the presence of the moon.

5.63.s:
tataḥ provāca so'nvakṣaṃ tāsāṃ dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ ..
bhartsayanparuṣairvākyairniśānāthaṃ muhurmuhuḥ .. 15 ..
5.63.d:
ततः प्रोवाच सोऽन्वक्षं तासां दक्षः प्रजापतिः ..
भर्त्सयन्परुषैर्वाक्यैर्निशानाथं मुहुर्मुहुः .. 15 ..
5.63.m:
Then Dakṣa, the progenitor of creatures, immediately spoke,
rebuking the lord of the night repeatedly with harsh words:

5.63.s:
kimidaṃ yujyate kartuṃ tvayā rātripate'dhama ..
karma mūḍha satāṃ bāhya dharmaśāstravigarhitam.. 16 ..
5.63.d:
किमिदं युज्यते कर्तुं त्वया रात्रिपतेऽधम ..
कर्म मूढ सतां बाह्य धर्मशास्त्रविगर्हितम्.. 16 ..
5.63.m:
"Is it proper for you to do this, O vile lord of the night?
O fool, [this is] an act foreign to the virtuous and condemned by the Dharmaśāstras!

5.63.s:
ṛtukāle'pi saṃprāpte sutā mama samudbhavāḥ ..
yanna saṃbhāṣasi prītyā dharmaśāstraṃ na vetsi kim .. 17 ..
5.63.d:
ऋतुकालेऽपि संप्राप्ते सुता मम समुद्भवाः ..
यन्न संभाषसि प्रीत्या धर्मशास्त्रं न वेत्सि किम् .. 17 ..
5.63.m:
Since, even when the time suitable for conception has arrived, you do not converse affectionately
with my daughters, do you not know the Dharmaśāstra?

5.63.s:
ṛtu snātāṃ tu yo bhāryāṃ saṃnidhau nopagacchati ..
ghorāyāṃ bhrūṇahatyāyāṃ yujyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 18 ..
5.63.d:
ऋतु स्नातां तु यो भार्यां संनिधौ नोपगच्छति ..
घोरायां भ्रूणहत्यायां युज्यते नात्र संशयः .. 18 ..
5.63.m:
He who does not approach his wife who has bathed after her season,
becomes bound to terrible embryo-murder; of this there is no doubt."

5.63.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā salajjo rātrināyakaḥ ....
provācādhomukho dakṣaṃ prakariṣye vacastava .. 19 ..
5.63.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा सलज्जो रात्रिनायकः ....
प्रोवाचाधोमुखो दक्षं प्रकरिष्ये वचस्तव .. 19 ..
5.63.m:
Hearing his words, the lord of the night, ashamed
and looking downwards, said to Dakṣa: "I shall carry out your word."

5.63.s:
tato hṛṣṭamanā dakṣaḥ sutāḥ sarvā himadyute ..
nivedyāmaṃtrya taṃ paścājjagāma nijamaṃdiram .. 6.63.20 ..3
5.63.d:
ततो हृष्टमना दक्षः सुताः सर्वा हिमद्युते ..
निवेद्यामंत्र्य तं पश्चाज्जगाम निजमंदिरम् .. 6.63.20 ..3
5.63.m:
Then, delighted in mind, having entrusted all his daughters
to the cold-rayed one and taken leave of him, Dakṣa went to his own abode.

5.63.s:
candro'pi pūrvavatsarvāstāḥ parityajya dakṣajāḥ ..
rohiṇyā saha saṃsargaṃ pracakārānurāgataḥ .. 21 ..
5.63.d:
चन्द्रोऽपि पूर्ववत्सर्वास्ताः परित्यज्य दक्षजाः ..
रोहिण्या सह संसर्गं प्रचकारानुरागतः .. 21 ..
5.63.m:
The moon also, abandoning all those daughters of Dakṣa just as before,
consorted passionately with Rohiṇī.

5.63.s:
atha tā duḥkhitā bhūyo jagmuryatra pitā sthitaḥ ..
procuśca bāṣpapūrṇākṣāstatkālasadṛśaṃ vacaḥ .. 22 ..
5.63.d:
अथ ता दुःखिता भूयो जग्मुर्यत्र पिता स्थितः ..
प्रोचुश्च बाष्पपूर्णाक्षास्तत्कालसदृशं वचः .. 22 ..
5.63.m:
Then, aggrieved once again, they went to where their father was
and, their eyes filled with tears, spoke words suited to that moment:

5.63.s:
etattāta mahadduḥkhamasmākaṃ vartate hṛdi ..
yaddaurbhāgyaṃ prasaṃjātaṃ sarvastrījanagarhitam .. .. 23 ..
5.63.d:
एतत्तात महद्दुःखमस्माकं वर्तते हृदि ..
यद्दौर्भाग्यं प्रसंजातं सर्वस्त्रीजनगर्हितम् .. .. 23 ..
5.63.m:
"This is the great sorrow in our hearts, O father:
the misfortune that has befallen us, condemned by all womankind.

5.63.s:
yatpunastvaṃ kṛtastena kāmukena durātmanā ..
vyarthaśramo'pramāṇīva kṛte'smākaṃ gataḥ svayam .. 24 ..
5.63.d:
यत्पुनस्त्वं कृतस्तेन कामुकेन दुरात्मना ..
व्यर्थश्रमोऽप्रमाणीव कृतेऽस्माकं गतः स्वयम् .. 24 ..
5.63.m:
And moreover, that you were made to exert yourself in vain by that wicked, lustful one,
as if you carried no authority, though you went yourself on our behalf—

5.63.s:
tadduḥkhaṃ na vayaṃ śaktā hṛdi dhartuṃ kathaṃcana ..
ramate sa hi rohiṇyā caṃdramāḥ sahito'niśam .. 25 ..
5.63.d:
तद्दुःखं न वयं शक्ता हृदि धर्तुं कथंचन ..
रमते स हि रोहिण्या चंद्रमाः सहितोऽनिशम् .. 25 ..
5.63.m:
we are not able to bear that sorrow in our hearts in any way.
For the moon takes his pleasure with Rohiṇī day and night,

5.63.s:
viśeṣāttava vākyena niṣiddho rātrināyakaḥ ..
anujñāṃ dehi tasmāttvamasmākaṃ tatra sāṃpratam ..
daurbhāgyaduḥkhasaṃtaptāstyajāmo yena jīvitam .. 26 ..
5.63.d:
विशेषात्तव वाक्येन निषिद्धो रात्रिनायकः ..
अनुज्ञां देहि तस्मात्त्वमस्माकं तत्र सांप्रतम् ..
दौर्भाग्यदुःखसंतप्तास्त्यजामो येन जीवितम् .. 26 ..
5.63.m:
even though the lord of the night was explicitly forbidden by your word.
Therefore, grant us permission now,
so that, burned by the sorrow of misfortune, we may cast off our lives."

5.63.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tāsāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dakṣaḥ kopasamanvitaḥ ..
śaśāpa śarvarīnāthaṃ gatvā tatsaṃnidhau tataḥ .. 27 ..
5.63.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तासां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा दक्षः कोपसमन्वितः ..
शशाप शर्वरीनाथं गत्वा तत्संनिधौ ततः .. 27 ..
5.63.m: Sūta said: / Hearing those words of theirs, Dakṣa was filled with wrath; / he went into his presence and cursed the lord of the night: 27

5.63.s:
yasmātpāpa na me vākyaṃ tvayā dharmasamanvitam ..
kṛtaṃ tasmātkṣayavyādhistvāṃ grasiṣyati dāruṇaḥ .. 28 ..
5.63.d:
यस्मात्पाप न मे वाक्यं त्वया धर्मसमन्वितम् ..
कृतं तस्मात्क्षयव्याधिस्त्वां ग्रसिष्यति दारुणः .. 28 ..
5.63.m: "Since you, sinner, did not obey my word endowed with righteousness, / therefore a dreadful consumptive disease shall devour you." 28

5.63.s:
evamuktvā yayau dakṣaścandro'pi dvijasattamāḥ ..
tatkṣaṇādyakṣmaṇāśliṣṭaḥ kṣayaṃ yāti dine dine .. 29 ..
5.63.d:
एवमुक्त्वा ययौ दक्षश्चन्द्रोऽपि द्विजसत्तमाः ..
तत्क्षणाद्यक्ष्मणाश्लिष्टः क्षयं याति दिने दिने .. 29 ..
5.63.m: Having spoken thus, Dakṣa departed; and the moon too, O best of brahmins, / seized that very moment by consumption, waned day by day. 29

5.63.s:
tato'sau kṛśatāṃ prāptaḥ saṃparityajya rohiṇīm ..
aśaktaḥ sevituṃ kāmaṃ vabhrāma jagatītale .. 6.63.30 ..
5.63.d:
ततोऽसौ कृशतां प्राप्तः संपरित्यज्य रोहिणीम् ..
अशक्तः सेवितुं कामं वभ्राम जगतीतले .. 6.63.30 ..
5.63.m: Then, having become emaciated, abandoning Rohiṇī / and unable to indulge in pleasure, he wandered over the earth, 30

5.63.s:
kṣayavyādhipraṇāśāya pṛccha mānaścikitsakān..
auṣadhāni vicitrāṇi prakurvāṇo jitendriyaḥ .. 31 ..
5.63.d:
क्षयव्याधिप्रणाशाय पृच्छ मानश्चिकित्सकान्..
औषधानि विचित्राणि प्रकुर्वाणो जितेन्द्रियः .. 31 ..
5.63.m: inquiring of physicians for the cure of the consumptive disease, / trying various medicines, with his senses controlled. 31

5.63.s:
tathāpi mucyate naiva yakṣmaṇā sa niśāpatiḥ ..
dakṣaśāpena raudreṇa kṣayaṃ yāti dinedine .. 32 ..
5.63.d:
तथापि मुच्यते नैव यक्ष्मणा स निशापतिः ..
दक्षशापेन रौद्रेण क्षयं याति दिनेदिने .. 32 ..
5.63.m: Even so, the lord of the night was not at all released from consumption; / due to Dakṣa's terrible curse, he waned day by day. 32

5.63.s:
tato vairāgyamāpannastīrthayātrāparāyaṇaḥ ..
babhūva śraddhayāyuktastyaktvā bheṣajamuttamam .. 33 ..
5.63.d:
ततो वैराग्यमापन्नस्तीर्थयात्रापरायणः ..
बभूव श्रद्धयायुक्तस्त्यक्त्वा भेषजमुत्तमम् .. 33 ..
5.63.m: Then, filled with dispassion and devoted to pilgrimage to sacred fords, / he abandoned the best of remedies and became imbued with faith. 33

5.63.s:
athāsau bhramamāṇastu tīrthānyāyatanāni ca ..
saṃprāpto brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhāḥ prabhāsaṃ kṣetramuttamam.. 34 ..
5.63.d:
अथासौ भ्रममाणस्तु तीर्थान्यायतनानि च ..
संप्राप्तो ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठाः प्रभासं क्षेत्रमुत्तमम्.. 34 ..
5.63.m: Now, wandering among sacred fords and temples, / O best of brahmins, he reached the excellent sacred field of Prabhāsa. 34

5.63.s:
tatra snātvā śucirbhūtvā prabhāsaṃ vīkṣya rātripaḥ ..
yāvatsaṃprasthitonyatra tāvadagre vyavasthitam .. 35 ..
5.63.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा शुचिर्भूत्वा प्रभासं वीक्ष्य रात्रिपः ..
यावत्संप्रस्थितोन्यत्र तावदग्रे व्यवस्थितम् .. 35 ..
5.63.m: Having bathed there and become pure, having gazed upon Prabhāsa, as the lord of the night / was about to set out elsewhere, standing right before him 35

5.63.s:
apaśyadromakaṃnāma sa muni saṃśitavratam ..
tapovīryasamopetaṃ sarvasattvānukampakam .. 36 ..
5.63.d:
अपश्यद्रोमकंनाम स मुनि संशितव्रतम् ..
तपोवीर्यसमोपेतं सर्वसत्त्वानुकम्पकम् .. 36 ..
5.63.m: he saw a sage named Romaka, of strict vows, / endowed with the power of austerity, compassionate to all living beings. 36

5.63.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā sa praṇamyoccai stataḥ provāca sādaram ..
kṣayavyādhiyutaścandro nirvedāddvijasattamāḥ .. 37 ..
5.63.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा स प्रणम्योच्चै स्ततः प्रोवाच सादरम् ..
क्षयव्याधियुतश्चन्द्रो निर्वेदाद्द्विजसत्तमाः .. 37 ..
5.63.m: Having seen him and bowed down deeply, afflicted with the consumptive disease, / the moon, out of despondency, respectfully said, O best of brahmins: 37

5.63.s:
parikṣīṇo'smi vipreṃdra kṣayavyādhiprabhāvataḥ ..
tasmātkuru pratīkāra mahaṃ tvāṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ .. 38 ..
5.63.d:
परिक्षीणोऽस्मि विप्रेंद्र क्षयव्याधिप्रभावतः ..
तस्मात्कुरु प्रतीकार महं त्वां शरणं गतः .. 38 ..
5.63.m: "I am severely wasted, O best of brahmins, by the power of the consumptive disease; / therefore, bring about a cure; I have come to you for refuge. 38

5.63.s:
mayā cikitsakāḥ pṛṣṭāstairuktaṃ bheṣajaṃ kṛtam ..
anekadhā mahābhāga parikṣīṇo dinedine .. 39 ..
5.63.d:
मया चिकित्सकाः पृष्टास्तैरुक्तं भेषजं कृतम् ..
अनेकधा महाभाग परिक्षीणो दिनेदिने .. 39 ..
5.63.m: I consulted physicians and took the remedies prescribed by them / in many ways, O fortunate one, yet I waste away day by day. 39

5.63.s:
yadi naivopadeśaṃ me kañcittvaṃ saṃpradāsyasi ..
vyādhināśāya tattena tyakṣyāmyadya kalevaram .. 6.63.40 ..
5.63.d:
यदि नैवोपदेशं मे कञ्चित्त्वं संप्रदास्यसि ..
व्याधिनाशाय तत्तेन त्यक्ष्याम्यद्य कलेवरम् .. 6.63.40 ..
5.63.m: If you do not impart to me some instruction / for the destruction of the disease, then because of it I shall cast off my body today." 40

5.63.s:
.. romaka uvāca .. ..
anyasyāpi niśānātha na śāpaḥ kartumanyathā ..
śakyate kiṃ punastasya dakṣasyāmitatejasaḥ .. 41 ..
5.63.d:
.. रोमक उवाच .. ..
अन्यस्यापि निशानाथ न शापः कर्तुमन्यथा ..
शक्यते किं पुनस्तस्य दक्षस्यामिततेजसः .. 41 ..
5.63.m: Romaka said: / "The curse even of another cannot be undone, O lord of night; / what then of that Dakṣa of boundless splendor? 41

5.63.s:
tasmādatropadeśaṃ te prayacchāmi susaṃmatam ..
yena te syādasaṃdigdhaṃ kṣayavyādhi parikṣayaḥ .. 42 ..
5.63.d:
तस्मादत्रोपदेशं ते प्रयच्छामि सुसंमतम् ..
येन ते स्यादसंदिग्धं क्षयव्याधि परिक्षयः .. 42 ..
5.63.m: Therefore, I give you well-considered instruction in this matter, / by which the complete destruction of your consumptive disease will undoubtedly take place. 42

5.63.s:
nādeyaṃ kiṃcidastīha devadevasya śūlinaḥ ..
saṃprahṛṣṭasya tadvākyāttasmādārādhayasva tam .. 43 ..
5.63.d:
नादेयं किंचिदस्तीह देवदेवस्य शूलिनः ..
संप्रहृष्टस्य तद्वाक्यात्तस्मादाराधयस्व तम् .. 43 ..
5.63.m: There is nothing that cannot be granted in this world by the God of gods, the trident-bearer, / when he is fully pleased; therefore, worship him according to his word. 43

5.63.s:
aṣṭaṣaṣṭiṣu tīrtheṣu satyaṃ vāsaḥ sadā kṣitau ..
teṣu saṃsthāpya talliṃgaṃ tasya nāśāya rātripa .. 44 ..
5.63.d:
अष्टषष्टिषु तीर्थेषु सत्यं वासः सदा क्षितौ ..
तेषु संस्थाप्य तल्लिंगं तस्य नाशाय रात्रिप .. 44 ..
5.63.m: Truly, his dwelling is always on earth in the sixty-eight sacred fords; / having installed his liṅga in them for the destruction of that [disease], O lord of night, 44

5.63.s:
ārādhaya tato nityaṃ śraddhāpūtena cetasā ..
saṃprāpsyasi na saṃdehaḥ kṣayavyādhi parikṣayam .. 45 ..
5.63.d:
आराधय ततो नित्यं श्रद्धापूतेन चेतसा ..
संप्राप्स्यसि न संदेहः क्षयव्याधि परिक्षयम् .. 45 ..
5.63.m: worship him there constantly with a mind purified by faith; / without doubt, you will attain the total destruction of your consumptive disease." 45

5.63.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā saṃprahṛṣṭo niśāpatiḥ ..
tasminprabhāsake kṣetre divyaliṃgāni śūlinaḥ ..
saṃsthāpya pūjayāmāsa svanāmāṃkāni bhaktitaḥ .. 46 ..
5.63.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा संप्रहृष्टो निशापतिः ..
तस्मिन्प्रभासके क्षेत्रे दिव्यलिंगानि शूलिनः ..
संस्थाप्य पूजयामास स्वनामांकानि भक्तितः .. 46 ..
5.63.m: Sūta said: / Hearing those words of his, the lord of the night was overjoyed; / having installed divine liṅgas of the trident-bearer marked with his own name / in that sacred field of Prabhāsa, he worshipped them with devotion. 46

5.63.s:
tatastuṣṭo mahādevastasya saṃdarśanaṃ gataḥ ..
provāca varado'smīti prārthayasva yathepsitam .. 47 .. ..
5.63.d:
ततस्तुष्टो महादेवस्तस्य संदर्शनं गतः ..
प्रोवाच वरदोऽस्मीति प्रार्थयस्व यथेप्सितम् .. 47 .. ..
5.63.m: Then Mahādeva, being pleased, appeared before him / and said: "I am the granter of boons; ask whatever you desire." 47

5.63.s:
.. candra uvāca .. ..
paraṃ kṣīṇo'smi deveśa yakṣmaṇāhaṃ padāṃtikam ..
prāptastasmātparitrāhi nānyatsaṃprārthayāmyaham .. 48 ..
5.63.d:
.. चन्द्र उवाच .. ..
परं क्षीणोऽस्मि देवेश यक्ष्मणाहं पदांतिकम् ..
प्राप्तस्तस्मात्परित्राहि नान्यत्संप्रार्थयाम्यहम् .. 48 ..
5.63.m: The Moon said: / "I am exceedingly wasted by consumption, O Lord of gods, and have come to your feet; / therefore, rescue me; I ask for nothing else." 48

5.63.s:
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhagavānvṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ..
dakṣamāhūya tatraiva tataḥ provāca sādaram .. 49 ..
5.63.d:
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा भगवान्वृषभध्वजः ..
दक्षमाहूय तत्रैव ततः प्रोवाच सादरम् .. 49 ..
5.63.m: Hearing those words of his, the blessed Lord whose emblem is the bull / summoned Dakṣa right there and then respectfully said: 49

5.63.s:
eṣa caṃdrastvayā śapto jāmātā na kṛtaṃ śubham ..
tasmādanugrahaṃ cāsya mama vākyātsamācara .. 6.63.50 ..
5.63.d:
एष चंद्रस्त्वया शप्तो जामाता न कृतं शुभम् ..
तस्मादनुग्रहं चास्य मम वाक्यात्समाचर .. 6.63.50 ..
5.63.m: "This Moon, your son-in-law, was cursed by you; that was not well done. / Therefore, bestow favor upon him at my word." 50

5.63.s:
.. dakṣa uvāca .. ..
mayā dharmyamapi prokto vākyameṣa kubuddhimān ..
nākaronme puraḥ procya kariṣyāmītya satyavāk .. 51 ..
5.63.d:
.. दक्ष उवाच .. ..
मया धर्म्यमपि प्रोक्तो वाक्यमेष कुबुद्धिमान् ..
नाकरोन्मे पुरः प्रोच्य करिष्यामीत्य सत्यवाक् .. 51 ..
5.63.m: Dakṣa said: / "Though addressed by me in accordance with righteousness, this foolish one / did not carry it out; having promised in front of me 'I shall do it,' he proved false to his word. 51

5.63.s:
tena śaptastu kopena sutārthe vṛṣabhadhvaja ..
hāsyenāpi mayā proktaṃ nānyathā saṃprajāyate .. 52 ..
5.63.d:
तेन शप्तस्तु कोपेन सुतार्थे वृषभध्वज ..
हास्येनापि मया प्रोक्तं नान्यथा संप्रजायते .. 52 ..
5.63.m: Therefore, he was cursed out of anger for the sake of my daughters, O Lord whose emblem is the bull; / even what is uttered by me in jest does not turn out otherwise." 52

5.63.s:
.. devadeva uvāca .. ..
adyaprabhṛti sarvāstāḥ sutā eṣa niśākaraḥ ..
samāḥ saṃvīkṣate nityaṃ mama vākyādasaṃśayam .. 53 ..
5.63.d:
.. देवदेव उवाच .. ..
अद्यप्रभृति सर्वास्ताः सुता एष निशाकरः ..
समाः संवीक्षते नित्यं मम वाक्यादसंशयम् .. 53 ..
5.63.m: The God of gods said: / "From this day forward, this maker of night will always regard / all those daughters equally, in accordance with my word, without doubt. 53

5.63.s:
tasmātpakṣaṃ kṣayaṃ yātu pakṣaṃ vṛddhiṃ pragacchatu ..
yena te syādvacaḥ satyaṃ matprasādasamanvitam .. 54 ..
5.63.d:
तस्मात्पक्षं क्षयं यातु पक्षं वृद्धिं प्रगच्छतु ..
येन ते स्याद्वचः सत्यं मत्प्रसादसमन्वितम् .. 54 ..
5.63.m: Therefore, let him wane for one fortnight and wax for one fortnight, / so that your word may remain true, joined with my favor." 54

5.63.s:
tato dakṣastathetyuktvā jagāma nijamandiram ..
devo'pi śaṃkaro bhūyaḥ provāca śaśalāṃchanam .. 55 ..
5.63.d:
ततो दक्षस्तथेत्युक्त्वा जगाम निजमन्दिरम् ..
देवोऽपि शंकरो भूयः प्रोवाच शशलांछनम् .. 55 ..
5.63.m: Then Dakṣa said 'So be it' and went to his own abode; / and Lord Śaṃkara spoke again to the hare-marked moon: 55

5.63.s:
bhūyo'pi prārthayābhīṣṭaṃ mattastvaṃ śaśalāṃchana ..
yena sarvaṃ prayacchāmi yadyapi syātsudurlabham .. 56 .. ..
5.63.d:
भूयोऽपि प्रार्थयाभीष्टं मत्तस्त्वं शशलांछन ..
येन सर्वं प्रयच्छामि यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्लभम् .. 56 .. ..
5.63.m: "Ask yet another desired wish from me, O hare-marked one, / so that I may grant all, even if it be very difficult to attain." 56

5.63.s:
.. candra uvāca .. ..
yadi tuṣṭo'si deveśa yadi deyo varo mama ..
tatsthāpiteṣu liṃgeṣu mayā sarveṣu sarvadā..
saṃnidhānaṃ tvayā kāryaṃ lokānāṃ hita kāmyayā .. 57 ..
5.63.d:
.. चन्द्र उवाच .. ..
यदि तुष्टोऽसि देवेश यदि देयो वरो मम ..
तत्स्थापितेषु लिंगेषु मया सर्वेषु सर्वदा..
संनिधानं त्वया कार्यं लोकानां हित काम्यया .. 57 ..
5.63.m: The Moon said: / "If you are pleased, O Lord of gods, if a boon is to be given to me, / then in all the liṅgas installed by me, your presence / must always be maintained, out of desire for the welfare of the worlds." 57

5.63.s:
.. deva uvāca .. ..
aṣṭaṣaṣṭiṣu liṃgeṣu sthāpiteṣu tvayā vibho ..
somavāreṇa sāṃnidhyaṃ kariṣye vacanāttava .. 58 ..
5.63.d:
.. देव उवाच .. ..
अष्टषष्टिषु लिंगेषु स्थापितेषु त्वया विभो ..
सोमवारेण सांनिध्यं करिष्ये वचनात्तव .. 58 ..
5.63.m: The God said: / "In the sixty-eight liṅgas installed by you, O powerful one, / I will make my presence on Mondays according to your word." 58

5.63.s:
evamuktvā sa deveśastataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ..
candro'pi harṣasaṃyuktaḥ samaṃ paśyati tāstataḥ .. 59 ..
5.63.d:
एवमुक्त्वा स देवेशस्ततश्चादर्शनं गतः ..
चन्द्रोऽपि हर्षसंयुक्तः समं पश्यति तास्ततः .. 59 ..
5.63.m: Having spoken thus, that Lord of gods disappeared from there; / and the moon, filled with joy, then looked upon them equally— 59

5.63.s:
sutā dakṣasya vipreṃdrā śaṃkarasya vacaḥ smaran..
tato harṣa samāyuktā vabhūvustadanaṃtaram .. 6.63.60 ..
5.63.d:
सुता दक्षस्य विप्रेंद्रा शंकरस्य वचः स्मरन्..
ततो हर्ष समायुक्ता वभूवुस्तदनंतरम् .. 6.63.60 ..
5.63.m: the daughters of Dakṣa, O best of brahmins, remembering the words of Śaṃkara; / then, immediately after that, they became filled with joy. 60

5.63.s:
evaṃ someśvarāstatra babhūvurdvijasattamāḥ ..
aṣṭaṣaṣṭiṣu tīrtheṣu tathānyeṣu tataḥ param .. 61 ..
5.63.d:
एवं सोमेश्वरास्तत्र बभूवुर्द्विजसत्तमाः ..
अष्टषष्टिषु तीर्थेषु तथान्येषु ततः परम् .. 61 ..
5.63.m: Thus the Someśvara liṅgas came into being there, O best of brahmins, / in the sixty-eight sacred fords, and in others thereafter. 61

5.63.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye somanāthotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma triṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 63 .. .. cha ..
5.63.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे श्रीहाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये सोमनाथोत्पत्तिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रिषष्टितमोऽध्यायः .. .. 63 .. .. छ ..
5.63.m: Thus ends the sixty-third chapter, entitled 'Description of the Origin and Māhātmya of Somanātha,' in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Śrī Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa. 63.

5.64.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
camatkārī purā devī tatraivāsti dvijottamāḥ ..
camatkāranareṃdreṇa sthāpitā śraddhayā purā .. 1 ..
5.64.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
चमत्कारी पुरा देवी तत्रैवास्ति द्विजोत्तमाः ..
चमत्कारनरेंद्रेण स्थापिता श्रद्धया पुरा .. 1 ..
5.64.m: Sūta said: / In ancient times, O best of brahmins, goddess Camatkārī was established right there, / formerly installed with faith by King Camatkāra, 1

5.64.s:
yayā sa mahiṣaḥ pūrvaṃ nihato dānavo raṇe ..
kaumāravratadhāriṇyā māyāśatasahasradhṛk .. 2 ..
5.64.d:
यया स महिषः पूर्वं निहतो दानवो रणे ..
कौमारव्रतधारिण्या मायाशतसहस्रधृक् .. 2 ..
5.64.m: by whom previously that dānava Mahiṣa, who possessed a hundred thousand illusory forms, / was slain in battle when she observed the vow of maidenhood. 2

5.64.s:
yadā tannirmitaṃ tatra puraṃ tena mahātmanā ..
tasya saṃrakṣaṇārthāya tadā sā sthāpitā dvijāḥ .. 3 ..
5.64.d:
यदा तन्निर्मितं तत्र पुरं तेन महात्मना ..
तस्य संरक्षणार्थाय तदा सा स्थापिता द्विजाः .. 3 ..
5.64.m: When that city was built there by that great-souled one, / she was installed at that time, O brahmins, for its protection, 3

5.64.s:
purasya tasya rakṣārthaṃ tathā tatpuravāsinām ..
sarveṣāṃ brāhmaṇeṃdrāṇāṃ bhaktyā bhāvitacetasām .. 4 ..
5.64.d:
पुरस्य तस्य रक्षार्थं तथा तत्पुरवासिनाम् ..
सर्वेषां ब्राह्मणेंद्राणां भक्त्या भावितचेतसाम् .. 4 ..
5.64.m: for the protection of that city and of the inhabitants of that city, / [and] of all the eminent brahmins whose minds were steeped in devotion. 4

5.64.s:
yastāmabhyarcayetsamyaṅmahānavamivāsare ..
kṛtsnaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ tasya na bhayaṃ jāyate kvacit .. 5 ..
5.64.d:
यस्तामभ्यर्चयेत्सम्यङ्महानवमिवासरे ..
कृत्स्नं संवत्सरं तस्य न भयं जायते क्वचित् .. 5 ..
5.64.m: Whoever properly worships her on the day of the Mahānavamī / never has any fear anywhere for an entire year, 5

5.64.s:
bhūtapretapiśācebhyaḥ śatrutaśca viśeṣataḥ ..
rogebhyastaskarebhyaśca duṣṭebhyo'nyebhya eva ca .. 6 ..
5.64.d:
भूतप्रेतपिशाचेभ्यः शत्रुतश्च विशेषतः ..
रोगेभ्यस्तस्करेभ्यश्च दुष्टेभ्योऽन्येभ्य एव च .. 6 ..
5.64.m: especially from bhūtas, pretas, and piśācas, or from enemies, / and from diseases, thieves, and other wicked beings. 6

5.64.s:
yaṃyaṃ kāmamabhidhyāyañchuklāṣṭamyāṃ naraḥ śuciḥ ..
tāṃ pūjayati sadbhaktyā sa tamāpnotyasaṃśayam .. 7 ..
5.64.d:
यंयं काममभिध्यायञ्छुक्लाष्टम्यां नरः शुचिः ..
तां पूजयति सद्भक्त्या स तमाप्नोत्यसंशयम् .. 7 ..
5.64.m: Whatever desire a pure man contemplates on the bright eighth [lunar day], / if he worships her with true devotion, he attains it without a doubt. 7

5.64.s:
niṣkāmaḥ sukhamāpnoti mokṣaṃ nāstyatra saṃśayaḥ ..
tasyā devyāḥ prasādena satyametanmayoditam .. 8 ..
5.64.d:
निष्कामः सुखमाप्नोति मोक्षं नास्त्यत्र संशयः ..
तस्या देव्याः प्रसादेन सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् .. 8 ..
5.64.m: One free of desire attains happiness and liberation, there is no doubt here; / by the grace of that goddess, this is the truth spoken by me. 8

5.64.s:
tāmārādhya gatāḥ pūrvaṃ siddhiṃ bhūrirmahībhujaḥ ..
brāhmaṇāśca tathānye'pi yoginaḥ parameśvarīm .. 9 ..
5.64.d:
तामाराध्य गताः पूर्वं सिद्धिं भूरिर्महीभुजः ..
ब्राह्मणाश्च तथान्येऽपि योगिनः परमेश्वरीम् .. 9 ..
5.64.m: In the past, having propitiated her, the Supreme Goddess, / many kings, brahmins, and also other yogins attained perfection. 9

5.64.s:
yastasyāḥ śraddhayopetaḥ prakaroti pradakṣiṇām ..
nityaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ yāvattiryagyonau na sa vrajet..6.64,10..
tasyā āyatane pūrvamāścaryamabhavanmahat ..
yattadvaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi śṛṇudhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ .. 11 ..
5.64.d:
यस्तस्याः श्रद्धयोपेतः प्रकरोति प्रदक्षिणाम् ..
नित्यं संवत्सरं यावत्तिर्यग्योनौ न स व्रजेत्..6.64,10..
तस्या आयतने पूर्वमाश्चर्यमभवन्महत् ..
यत्तद्वः कीर्तयिष्यामि शृणुध्वं सुसमाहिताः .. 11 ..
5.64.m: Whoever, endowed with faith, circumambulates her / every day for a year, shall not enter an animal womb. 10 / In her temple in former times there occurred a great wonder; / I shall relate it to you: listen attentively! 11

5.64.s:
āsīccitrarathonāma pūrvaṃ pārthivasattamaḥ ..
daśārṇādhipatiḥ khyātaḥ sarvaśatrunibarhaṇaḥ .. 12 ..
5.64.d:
आसीच्चित्ररथोनाम पूर्वं पार्थिवसत्तमः ..
दशार्णाधिपतिः ख्यातः सर्वशत्रुनिबर्हणः .. 12 ..
5.64.m: Formerly there was an excellent king named Citraratha, / the famous lord of Daśārṇa, the slayer of all enemies. 12

5.64.s:
śuklāṣṭamyāṃ sadā bhaktyā sa tasyāḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ ..
aṣṭottaraśataṃ yāvatpracakāra pradakṣiṇām .. 13 ..
5.64.d:
शुक्लाष्टम्यां सदा भक्त्या स तस्याः श्रद्धयान्वितः ..
अष्टोत्तरशतं यावत्प्रचकार प्रदक्षिणाम् .. 13 ..
5.64.m: On the bright eighth [lunar day], endowed with faith, he always with devotion / performed circumambulation [around her temple] one hundred and eight times. 13

5.64.s:
tataḥ praṇamya tāṃ devīṃ saṃprayāti punargṛham ..
sainyena caturaṃgeṇa samaṃtātparivāritaḥ .. 14 ..
5.64.d:
ततः प्रणम्य तां देवीं संप्रयाति पुनर्गृहम् ..
सैन्येन चतुरंगेण समंतात्परिवारितः .. 14 ..
5.64.m: Then, having bowed down to that goddess, he would return to his home, / surrounded on all sides by his fourfold army. 14

5.64.s:
evaṃ tasya nareṃdrasya pradakṣiṇaratasya ca ..
jagāma sumahānkālo devyā bhaktiratasya ca .. 15 ..
5.64.d:
एवं तस्य नरेंद्रस्य प्रदक्षिणरतस्य च ..
जगाम सुमहान्कालो देव्या भक्तिरतस्य च .. 15 ..
5.64.m: Thus, while that lord of men was intent on circumambulation / and devoted to the worship of the goddess, a very long time passed. 15

5.64.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya sa rājā tatra saṃgataḥ ..
apaśyadbrāhmaṇaśreṣṭhāndevīgṛhasamāśritān .. 16 ..
tataḥ pradakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvā tāṃ devīṃ sa mahīpatiḥ .. 16 ..
5.64.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य स राजा तत्र संगतः ..
अपश्यद्ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठान्देवीगृहसमाश्रितान् .. 16 ..
ततः प्रदक्षिणां कृत्वा तां देवीं स महीपतिः .. 16 ..
5.64.m:
Then once upon a time, that king, having arrived there, / saw the best of brahmins gathered at the temple of the goddess. 16
Then, having circumambulated that goddess, that ruler of the earth, 16

5.64.s: agrasthāṃstāndvijānsarvānnamaścakre samāhitaḥ .. 17 ..
5.64.d: अग्रस्थांस्तान्द्विजान्सर्वान्नमश्चक्रे समाहितः .. 17 ..
5.64.m: collected in mind, bowed down to all those brahmins standing before him. 17

5.64.s:
tatastaiḥ sahitaistatra sahāsīnaḥ kathāḥ śubhāḥ ..
rājarṣīṇāṃ purāṇānāṃ viprarṣīṇāṃ cakāra ha .. 18 ..
5.64.d:
ततस्तैः सहितैस्तत्र सहासीनः कथाः शुभाः ..
राजर्षीणां पुराणानां विप्रर्षीणां चकार ह .. 18 ..
5.64.m: Then, seated there together with them, he engaged in / auspicious tales of ancient royal seers and brahmin seers. 18

5.64.s:
tataḥ kasminkathāṃte sa pṛṣṭastairdvijasattamaiḥ ..
kautūhalasamopetairvinayāvanataḥ sthitaḥ .. .. 19 ..
5.64.d:
ततः कस्मिन्कथांते स पृष्टस्तैर्द्विजसत्तमैः ..
कौतूहलसमोपेतैर्विनयावनतः स्थितः .. .. 19 ..
5.64.m: Then, at the end of some conversation, he was questioned by those best of brahmins / filled with curiosity, as he stood bowed down with humility: 19

5.64.s:
rājanpṛcchāmahe sarve tvāṃ vayaṃ kautukānvitāḥ ..
tasmātkīrtaya cedguhyaṃ na tattava vyavasthitam .. 6.64.20 ..
5.64.d:
राजन्पृच्छामहे सर्वे त्वां वयं कौतुकान्विताः ..
तस्मात्कीर्तय चेद्गुह्यं न तत्तव व्यवस्थितम् .. 6.64.20 ..
5.64.m: “O King, we all ask you, being filled with curiosity; / therefore tell us, if it is not a secret kept by you. 20

5.64.s:
māsimāsi sadāṣṭamyāṃ tvaṃ śuklāyāṃ sudūrataḥ ..
āgatya devatāyāśca prakaroṣi pradakṣiṇām .. 21 ..
5.64.d:
मासिमासि सदाष्टम्यां त्वं शुक्लायां सुदूरतः ..
आगत्य देवतायाश्च प्रकरोषि प्रदक्षिणाम् .. 21 ..
5.64.m: Month after month, always on the bright eighth [lunar day], having come from far away, / you perform circumambulation of the deity. 21

5.64.s:
yatnenānyāḥ parityajya sarvāḥ pūjādikāḥ kriyāḥ ..
nūnaṃ vetsi phalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ yatpradakṣiṇasaṃbhavam.. 22 ..
5.64.d:
यत्नेनान्याः परित्यज्य सर्वाः पूजादिकाः क्रियाः ..
नूनं वेत्सि फलं कृत्स्नं यत्प्रदक्षिणसंभवम्.. 22 ..
5.64.m: Diligently abandoning all other rites such as worship, / surely you know the entire fruit that arises from circumambulation.” 22

5.64.s:
.. rājovāca .. .. satyametaddvijaśreṣṭhā yadbhavadbhirudāhṛtam ..
rahasyamapi vaktavyaṃ yuṣmākaṃ sāṃprataṃ mayā .. 23 ..
5.64.d:
.. राजोवाच .. .. सत्यमेतद्द्विजश्रेष्ठा यद्भवद्भिरुदाहृतम् ..
रहस्यमपि वक्तव्यं युष्माकं सांप्रतं मया .. 23 ..
5.64.m: The king said: / “What has been spoken by your honors, O best of brahmins, is true; / even though it is a secret, it must now be told by me to you. 23

5.64.s:
ahamāsa śukaḥ pūrvamasminnāyatane śubhe ..
devyāḥ paścimadigbhāge kulāyakṛtasaṃśrayaḥ .. 24 ..
5.64.d:
अहमास शुकः पूर्वमस्मिन्नायतने शुभे ..
देव्याः पश्चिमदिग्भागे कुलायकृतसंश्रयः .. 24 ..
5.64.m: Formerly I was a parrot in this auspicious temple, / taking shelter having made a nest on the western side of the goddess. 24

5.64.s:
tatra nirgacchato nityaṃ kurvataścapraveśanam ..
pradakṣiṇābhavaddevyā nityameva dvijottamāḥ .. 25 ..
5.64.d:
तत्र निर्गच्छतो नित्यं कुर्वतश्चप्रवेशनम् ..
प्रदक्षिणाभवद्देव्या नित्यमेव द्विजोत्तमाः .. 25 ..
5.64.m: There, constantly going out and entering, / circumambulation of the goddess happened every day, O best of brahmins. 25

5.64.s:
tataḥ kālena me mṛtyuḥ saṃjāto'traiva maṃdire ..
tatprabhāveṇa saṃjāto rājā jātismaro'tra hi .. .. 26 ..
5.64.d:
ततः कालेन मे मृत्युः संजातोऽत्रैव मंदिरे ..
तत्प्रभावेण संजातो राजा जातिस्मरोऽत्र हि .. .. 26 ..
5.64.m: Then in time my death occurred right here in this temple; / by the power of that, I was born as a king here, remembering my past lives. 26

5.64.s:
etasmātkāraṇāddūrātsamabhyetya pradakṣiṇām ..
karomyasyā dvijaśreṣṭhā devatāyāḥ samāhitaḥ .. 27 ..
5.64.d:
एतस्मात्कारणाद्दूरात्समभ्येत्य प्रदक्षिणाम् ..
करोम्यस्या द्विजश्रेष्ठा देवतायाः समाहितः .. 27 ..
5.64.m: For this reason, coming from afar, collected in mind, / I perform circumambulation of this deity, O best of brahmins. 27

5.64.s:
purā bhaktivihīnena kulāye vasatā mayā ..
kṛtā pradakṣiṇā devyāstena jāto'smi bhūpatiḥ .. 28 ..
5.64.d:
पुरा भक्तिविहीनेन कुलाये वसता मया ..
कृता प्रदक्षिणा देव्यास्तेन जातोऽस्मि भूपतिः .. 28 ..
5.64.m: Formerly, dwelling in the nest devoid of devotion, / circumambulation of the goddess was performed by me; through that I became a king. 28

5.64.s:
adhunā śraddhayā yukto yatkaromi pradakṣiṇām ..
kiṃ me bhaviṣyati śreyastanna vedmi dvijottamāḥ .. 29 ..
5.64.d:
अधुना श्रद्धया युक्तो यत्करोमि प्रदक्षिणाम् ..
किं मे भविष्यति श्रेयस्तन्न वेद्मि द्विजोत्तमाः .. 29 ..
5.64.m: Now that I perform circumambulation endowed with faith, / what greater good will be mine, that I do not know, O best of brahmins!” 29

5.64.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tacchrutvā tasya te viprā vismayotphullalocanāḥ ..
sādhuvādaṃ tathā cakrustasya bhūpasya harṣitāḥ .. .. 6.64.30 ..
5.64.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा तस्य ते विप्रा विस्मयोत्फुल्ललोचनाः ..
साधुवादं तथा चक्रुस्तस्य भूपस्य हर्षिताः .. .. 6.64.30 ..
5.64.m: Sūta said: / Hearing that of his, those brahmins, their eyes wide open with wonder, / rejoiced and applauded that king, saying ‘Well done!’ 30

5.64.s:
tataḥ sa pārthivaḥ sarvānpraṇamya dvijasattamān ..
anujñāpya yayau tūrṇaṃ svagṛhāya sasainikaḥ .. 31 ..
5.64.d:
ततः स पार्थिवः सर्वान्प्रणम्य द्विजसत्तमान् ..
अनुज्ञाप्य ययौ तूर्णं स्वगृहाय ससैनिकः .. 31 ..
5.64.m: Then, having bowed to all the best of brahmins and taken leave, / that ruler of the earth quickly departed for his home along with his soldiers. 31

5.64.s:
adhunā śraddhayā yukto yaḥ karoti pradakṣiṇām ..
sarvapāpavinirmukto labhate vāṃchitaṃ phalam .. 32 ..
5.64.d:
अधुना श्रद्धया युक्तो यः करोति प्रदक्षिणाम् ..
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो लभते वांछितं फलम् .. 32 ..
5.64.m: Whoever now performs circumambulation endowed with faith, / released from all sins, attains the desired fruit. 32

5.64.s:
tataḥ prabhṛti te viprāḥ sarve bhaktipuraḥsarāḥ ..
tasyāḥ pradakṣiṇāṃ cakrustathānye muktihetave .. 33 ..
5.64.d:
ततः प्रभृति ते विप्राः सर्वे भक्तिपुरःसराः ..
तस्याः प्रदक्षिणां चक्रुस्तथान्ये मुक्तिहेतवे .. 33 ..
5.64.m: From then on, all those brahmins, preceded by devotion, / and others as well, circumambulated her for the sake of liberation, 33

5.64.s:
prāptāśca paramāṃ siddhiṃ vāṃchitāṃ tatprabhāvataḥ ..
iha loke pare caiva durlabhāṃ tridaśairapi .. 34 ..
5.64.d:
प्राप्ताश्च परमां सिद्धिं वांछितां तत्प्रभावतः ..
इह लोके परे चैव दुर्लभां त्रिदशैरपि .. 34 ..
5.64.m: and by her power they attained supreme, desired perfection, / hard to obtain even by the gods, both in this world and in the next. 34

5.64.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena tāṃ devīmiha saṃśrayet ..
sarvakāmapradāṃ nṛṇāṃ tasminkṣetre vyavasthitām .. 35 ..
5.64.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन तां देवीमिह संश्रयेत् ..
सर्वकामप्रदां नृणां तस्मिन्क्षेत्रे व्यवस्थिताम् .. 35 ..
5.64.m: Therefore, by every effort, one should take refuge here in that goddess / situated in that sacred field, who grants all desires to mortals. 35

5.64.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye camatkārīdurgāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuḥṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 64 .. .. dha ..
5.64.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे श्रीहाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये चमत्कारीदुर्गामाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुःषष्टितमोऽध्यायः .. 64 .. .. ध ..
5.64.m: Thus ends the sixty-fourth chapter, entitled “Description of the Māhātmya of Camatkārī Durgā,” in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Śrī Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the eighty-one-thousand-[verse] collection of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa. 64.

5.65.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tathānyadapi tatrāsti taḍāgaṃ devanirmitam ..
yatrānarto nṛpaḥ siddhaḥ suhayo nāma nāmataḥ .. 1 ..
5.65.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तथान्यदपि तत्रास्ति तडागं देवनिर्मितम् ..
यत्रानर्तो नृपः सिद्धः सुहयो नाम नामतः .. 1 ..
5.65.m: Sūta said: / Likewise, there is another pond there made by the gods, / where a king of Ānarta named Suhaya attained perfection. 1

5.65.s:
tenaiva bhūbhujā tatra liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpitaṃ śubham ..
ānarteśvarasaṃjñaṃ ca sarva siddhipradaṃ nṛṇām .. 2 ..
5.65.d:
तेनैव भूभुजा तत्र लिंगं संस्थापितं शुभम् ..
आनर्तेश्वरसंज्ञं च सर्व सिद्धिप्रदं नृणाम् .. 2 ..
5.65.m: By that very king an auspicious liṅga was established there, / named Ānarteśvara, which grants all perfections to mortals. 2

5.65.s:
tatrāṃgārakaṣaṣṭhyāṃ yastaḍāge snānamācaret ..
sa prāpnoti naraḥ siddhiṃ yathā''nartādhipena ca .. 3 ..
5.65.d:
तत्रांगारकषष्ठ्यां यस्तडागे स्नानमाचरेत् ..
स प्राप्नोति नरः सिद्धिं यथा'ऽनर्ताधिपेन च .. 3 ..
5.65.m: Whoever takes a ritual ablution in that pond on Aṅgārakaṣaṣṭhī, / that man attains perfection, just as [it was attained] by the lord of Ānarta. 3

5.65.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
kathaṃ siddhistu saṃprāptā ānartena mahātmanā ..
sarvaṃ kathaya tatsūta sarvaṃ vetsi na saṃśayaḥ .. 4 ..
5.65.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
कथं सिद्धिस्तु संप्राप्ता आनर्तेन महात्मना ..
सर्वं कथय तत्सूत सर्वं वेत्सि न संशयः .. 4 ..
5.65.m: The seers said: / How was perfection attained by the high-souled king of Ānarta? / Tell all of that, O Sūta; you know everything without a doubt. 4

5.65.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
ānartaḥ suhayo nāma purāsītpṛthivīpatiḥ ..
sarvāribhirhato yuddhe palāyanaparāyaṇaḥ ..
ucchiṣṭo mlecchasaṃspṛṣṭa ekākī bahubhirvṛtaḥ .. 5 ..
5.65.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
आनर्तः सुहयो नाम पुरासीत्पृथिवीपतिः ..
सर्वारिभिर्हतो युद्धे पलायनपरायणः ..
उच्छिष्टो म्लेच्छसंस्पृष्ट एकाकी बहुभिर्वृतः .. 5 ..
5.65.m: Sūta said: / Formerly there was a king of Ānarta named Suhaya; / defeated in battle by all his enemies, intent on flight, / contaminated by food remnants, touched by barbarians, alone, surrounded by many. 5

5.65.s:
atha tasya kapālaṃ ca kāpālika vratānvitaḥ ..
jagṛhe nijakarmārthaṃ jñātvā taṃ vīrasaṃbhavam .. 6 ..
5.65.d:
अथ तस्य कपालं च कापालिक व्रतान्वितः ..
जगृहे निजकर्मार्थं ज्ञात्वा तं वीरसंभवम् .. 6 ..
5.65.m: Then one observing the Kāpālika vow took his skull / for his own ritual practice, knowing him to be born of a hero. 6

5.65.s:
ānarteśvarasāṃnidhye vasamāno vane sthitaḥ ..
sa rātrau tena toyena sarvadevamayena ca .. .. 7 ..
5.65.d:
आनर्तेश्वरसांनिध्ये वसमानो वने स्थितः ..
स रात्रौ तेन तोयेन सर्वदेवमयेन च .. .. 7 ..
5.65.m: Dwelling in the forest in the presence of Ānarteśvara, / he, at night, with that water consisting of all the gods, 7

5.65.s:
taḍāgotthena saṃpūrṇaṃ rātrau kṛtvā pramuṃcati ..
āsītpūrvaṃ vaṇiṅnāmnā siddhasena iti smṛtaḥ ..
dhanī bhṛtyasamopetaḥ sadā puṇyaparāyaṇaḥ .. 8 ..
5.65.d:
तडागोत्थेन संपूर्णं रात्रौ कृत्वा प्रमुंचति ..
आसीत्पूर्वं वणिङ्नाम्ना सिद्धसेन इति स्मृतः ..
धनी भृत्यसमोपेतः सदा पुण्यपरायणः .. 8 ..
5.65.m: having filled [it] at night with [water] originating from the pond, would release [it]. / Formerly there was a merchant celebrated by the name of Siddhasena, / wealthy, accompanied by servants, always devoted to virtue. 8

5.65.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya paṇyabuddhyā dvijottamāḥ ..
prasthitaścottarāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ sa sārthena samanvitaḥ .. 9 ..
5.65.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य पण्यबुद्ध्या द्विजोत्तमाः ..
प्रस्थितश्चोत्तरां काष्ठां स सार्थेन समन्वितः .. 9 ..
5.65.m: Then once upon a time, with an eye to trade, O best of brahmins, / he set out toward the northern quarter together with a caravan. 9

5.65.s:
atha prāptaḥ kramātsarvaiḥ sa gacchanmarumaṃḍala m ..
vṛkṣodakaparityaktaṃ sarvasattvavivarjitam.. 6.65.10 ..
5.65.d:
अथ प्राप्तः क्रमात्सर्वैः स गच्छन्मरुमंडल म् ..
वृक्षोदकपरित्यक्तं सर्वसत्त्वविवर्जितम्.. 6.65.10 ..
5.65.m: Then, proceeding by degrees with all [his companions], he reached a desert region, / devoid of trees and water, and abandoned by all living beings.

5.65.s:
tatra rātriṃ samāsādya śrāṃtāḥ pāṃthāḥ samantataḥ..
suptāḥ sthānāni saṃsṛtya gatā nidrāvaśaṃ tathā .. 11 ..
5.65.d:
तत्र रात्रिं समासाद्य श्रांताः पांथाः समन्ततः..
सुप्ताः स्थानानि संसृत्य गता निद्रावशं तथा .. 11 ..
5.65.m: Having arrived there at night, the exhausted travelers on all sides / lay down, taking their places, and fell under the sway of sleep.

5.65.s:
tataḥ pratyūṣamāsādya samutthāya ca satvaram ..
prasthitā uttarāṃ kāṣṭhāṃ muktvaikaṃ śūdrasevakam .. 12 ..
5.65.d:
ततः प्रत्यूषमासाद्य समुत्थाय च सत्वरम् ..
प्रस्थिता उत्तरां काष्ठां मुक्त्वैकं शूद्रसेवकम् .. 12 ..
5.65.m: Then, having reached dawn and gotten up quickly, / they departed toward the northern quarter, leaving behind a single Śūdra servant.

5.65.s:
sa vai mārgapariśrāṃto gatvā nidrāvaśaṃ bhṛśam ..
na jajāgāra jāte'pi prayāṇe bahuśabdite .. 13 ..
5.65.d:
स वै मार्गपरिश्रांतो गत्वा निद्रावशं भृशम् ..
न जजागार जातेऽपि प्रयाणे बहुशब्दिते .. 13 ..
5.65.m: Exhausted from the road, he had fallen into a deep sleep / and did not wake up, even though the departure was made with much noise.

5.65.s:
na ca taiḥ sa smṛtaḥ sārthairyaiḥ samaṃ prasthito gṛhāt ..
na ca kenāpi saṃdṛṣṭaḥ sa tu rodhasi saṃsthitaḥ .. 14 ..
5.65.d:
न च तैः स स्मृतः सार्थैर्यैः समं प्रस्थितो गृहात् ..
न च केनापि संदृष्टः स तु रोधसि संस्थितः .. 14 ..
5.65.m: Nor was he remembered by the caravan members with whom he had set out from home; / nor was he noticed by anyone, as he lay upon the bank.

5.65.s:
evaṃ gate tataḥ sārthe prodgate sūryamaṃḍale ..
tīvratāpaparispṛṣṭo jajāgāra tataḥ param ..15..
yāvatpaśyati no kiñcittasminsthāne sa sārthakam..
na ca teṣāṃ marau tasmim̐llakṣyate padapaddhatiḥ...6..
tato duḥkhaparītātmā dhāvamāna itastataḥ..
patito medinīpṛṣṭhe madhyāhne kṣuttṛṣārditaḥ ...7..
5.65.d:
एवं गते ततः सार्थे प्रोद्गते सूर्यमंडले ..
तीव्रतापपरिस्पृष्टो जजागार ततः परम् ..15..
यावत्पश्यति नो किञ्चित्तस्मिन्स्थाने स सार्थकम्..
न च तेषां मरौ तस्मिम्̐ल्लक्ष्यते पदपद्धतिः...6..
ततो दुःखपरीतात्मा धावमान इतस्ततः..
पतितो मेदिनीपृष्ठे मध्याह्ने क्षुत्तृषार्दितः ...7..
5.65.m:
When the caravan had thus departed and the disc of the sun had risen, / touched by the intense heat, he awoke thereafter.
When he looked, [he saw] no caravan at that place, / nor could their track of footprints be discerned in that desert.
Then, his mind overwhelmed with distress, running here and there, / he collapsed on the surface of the earth at midday, tormented by hunger and thirst.

5.65.s:
evaṃ tasya tṛṣārtasya patitasya dharātale ..
dhṛtaprāṇasya kṛcchreṇa saṃyāto'stācalaṃ raviḥ .. 18 ..
5.65.d:
एवं तस्य तृषार्तस्य पतितस्य धरातले ..
धृतप्राणस्य कृच्छ्रेण संयातोऽस्ताचलं रविः .. 18 ..
5.65.m: While he lay thus fallen on the surface of the earth, afflicted with thirst / and barely holding on to his life, the sun set behind the mountain of setting.

5.65.s:
tataḥ kiṃcitsasaṃjño'bhūnmaṃdībhūte divākare ..
cintayāmāsa cittena kvāhaṃ gacchāmi sāṃpratam .. 19 ..
5.65.d:
ततः किंचित्ससंज्ञोऽभून्मंदीभूते दिवाकरे ..
चिन्तयामास चित्तेन क्वाहं गच्छामि सांप्रतम् .. 19 ..
5.65.m: Then he regained some consciousness as the day-maker's light grew dim, / and he reflected in his mind: “Where shall I go now?

5.65.s:
na lakṣyate kvacinmārgo dṛśyate na ca mānuṣam ..
nātra toyaṃ na ca cchāyā nūnaṃ me mṛtyu rāgataḥ .. 6.65.20 ..
5.65.d:
न लक्ष्यते क्वचिन्मार्गो दृश्यते न च मानुषम् ..
नात्र तोयं न च च्छाया नूनं मे मृत्यु रागतः .. 6.65.20 ..
5.65.m: Nowhere is a path discerned, nor is any human being seen; / here is no water and no shade; surely my death has arrived!”

5.65.s:
evaṃ cintāprapannasya tasya śūdrasya nirjane ..
marau tasminsamāyātā śarvarī tadanantaram .. 21 ..
5.65.d:
एवं चिन्ताप्रपन्नस्य तस्य शूद्रस्य निर्जने ..
मरौ तस्मिन्समायाता शर्वरी तदनन्तरम् .. 21 ..
5.65.m: While that Śūdra was thus plunged in sorrow in the desolate desert, / night arrived immediately thereafter.

5.65.s:
atha kṣaṇena śuśrāva sa gītaṃ madhuradhvani ..
paṭhatāṃ nandivṛddhānāṃ tathā śabdaṃ manoharam .. 22 ..
5.65.d:
अथ क्षणेन शुश्राव स गीतं मधुरध्वनि ..
पठतां नन्दिवृद्धानां तथा शब्दं मनोहरम् .. 22 ..
5.65.m: Then in an instant he heard sweet-sounding song / and also the charming voice of bards chanting benedictions.

5.65.s:
athāpaśyatkṣaṇenaiva pretasaṃghaiḥ sabhāvṛtam ..
pretamekaṃ ca sarveṣāmādhipatye vyava sthitam .. 23 ..
5.65.d:
