5.70.s: sasṛjuste surādhīśā dānavebhyo divāniśam .. 6.70.20 ..
5.70.d: ससृजुस्ते सुराधीशा दानवेभ्यो दिवानिशम् .. 6.70.20 ..
5.70.m: Those lords of the gods produced [them] day and night against the dānavas: // 20

5.70.s:
mudgarā bhiṃḍipālāśca śataghnyo'tha vareṣavaḥ ..
prāsāḥ kuntāśca bhallāśca tasminkāle vinirmitāḥ ..
viśeṣāhavasaṃbandhavyūhānāṃ prakriyāśca yāḥ .. 21 ..
5.70.d:
मुद्गरा भिंडिपालाश्च शतघ्न्योऽथ वरेषवः ..
प्रासाः कुन्ताश्च भल्लाश्च तस्मिन्काले विनिर्मिताः ..
विशेषाहवसंबन्धव्यूहानां प्रक्रियाश्च याः .. 21 ..
5.70.m: clubs, slings, śataghnīs, excellent arrows, / javelins, spears, and missile points were fashioned at that time, / as well as arrays of battle formations specific to combat, // 21

5.70.s:
tathānyāni vicitrāṇi kūṭayuddhānyanekaśaḥ ..
bhīṣikāḥ kuhakāścaiva śakrajālāni kṛtsnaśaḥ .. 22 ..
5.70.d:
तथान्यानि विचित्राणि कूटयुद्धान्यनेकशः ..
भीषिकाः कुहकाश्चैव शक्रजालानि कृत्स्नशः .. 22 ..
5.70.m: and likewise other multifaceted deceptive tactics in large numbers: / terrors, magic tricks, and all forms of illusory nets. // 22

5.70.s:
na ca te vijayaṃ prāpustathāpi dvijasattamāḥ ..
dānavebhyo mahāyuddhe prahārairjarjarīkṛtāḥ..23..
5.70.d:
न च ते विजयं प्रापुस्तथापि द्विजसत्तमाः ..
दानवेभ्यो महायुद्धे प्रहारैर्जर्जरीकृताः..23..
5.70.m: Even so, they did not attain victory, O best of brahmins; / they were battered by blows from the dānavas in the great battle. // 23

5.70.s:
atha prāha sahasrākṣo bhayatrasto bṛhaspatim ..
dinedine vayaṃ daityairvijayāmo dvijottama .. 24 ..
5.70.d:
अथ प्राह सहस्राक्षो भयत्रस्तो बृहस्पतिम् ..
दिनेदिने वयं दैत्यैर्विजयामो द्विजोत्तम .. 24 ..
5.70.m: Then the thousand-eyed [Indra], terrified by fear, spoke to Bṛhaspati: / “Day after day we are conquered by the daityas, O best of brahmins! // 24

5.70.s:
yathāyathā raṇārthāya sadupāyānkaromyaham ..
tathātathā parābhūtirjāyate me mahāhave .. 25 ..
5.70.d:
यथायथा रणार्थाय सदुपायान्करोम्यहम् ..
तथातथा पराभूतिर्जायते मे महाहवे .. 25 ..
5.70.m: The more I employ proper strategies for the sake of battle, / the more my defeat occurs in the great combat. // 25

5.70.s:
tadupāyaṃ surācārya svabuddhyā tvaṃ pracintaya ..
yena me syājjayo yuddhe tava kīrtiraninditā 0. 26 ..
5.70.d:
तदुपायं सुराचार्य स्वबुद्ध्या त्वं प्रचिन्तय ..
येन मे स्याज्जयो युद्धे तव कीर्तिरनिन्दिता 0. 26 ..
5.70.m: Therefore, O teacher of the gods, devise a strategy with your intellect, / whereby victory in battle may be mine, and blameless fame may be yours.” // 26

5.70.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tato bṛhaspatiḥ prāha ciraṃ dhyātvā śacīpatim ..
prahṛṣṭavadano jñātvā jayopāyaṃ mahāhave .. .. 27 ..
5.70.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
ततो बृहस्पतिः प्राह चिरं ध्यात्वा शचीपतिम् ..
प्रहृष्टवदनो ज्ञात्वा जयोपायं महाहवे .. .. 27 ..
5.70.m: Sūta said: / Then Bṛhaspati, having meditated for a long time, spoke to the lord of Śacī, / with a joyful face, having understood the means of victory in the great combat: // 27

5.70.s:
mayā śakra parijñātaḥ sa upāyo mahāhave ..
jīyante śatravo yena līlayaivāpi bhūriśaḥ .. 28 ..
5.70.d:
मया शक्र परिज्ञातः स उपायो महाहवे ..
जीयन्ते शत्रवो येन लीलयैवापि भूरिशः .. 28 ..
5.70.m: “O Indra, I have discovered that means in the great combat, / by which the enemies are easily conquered, even in great numbers. // 28

5.70.s:
yadābhīṣṭaṃ varaṃ tena prārthitastripurāṃtakaḥ ..
tadaivaṃ vacanaṃ prāha praṇipatya muhurmuhuḥ .. 29 ..
5.70.d:
यदाभीष्टं वरं तेन प्रार्थितस्त्रिपुरांतकः ..
तदैवं वचनं प्राह प्रणिपत्य मुहुर्मुहुः .. 29 ..
5.70.m: When he requested the desired boon from the destroyer of Tripura, / he then spoke these words, bowing repeatedly: // 29

5.70.s:
ajeyaḥ sarvadevānāṃ tvatprasādādahaṃ vibho ..
yathā bhavāmi saṃgrāme tvāṃ vihāya tathā kuru .. 6.70.30
na taṃ svayaṃ mahādevaḥ svaśiṣyaṃ sūdayiṣyati ..
viṣavṛkṣamapi sthāpya kaśchinatti punaḥ svayam .. 31 ..
5.70.d:
अजेयः सर्वदेवानां त्वत्प्रसादादहं विभो ..
यथा भवामि संग्रामे त्वां विहाय तथा कुरु .. 6.70.30
न तं स्वयं महादेवः स्वशिष्यं सूदयिष्यति ..
विषवृक्षमपि स्थाप्य कश्छिनत्ति पुनः स्वयम् .. 31 ..
5.70.m:
‘O lord, by your favor, act in such a way that in battle / I may be unconquerable by all the gods, leaving you aside.’ // 30
Mahādeva himself will not destroy his own disciple; / for having planted even a poisonous tree, who cuts it down himself? // 31

5.70.s:
yo vai pitā sa putraḥ syācchrutivākyamidaṃ smṛtam ..
tasmājjanayatu kṣipraṃ harastannāśakṛtsutam .. 32 ..
5.70.d:
यो वै पिता स पुत्रः स्याच्छ्रुतिवाक्यमिदं स्मृतम् ..
तस्माज्जनयतु क्षिप्रं हरस्तन्नाशकृत्सुतम् .. 32 ..
5.70.m: ‘He who is the father becomes the son’—such is the celebrated Vedic statement. / Therefore, let Hara quickly beget a son who will cause his destruction, // 32

5.70.s:
yena senādhipatye taṃ viniyojya mahāhavam ..
kurmo daityaiḥ samaṃ śastraiḥ prāpnuyāma tato jayam ..33..
5.70.d:
येन सेनाधिपत्ये तं विनियोज्य महाहवम् ..
कुर्मो दैत्यैः समं शस्त्रैः प्राप्नुयाम ततो जयम् ..33..
5.70.m: by which, having appointed him to the command of the army, we may wage / a great battle against the daityas with weapons, and then attain victory. // 33

5.70.s:
eṣa eva upāyo'tra mayā te parikīrtitaḥ ..
vijayāya sahasrākṣa nānyo'sti bhuvanatraye .. 34 ..
5.70.d:
एष एव उपायोऽत्र मया ते परिकीर्तितः ..
विजयाय सहस्राक्ष नान्योऽस्ति भुवनत्रये .. 34 ..
5.70.m: This alone is the means proclaimed by me here to you / for victory, O thousand-eyed one; there is no other in the three worlds.” // 34

5.70.s:
tato devagaṇaiḥ sarvaiḥ sametaḥ pākaśāsanaḥ ...
tamarthaṃ proktavāñchaṃbhuṃ vinayāvanataḥ sthitaḥ .. 35 ..
5.70.d:
ततो देवगणैः सर्वैः समेतः पाकशासनः ...
तमर्थं प्रोक्तवाञ्छंभुं विनयावनतः स्थितः .. 35 ..
5.70.m: Then the subduer of Pāka, accompanied by all the hosts of gods, / spoke of that matter to Śambhu, standing bowed down in humility: // 35

5.70.s:
sutasya jananārthāya kuru yatnaṃ vṛṣadhvaja..
yena senādhipatye taṃ yojayāmi divaukasām ..36..
5.70.d:
सुतस्य जननार्थाय कुरु यत्नं वृषध्वज..
येन सेनाधिपत्ये तं योजयामि दिवौकसाम् ..36..
5.70.m: “Make an effort to beget a son, O bull-bannered god, / so that I may appoint him to the command of the army of the celestials, // 36

5.70.s:
prāpnomyahaṃ ca saṃgrāme vijayaṃ tvatprasādataḥ ..
nihatya dānavānsarvāṃstārakeṇa samanvitān .. 37 ..
5.70.d:
प्राप्नोम्यहं च संग्रामे विजयं त्वत्प्रसादतः ..
निहत्य दानवान्सर्वांस्तारकेण समन्वितान् .. 37 ..
5.70.m: and by your grace I may attain victory in battle, / having slain all the dānavas together with Tāraka. // 37

5.70.s:
nānyathā vijayo me syātsaṃgrāme dānavaiḥ saha...
iti māṃ prāha devejyo jñātvā samyaṅmahāmatiḥ .. 38 ..
5.70.d:
नान्यथा विजयो मे स्यात्संग्रामे दानवैः सह...
इति मां प्राह देवेज्यो ज्ञात्वा सम्यङ्महामतिः .. 38 ..
5.70.m: In no other way can there be victory for me in battle against the dānavas; / so the highly intelligent preceptor of the gods told me, having properly discerned it.” // 38

5.70.s:
athovāca vihasyoccaiḥ śaṃkarastridaśeśvaram ..
kariṣyāmi vacaḥ kṣipraṃ tava śakra na saṃśayaḥ.. . .. 39 ..
5.70.d:
अथोवाच विहस्योच्चैः शंकरस्त्रिदशेश्वरम् ..
करिष्यामि वचः क्षिप्रं तव शक्र न संशयः.. . .. 39 ..
5.70.m: Then Śaṃkara, laughing aloud, said to the lord of the thirty [gods]: / “I will carry out your word swiftly, O Indra; of this there is no doubt.” // 39

5.70.s:
putramutpādayiṣyāmi sarvadaityavināśakam ..
yaṃ tvaṃ senāpatiṃ kṛtvā jayaṃ prāpsyasi sarvadā .. 6.70.40 ..
5.70.d:
पुत्रमुत्पादयिष्यामि सर्वदैत्यविनाशकम् ..
यं त्वं सेनापतिं कृत्वा जयं प्राप्स्यसि सर्वदा .. 6.70.40 ..
5.70.m: "I shall produce a son who will destroy all the Daityas, / whom you will make commander-in-chief and thereby obtain victory always."

5.70.s:
evamuktvā mahādevo gatvā kailāsa parvatam ..
gauryā samaṃ tataścakre kāmadharmaṃ yathocitam .. 41 ..
5.70.d:
एवमुक्त्वा महादेवो गत्वा कैलास पर्वतम् ..
गौर्या समं ततश्चक्रे कामधर्मं यथोचितम् .. 41 ..
5.70.m: Having spoken thus, Mahādeva went to Mount Kailāsa, / and then with Gaurī engaged in the duty of love as was proper,

5.70.s:
hāvairbhāvaiḥ samopetaṃ hāsyairanyaistadātmikaiḥ ..
yāvadvarṣasahasrāṃtaṃ divyaṃ caiva nimeṣavat .. .. 42 ..
5.70.d:
हावैर्भावैः समोपेतं हास्यैरन्यैस्तदात्मिकैः ..
यावद्वर्षसहस्रांतं दिव्यं चैव निमेषवत् .. .. 42 ..
5.70.m: accompanied by gestures and moods, and other laughs natural to it, / for the duration of a thousand divine years, like the twinkling of an eye.

5.70.s:
atha devagaṇāḥ sarve bhayasaṃtrastamānasāḥ ..
cakrurmaṃtraṃ tadarthaṃ hi tārakeṇa prapīḍitāḥ .. 43 ..
5.70.d:
अथ देवगणाः सर्वे भयसंत्रस्तमानसाः ..
चक्रुर्मंत्रं तदर्थं हि तारकेण प्रपीडिताः .. 43 ..
5.70.m: Then all the hosts of gods, their minds terrified with fear, / held counsel for that purpose, oppressed as they were by Tāraka:

5.70.s:
sahasraṃ vatsarāṇāṃ tu ratāsaktasya śūlinaḥ ..
atikrāṃtaṃ na devānāṃ tena kṛtyaṃ vinirmitam .. 44 ..
5.70.d:
सहस्रं वत्सराणां तु रतासक्तस्य शूलिनः ..
अतिक्रांतं न देवानां तेन कृत्यं विनिर्मितम् .. 44 ..
5.70.m: "A thousand years have passed while the Trident-bearer has been absorbed in pleasure, / yet the task of the gods has not been accomplished by him.

5.70.s:
tasmādgacchāmahe tatra yatra devo maheśvaraḥ ..
saṃtiṣṭhate samaṃ gauryā kailāse vijane sthitaḥ ..45...
5.70.d:
तस्माद्गच्छामहे तत्र यत्र देवो महेश्वरः ..
संतिष्ठते समं गौर्या कैलासे विजने स्थितः ..45...
5.70.m: Therefore let us go there where the god Maheśvara / resides together with Gaurī, staying in a secluded place on Kailāsa."

5.70.s:
tatastatraiva saṃjagmuḥ sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ ..
udvahantaḥ parāmārtiṃ tārakārisamudbhavām .. 46 ..
5.70.d:
ततस्तत्रैव संजग्मुः सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः ..
उद्वहन्तः परामार्तिं तारकारिसमुद्भवाम् .. 46 ..
5.70.m: Then all the gods along with Indra went right there, / bearing supreme distress born from the enemy Tāraka.

5.70.s:
atha kailāsamāsādya yāvadyāṃti bhavāṃtikam..
niṣiddhā naṃdinā tāvanna gaṃtavyamataḥ param .. 47 ..
5.70.d:
अथ कैलासमासाद्य यावद्यांति भवांतिकम्..
निषिद्धा नंदिना तावन्न गंतव्यमतः परम् .. 47 ..
5.70.m: Then, having reached Kailāsa, as they were approaching Hara's presence, / they were stopped by Nandin: "You must not go beyond this.

5.70.s:
rahasye bhagavānsārdhaṃ pārvatyā samavasthitaḥ ..
asmākamapi no gamyaṃ tasmāttāvanna gamyatām .. 48 ..
5.70.d:
रहस्ये भगवान्सार्धं पार्वत्या समवस्थितः ..
अस्माकमपि नो गम्यं तस्मात्तावन्न गम्यताम् .. 48 ..
5.70.m: The Lord is situated in privacy together with Pārvatī. / Even we cannot go [there]; therefore do not go!"

5.70.s:
tatastairvibudhaiḥ sarvaiḥ preṣitastatra cānilaḥ..
kiṃ karoti mahādevaḥ śīghraṃ vijñāyatāmiti .. 49 ..
5.70.d:
ततस्तैर्विबुधैः सर्वैः प्रेषितस्तत्र चानिलः..
किं करोति महादेवः शीघ्रं विज्ञायतामिति .. 49 ..
5.70.m: Then the Wind was dispatched there by all those gods, / saying: "Let it be quickly ascertained what Mahādeva is doing."

5.70.s:
atha vāyurgatastatra yatrāste bhagavāñchivaḥ ..
gauryā saha ratāsakta ānandaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ .. 6.70.50 ..
5.70.d:
अथ वायुर्गतस्तत्र यत्रास्ते भगवाञ्छिवः ..
गौर्या सह रतासक्त आनन्दं परमं गतः .. 6.70.50 ..
5.70.m: Then the Wind went there where the Lord Śiva sat, / absorbed in pleasure with Gaurī, having attained supreme bliss.

5.70.s:
atha pracalite śukre sthānādaprāptayonike ..
devena vīkṣito vāyurnātidūre vyavasthitaḥ .. 51 ..
5.70.d:
अथ प्रचलिते शुक्रे स्थानादप्राप्तयोनिके ..
देवेन वीक्षितो वायुर्नातिदूरे व्यवस्थितः .. 51 ..
5.70.m: Then, as the semen had stirred from its place without having reached the womb, / the Wind, standing not very far away, was seen by the god.

5.70.s:
tato vrīḍā samopetastatkṣaṇādeva cotthitaḥ ..
bhāvāsaktāṃ priyāṃ tyaktvā mā mottiṣṭhetivādinīm .. 52 ..
5.70.d:
ततो व्रीडा समोपेतस्तत्क्षणादेव चोत्थितः ..
भावासक्तां प्रियां त्यक्त्वा मा मोत्तिष्ठेतिवादिनीम् .. 52 ..
5.70.m: Then, overcome with shame, he arose that very moment, / abandoning his beloved who was absorbed in passion and saying, "Do not, do not get up!"

5.70.s:
abravīdatha taṃ vāyuṃ vinayāvanataṃ sthitam ..
kimarthaṃ tvamihāyātaḥ kaccitkṣemaṃ divaukasām .. 53 ..
5.70.d:
अब्रवीदथ तं वायुं विनयावनतं स्थितम् ..
किमर्थं त्वमिहायातः कच्चित्क्षेमं दिवौकसाम् .. 53 ..
5.70.m: He then spoke to the Wind who was standing bowed in modesty: / "For what purpose have you come here? Is all well with the gods?"

5.70.s:
.. vāyuruvāca .. ..
ete śakrādayo devā naṃdinā vinivāritāḥ ..
tārakeṇa hatotsāhāstiṣṭhaṃti girirodhasi .. 54 ..
5.70.d:
.. वायुरुवाच .. ..
एते शक्रादयो देवा नंदिना विनिवारिताः ..
तारकेण हतोत्साहास्तिष्ठंति गिरिरोधसि .. 54 ..
5.70.m: The Wind said: / "These gods, Indra and the others, turned back by Nandin, / their enthusiasm destroyed by Tāraka, are waiting at the base of the mountain.

5.70.s:
tasmādetānsamābhāṣya samāśvāsya ca sādaram ..
preṣayasva drutaṃ tatra yatra te dānavāḥ sthitāḥ .. 55 ..
5.70.d:
तस्मादेतान्समाभाष्य समाश्वास्य च सादरम् ..
प्रेषयस्व द्रुतं तत्र यत्र ते दानवाः स्थिताः .. 55 ..
5.70.m: Therefore, having addressed them and respectfully consoled them, / send [them] quickly to where those Dānavas are stationed."

5.70.s:
atha tānāhvayāmāma tatkṣaṇāttripurāṃtakaḥ ..
saṃprāha caviṣaṇṇāsyaḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭānsthitān .. 56 ..
5.70.d:
अथ तानाह्वयामाम तत्क्षणात्त्रिपुरांतकः ..
संप्राह चविषण्णास्यः कृतांजलिपुटान्स्थितान् .. 56 ..
5.70.m: Then the destroyer of Tripura summoned them immediately; / with a dejected face, he addressed them as they stood with folded hands:

5.70.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
yuṣmatkṛte samāraṃbhaḥ putrārthaṃ yo mayā kṛtaḥ ..
svasthānāccalite śukre kṛto moghodya vāyunā .. 57 ..
5.70.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
युष्मत्कृते समारंभः पुत्रार्थं यो मया कृतः ..
स्वस्थानाच्चलिते शुक्रे कृतो मोघोद्य वायुना .. 57 ..
5.70.m: The Lord said: / "The undertaking made by me for your sake, for the sake of a son, / when the semen stirred from its place, has today been made vain by the Wind.

5.70.s:
etadvīryaṃ mayā dhairyātstaṃbhitaṃ liṃgamadhyagam ..
amoghaṃ tiṣṭhate sarvaṃ kva dadhāmi nivedyatām.. 58 ..
5.70.d:
एतद्वीर्यं मया धैर्यात्स्तंभितं लिंगमध्यगम् ..
अमोघं तिष्ठते सर्वं क्व दधामि निवेद्यताम्.. 58 ..
5.70.m: This semen was arrested with firm resolve by me within the liṅga; / it remains entirely unfailing. Let it be declared where I may deposit it,

5.70.s:
yena saṃjāyate putro dānavāṃtakaraḥ paraḥ ..
senānāthaśca yuṣmākaṃ durddharaḥ samare paraiḥ .. 59 ..
5.70.d:
येन संजायते पुत्रो दानवांतकरः परः ..
सेनानाथश्च युष्माकं दुर्द्धरः समरे परैः .. 59 ..
5.70.m: so that an excellent son may be born, the destroyer of Dānavas, / and your commander-in-chief, unassailable in battle by enemies.

5.70.s:
etatkalpāgnisaṃkāśaṃ dhartuṃ śaknoti nāparaḥ ..
vinā vaiśvānaraṃ tasmāddadhātveṣa sanātanam.. 6.70.60 ..
5.70.d:
एतत्कल्पाग्निसंकाशं धर्तुं शक्नोति नापरः ..
विना वैश्वानरं तस्माद्दधात्वेष सनातनम्.. 6.70.60 ..
5.70.m: No other is able to bear this, which resembles the cosmic fire of dissolution, / except Vaiśvānara; therefore let him bear this eternal [seed],

5.70.s:
yena tatra pramuñcāmi sutāya vijayāya ca ..
etadvīryaṃ mahātīvraṃ dvādaśārkasamaprabham .. .. 61 ..
5.70.d:
येन तत्र प्रमुञ्चामि सुताय विजयाय च ..
एतद्वीर्यं महातीव्रं द्वादशार्कसमप्रभम् .. .. 61 ..
5.70.m: so that I may release it there for a son and for victory, / this exceedingly fierce seed equal in brilliance to twelve suns."

5.70.s:
atha prāhuḥ surāḥ sarve vahniṃ saṃślāghya sādarāḥ ..
tvaṃ dhārayāgne vaktrāṃte vīryametadbhavodbhavam .. 62 ..
5.70.d:
अथ प्राहुः सुराः सर्वे वह्निं संश्लाघ्य सादराः ..
त्वं धारयाग्ने वक्त्रांते वीर्यमेतद्भवोद्भवम् .. 62 ..
5.70.m: Then all the gods, praising the Fire, respectfully said: / "O Fire, hold in your mouth this seed sprung from Bhava."

5.70.s:
tataḥ prasārayāmāsa svavaktraṃ pāvako drutam..
kurvañchakrasamādeśamavikalpena cetasā ..63..
5.70.d:
ततः प्रसारयामास स्ववक्त्रं पावको द्रुतम्..
कुर्वञ्छक्रसमादेशमविकल्पेन चेतसा ..63..
5.70.m: Then the Fire quickly opened his mouth, / executing Indra's command with an unhesitating mind.

5.70.s:
śaṃkaro'pyakṣipattatra kāmabāṇaprapīḍitaḥ ..
gaurīṃ bhagavatīṃ dhyāyannānandaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ..64..
5.70.d:
शंकरोऽप्यक्षिपत्तत्र कामबाणप्रपीडितः ..
गौरीं भगवतीं ध्यायन्नानन्दं परमं गतः..64..
5.70.m: Śaṃkara also discharged it there, afflicted by the arrows of Kāma, / meditating on the goddess Gaurī, having attained supreme bliss.

5.70.s:
pāvako'pi bhṛśaṃ tena kalpāgnisadṛśena ca ..
dahyamāno'kṣipadbhūmau śarastaṃbe suvistare..65..
5.70.d:
पावकोऽपि भृशं तेन कल्पाग्निसदृशेन च ..
दह्यमानोऽक्षिपद्भूमौ शरस्तंबे सुविस्तरे..65..
5.70.m: The Fire too, intensely burned by it which was like the fire of cosmic dissolution, / dropped it upon the ground into a vast clump of reeds.

5.70.s:
etasminnaṃtare prāptā bhramamāṇā itastataḥ..
bhāryāstatra munīnāṃ tāḥ ṣaṇṇāṃ ṣaṭkṛttikāḥ śubhāḥ..66..
5.70.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्ता भ्रममाणा इतस्ततः..
भार्यास्तत्र मुनीनां ताः षण्णां षट्कृत्तिकाः शुभाः..66..
5.70.m: Meanwhile, wandering here and there, / the wives of the six sages, the six auspicious Kṛttikās, arrived there.

5.70.s:
tāsāṃ nideśayāmāsa svayameva śatakratuḥ ..
etadbījaṃ trinetrasya paripālyaṃ prayatnataḥ .. 67 ..
5.70.d:
तासां निदेशयामास स्वयमेव शतक्रतुः ..
एतद्बीजं त्रिनेत्रस्य परिपाल्यं प्रयत्नतः .. 67 ..
5.70.m: Indra himself instructed them: / "This seed of the Three-eyed God is to be preserved with effort.

5.70.s:
atra saṃpatsyate putro dvādaśārkasamaprabhaḥ ..
bhavatīnāmapi prāyaḥ putratvaṃ saṃprayāsyati .. 68 ..
5.70.d:
अत्र संपत्स्यते पुत्रो द्वादशार्कसमप्रभः ..
भवतीनामपि प्रायः पुत्रत्वं संप्रयास्यति .. 68 ..
5.70.m: Here a son will be produced, equal in brilliance to twelve suns; / he will also essentially attain the status of son to you all."

5.70.s: iti śrīskāde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgara khaṃḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye kārtikeyotpattivṛttāṃtavarṇanaṃnāma saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 6.70.70 .. .. cha ..
5.70.d: इति श्रीस्कादे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागर खंडे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कार्तिकेयोत्पत्तिवृत्तांतवर्णनंनाम सप्ततितमोऽध्यायः .. 6.70.70 .. .. छ ..
5.70.m: Thus ends the seventieth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Account of the Origin of Kārttikeya', in the Māhātmya of Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

5.71.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tāstatheti pratijñāya cakrustacchakraśāsanam ..
sūtikāgṛhadharme yattaccakrustasya sarvaśaḥ .. 1 ..
5.71.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तास्तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय चक्रुस्तच्छक्रशासनम् ..
सूतिकागृहधर्मे यत्तच्चक्रुस्तस्य सर्वशः .. 1 ..
5.71.m: Sūta said: / Assenting with "So be it," they obeyed that command of Indra; / whatever pertained to the practice of the lying-in chamber, they performed completely for him.

5.71.s:
athānyadivase bālo dvādaśārkasamadyutiḥ ..
saṃjajñe tena vīryeṇa dvibhujaika mukhaḥ śubhaḥ .. 2 ..
5.71.d:
अथान्यदिवसे बालो द्वादशार्कसमद्युतिः ..
संजज्ञे तेन वीर्येण द्विभुजैक मुखः शुभः .. 2 ..
5.71.m: Then on another day, a boy having the splendor of twelve suns, / two-armed, single-faced, and auspicious, was born from that seed.

5.71.s:
yathāsau jātamātrastu praruroda suduḥkhitaḥ ..
tacchrutvā ruditaṃ sarvāḥ kṛttikāstamupāgatāḥ .. 3 ..
5.71.d:
यथासौ जातमात्रस्तु प्ररुरोद सुदुःखितः ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा रुदितं सर्वाः कृत्तिकास्तमुपागताः .. 3 ..
5.71.m: As soon as he was born, he wept, exceedingly distressed; / hearing that crying, all the Kṛttikās approached him.

5.71.s:
mahāseno'pi saṃvīkṣya mātṝstāḥ samupāgatāḥ..
sotkaṇṭhaḥ ṣaṇmukho jāto dvādaśākṣabhujastathā .. 4 ..
5.71.d:
महासेनोऽपि संवीक्ष्य मातॄस्ताः समुपागताः..
सोत्कण्ठः षण्मुखो जातो द्वादशाक्षभुजस्तथा .. 4 ..
5.71.m: Mahāsena also, seeing those mothers who had arrived, / became six-faced, longing [for them], and likewise with twelve eyes and arms.

5.71.s:
ekaikasyāḥ pṛthaktena prapapau prayataḥ stanam ..
dvābhyāmāliṃgayāmāsa bhujābhyāṃ snehapūrvakam.. 5 ..
5.71.d:
एकैकस्याः पृथक्तेन प्रपपौ प्रयतः स्तनम् ..
द्वाभ्यामालिंगयामास भुजाभ्यां स्नेहपूर्वकम्.. 5 ..
5.71.m: With effort, he drank from the breast of each one individually; / with two arms he embraced each of them with affection.

5.71.s:
etasminnaṃtare prāptā brahmaviṣṇuśivādayaḥ ..
sarve devāḥ sahendreṇa gandharvāpsarasastathā .. 6 ..
5.71.d:
एतस्मिन्नंतरे प्राप्ता ब्रह्मविष्णुशिवादयः ..
सर्वे देवाः सहेन्द्रेण गन्धर्वाप्सरसस्तथा .. 6 ..
5.71.m: Meanwhile, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Śiva, and the others arrived, / all the gods along with Indra, as well as gandharvas and apsarases.

5.71.s:
mahotsavo'tha saṃjajñe tasminsthāne nirargalaḥ ..
gītavādyapraṇādena yenaviśvaṃ prapūritam .. 7 ..
5.71.d:
महोत्सवोऽथ संजज्ञे तस्मिन्स्थाने निरर्गलः ..
गीतवाद्यप्रणादेन येनविश्वं प्रपूरितम् .. 7 ..
5.71.m: Then an unhindered great festival took place in that spot, / by the resounding roar of songs and musical instruments with which the universe was filled.

5.71.s:
raṃbhādyā nanṛtustasya vilāsinyo divaukasām ..
jaguśca mukhyagandharvā ścitrāṃgadamukhāśca ye .. 8 ..
5.71.d:
रंभाद्या ननृतुस्तस्य विलासिन्यो दिवौकसाम् ..
जगुश्च मुख्यगन्धर्वा श्चित्रांगदमुखाश्च ये .. 8 ..
5.71.m: The playful women of the gods, headed by Rambhā, danced for him, / and the foremost gandharvas, who were led by Citrāṅgada, sang.

5.71.s:
tatastu devatāḥ sarvāstasya nāma pracakrire ..
skandanādretaso bhūmau skanda ityeva sādaram .. 9 ..
5.71.d:
ततस्तु देवताः सर्वास्तस्य नाम प्रचक्रिरे ..
स्कन्दनाद्रेतसो भूमौ स्कन्द इत्येव सादरम् .. 9 ..
5.71.m: Then all the deities respectfully gave him the name / "Skanda," because of the spilling (skandana) of the semen upon the ground.

5.71.s:
atha tasya kumā rasya tadā tatrābhiṣecanam ..
senāpatyaṃ kṛtaṃ sākṣāddevānāṃ śaṃbhunā svayam .. 6.71.10 ..
5.71.d:
अथ तस्य कुमा रस्य तदा तत्राभिषेचनम् ..
सेनापत्यं कृतं साक्षाद्देवानां शंभुना स्वयम् .. 6.71.10 ..
5.71.m: Then the consecration of that boy to the commandership-in-chief / of the gods was performed directly by Śambhu himself there at that time.

5.71.s:
tasya śaktiḥ svayaṃ dattā vidhinā'dbhutadarśanā ..
amoghā vijayārthāya daityapakṣakṣayāya ca .. 11 ..
5.71.d:
तस्य शक्तिः स्वयं दत्ता विधिनाऽद्भुतदर्शना ..
अमोघा विजयार्थाय दैत्यपक्षक्षयाय च .. 11 ..
5.71.m: A spear of wondrous appearance was given to him by Brahmā himself, / unfailing, for the sake of victory and the destruction of the faction of Daityas.

5.71.s:
mayūro vāhanārthāya tryaṃbakeṇa suśīghrataḥ ..
divyāstrāṇi mahendreṇa viṣṇunātha mahātmanā .. 12 ..
5.71.d:
मयूरो वाहनार्थाय त्र्यंबकेण सुशीघ्रतः ..
दिव्यास्त्राणि महेन्द्रेण विष्णुनाथ महात्मना .. 12 ..
5.71.m: A peacock for a mount was swiftly [given] by Tryambaka, / and divine weapons by great Indra and by the high-souled Viṣṇu.

5.71.s:
tato'bhīṣṭāni śastrāṇi devaiḥ sarvaiḥ pṛthakpṛthak ..
tasya dattāni saṃtuṣṭaistathā mātṛgaṇairapi .. 13 ..
5.71.d:
ततोऽभीष्टानि शस्त्राणि देवैः सर्वैः पृथक्पृथक् ..
तस्य दत्तानि संतुष्टैस्तथा मातृगणैरपि .. 13 ..
5.71.m: Then desired weapons were given to him individually by all the delighted gods, / and likewise by the host of mothers.

5.71.s:
tatastamagrataḥ kṛtvā senānāthaṃ sureśvarāḥ ..
jagmuḥ sasainikāstatra tārako yatra saṃsthitaḥ .. 14 ..
5.71.d:
ततस्तमग्रतः कृत्वा सेनानाथं सुरेश्वराः ..
जग्मुः ससैनिकास्तत्र तारको यत्र संस्थितः .. 14 ..
5.71.m: Then, placing that army commander at their head, the lords of the gods / went with their soldiers to the place where Tāraka stood.

5.71.s:
tārako'pi samālokya devānsvayamupāgatān ..
yuddhārthaṃ harṣasaṃyuktaḥ sammukhaḥ satvaraṃ yayau .. 15 ..
5.71.d:
तारकोऽपि समालोक्य देवान्स्वयमुपागतान् ..
युद्धार्थं हर्षसंयुक्तः सम्मुखः सत्वरं ययौ .. 15 ..
5.71.m: And Tāraka, seeing that the gods had arrived of their own accord, / went quickly to meet them, filled with delight for battle.

5.71.s:
tato'bhūtsumahadyuddhaṃ devānāṃ dānavaiḥ saha ..
kopasaṃraktanetrāṇāṃ mṛtyuṃ kṛtvā nivartanam .. 16 ..
5.71.d:
ततोऽभूत्सुमहद्युद्धं देवानां दानवैः सह ..
कोपसंरक्तनेत्राणां मृत्युं कृत्वा निवर्तनम् .. 16 ..
5.71.m: Then a very great battle took place between the gods and the Dānavas, / whose eyes were reddened with rage, turning back only upon death.

5.71.s:
atha skandena saṃvīkṣya dūrasthaṃ tārakaṃ raṇe ..
samāhūya tato muktā sā śaktistasya mṛtyave .. 17 ..
5.71.d:
अथ स्कन्देन संवीक्ष्य दूरस्थं तारकं रणे ..
समाहूय ततो मुक्ता सा शक्तिस्तस्य मृत्यवे .. 17 ..
5.71.m: Then Skanda, beholding Tāraka standing afar in battle, / challenged him and released that spear for his death.

5.71.s:
athāsau hṛdayaṃ bhittvā tasya daityasya dāruṇā ..
camatkārapuropāṃte patitā rudhirokṣitā .. 18 ..
5.71.d:
अथासौ हृदयं भित्त्वा तस्य दैत्यस्य दारुणा ..
चमत्कारपुरोपांते पतिता रुधिरोक्षिता .. 18 ..
5.71.m: Then, having pierced the heart of that demon, it fell, / terrible and drenched in blood, near the city of Camatkārapura.

5.71.s:
tārakastu gato nāśaṃ muktaḥ prāṇaiśca tatkṣaṇāt ..
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve saṃhṛṣṭāstaṃ mahābalam .. 19 ..
5.71.d:
तारकस्तु गतो नाशं मुक्तः प्राणैश्च तत्क्षणात् ..
ततो देवगणाः सर्वे संहृष्टास्तं महाबलम् .. 19 ..
5.71.m: And Tāraka met his destruction, bereft of life at that very moment. / Thereupon all the hosts of gods were overjoyed, and praising that mighty one

5.71.s:
stotrairbahuvidhaiḥ stutvā procustasminhate sati ..
gatāśca tridivaṃ tūrṇaṃ saha śakreṇa nirbhayāḥ .1 6.71.20 ..
5.71.d:
स्तोत्रैर्बहुविधैः स्तुत्वा प्रोचुस्तस्मिन्हते सति ..
गताश्च त्रिदिवं तूर्णं सह शक्रेण निर्भयाः .1 6.71.20 ..
5.71.m: with manifold hymns, spoke once he was slain, / and together with Śakra they went swiftly to heaven, free from fear.

5.71.s:
skando'pi tāṃ samādāya śaktiṃ tatra purottame ..
sthāpayāmāsa yenaiva raktaśṛṃgo'bhavaddṛḍhaḥ .. .. 21 ..
5.71.d:
स्कन्दोऽपि तां समादाय शक्तिं तत्र पुरोत्तमे ..
स्थापयामास येनैव रक्तशृंगोऽभवद्दृढः .. .. 21 ..
5.71.m: Skanda too, taking up that spear in that excellent city, / installed it, by which very act Raktaśṛṅga was made firm.

5.71.s:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
raktaśṛṃgaḥ kathaṃ tena niścalo'pi dṛḍhīkṛtaḥ ..
kasya vākyena no brūhi vistareṇa mahāmate .. 22 ..
5.71.d:
ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
रक्तशृंगः कथं तेन निश्चलोऽपि दृढीकृतः ..
कस्य वाक्येन नो ब्रूहि विस्तरेण महामते .. 22 ..
5.71.m: The seers said: / How was Raktaśṛṅga, even though motionless, made firm by him? / At whose word? Tell us in detail, O highly intelligent one!

5.71.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
yadā vai bhūmikampastu saṃprajātaḥ sudāruṇaḥ ..
raktaśṛṅgaḥ pracalitaḥ svasthānādativegataḥ .. 23 ..
5.71.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
यदा वै भूमिकम्पस्तु संप्रजातः सुदारुणः ..
रक्तशृङ्गः प्रचलितः स्वस्थानादतिवेगतः .. 23 ..
5.71.m: Sūta said: / When a very terrible earthquake occurred, / Raktaśṛṅga was displaced from its position with great speed,

5.71.s:
tasya daityasya pātena yathānye parva tottamāḥ ..
atha harmyāṇi sarvāṇi camatkārapure tadā .. 24 ..
5.71.d:
तस्य दैत्यस्य पातेन यथान्ये पर्व तोत्तमाः ..
अथ हर्म्याणि सर्वाणि चमत्कारपुरे तदा .. 24 ..
5.71.m: by the fall of that demon, just like other excellent mountains. / Then all the mansions in Camatkārapura at that time

5.71.s:
śīrṇāni calite tasminparvate vyathitā dvijāḥ ..
prāyaśo nidhanaṃ prāptāstathā'nye mūrchayārditāḥ .. 25 ..
5.71.d:
शीर्णानि चलिते तस्मिन्पर्वते व्यथिता द्विजाः ..
प्रायशो निधनं प्राप्तास्तथाऽन्ये मूर्छयार्दिताः .. 25 ..
5.71.m: were shattered when that mountain shook; the twice-born were distressed, / for the most part met their death, and others were afflicted by unconsciousness.

5.71.s:
hataśeṣāstato viprā gatvā skandaṃ krudhānvitāḥ ..
procuśca kimidaṃ pāpa tvayā kṛtamabuddhinā .. 26 ..
5.71.d:
हतशेषास्ततो विप्रा गत्वा स्कन्दं क्रुधान्विताः ..
प्रोचुश्च किमिदं पाप त्वया कृतमबुद्धिना .. 26 ..
5.71.m: Then the surviving brahmins, going to Skanda filled with wrath, / said: What is this sin done by you, lacking in wisdom?

5.71.s:
nāśaṃ nītā vayaṃ sarve saputrapaśubādhavāḥ ..
tasmācchāpaṃ pradāsyāmo vayaṃ duḥkhena duḥkhitāḥ .. 27 ..
5.71.d:
नाशं नीता वयं सर्वे सपुत्रपशुबाधवाः ..
तस्माच्छापं प्रदास्यामो वयं दुःखेन दुःखिताः .. 27 ..
5.71.m: We have all been brought to ruin along with our sons, cattle, and kinsmen. / Therefore, stricken with sorrow, we shall pronounce a curse!

5.71.s:
.. skanda uvāca .. ..
hitāya sarvalokānāṃ mayaitatsamanuṣṭhitam ..
yaddhato dānavo raudro nānyathā dvijasattamāḥ .. 28 ..
5.71.d:
.. स्कन्द उवाच .. ..
हिताय सर्वलोकानां मयैतत्समनुष्ठितम् ..
यद्धतो दानवो रौद्रो नान्यथा द्विजसत्तमाः .. 28 ..
5.71.m: Skanda said: / This was undertaken by me for the welfare of all the worlds, / because the fierce Dānava was slain; not otherwise, O best of the twice-born!

5.71.s:
prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ tasmānmānyā me brāhmaṇāḥ sadā ..
mṛtānapi dvijānsarvānahaṃ tānamṛtāśrayāt.. 29 ..
5.71.d:
प्रसादः क्रियतां तस्मान्मान्या मे ब्राह्मणाः सदा ..
मृतानपि द्विजान्सर्वानहं तानमृताश्रयात्.. 29 ..
5.71.m: Therefore grant your favor, for brahmins are ever worthy of my honor. / Even all the dead twice-born, through the resort of nectar,

5.71.s:
punarjīvitasaṃyuktānkariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ ..
tathā suniścalaṃ śailaṃ kariṣyāmi svaśaktitaḥ .. 6.71.30 ..
5.71.d:
पुनर्जीवितसंयुक्तान्करिष्यामि न संशयः ..
तथा सुनिश्चलं शैलं करिष्यामि स्वशक्तितः .. 6.71.30 ..
5.71.m: I will restore to life again, no doubt; / likewise, I will make the mountain completely steady by my own power.

5.71.s:
evamuktvā samādāya tāṃ śaktiṃ rudhirokṣitām ..
cakre sthāpanamasyāstu raktaśṛṅgasya mūrdhani .. 31 ..
5.71.d:
एवमुक्त्वा समादाय तां शक्तिं रुधिरोक्षिताम् ..
चक्रे स्थापनमस्यास्तु रक्तशृङ्गस्य मूर्धनि .. 31 ..
5.71.m: Having spoken thus and taken that spear drenched in blood, / he performed its installation upon the crest of Raktaśṛṅga.

5.71.s:
tataḥ provāca saṃhṛṣṭo devatānāṃ catuṣṭayam ..
āṃbavṛddhāṃ tathaivāmrāṃ māhitthāṃ ca camatkarīm .. 32 ..
5.71.d:
ततः प्रोवाच संहृष्टो देवतानां चतुष्टयम् ..
आंबवृद्धां तथैवाम्रां माहित्थां च चमत्करीम् .. 32 ..
5.71.m: Then, delighted, he addressed the four goddesses: / Ambāvṛddhā, Amrā, Māhitthā, and Camatkarī:

5.71.s:
yuṣmābhirniścalaḥ kāryo bhūyo'yaṃ nagasattamaḥ ..
pralaye'pi yathā sthānādraktaśṛṅgaścalennahi .. 33 ..
sadaiva khyātimāyātu mannāmnā puramuttamam..32..
5.71.d:
युष्माभिर्निश्चलः कार्यो भूयोऽयं नगसत्तमः ..
प्रलयेऽपि यथा स्थानाद्रक्तशृङ्गश्चलेन्नहि .. 33 ..
सदैव ख्यातिमायातु मन्नाम्ना पुरमुत्तमम्..32..
5.71.m:
This best of mountains must be made motionless once more by you, / so that even at the dissolution of the world Raktaśṛṅga will not move from its place.
May this excellent city ever become famous by my name!

5.71.s: yuṣmākaṃ brāhmaṇāḥ sarve pūjāṃ dāsyaṃti sarvadā..34..
5.71.d: युष्माकं ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे पूजां दास्यंति सर्वदा..34..
5.71.m: All the brahmins will always offer worship to you.

5.71.s:
bāḍhamityeva tāḥ procya caturdikṣu tataśca tam..
śūlāgraiḥ sudṛḍhaṃ cakruḥ skandavākyena harṣitāḥ..
tataścāmṛtamādāya mṛtānapi dvijottamān..
skando jīvāpayāmāsa dvijabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ..36..
5.71.d:
बाढमित्येव ताः प्रोच्य चतुर्दिक्षु ततश्च तम्..
शूलाग्रैः सुदृढं चक्रुः स्कन्दवाक्येन हर्षिताः..
ततश्चामृतमादाय मृतानपि द्विजोत्तमान्..
स्कन्दो जीवापयामास द्विजभक्तिपरायणः..36..
5.71.m: Saying 'So be it,' and delighted by Skanda's word, they made it / exceedingly firm in the four directions with the tips of their tridents. / Then, taking nectar, Skanda, devoted to honoring the twice-born, / revived even the dead, best of the twice-born.

5.71.s:
tataste brāhmaṇāstatra saṃhṛṣṭā varamuttamam ..
dadustasya sa ca prāha mannāmaitatpurottamam ..
sadaiva khyātimāyātu etanme hṛdi vāṃchitam .. 37 ..
5.71.d:
ततस्ते ब्राह्मणास्तत्र संहृष्टा वरमुत्तमम् ..
ददुस्तस्य स च प्राह मन्नामैतत्पुरोत्तमम् ..
सदैव ख्यातिमायातु एतन्मे हृदि वांछितम् .. 37 ..
5.71.m: Then those brahmins there, overjoyed, gave him an excellent boon, / and he said: May this excellent city ever become famous by my name! / This is desired in my heart.

5.71.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
etatskandapuraṃnāma tava nāmnā bhaviṣyati ..
camatkārapuraṃ tadvatsāṃprataṃ surasattama .. 38 ..
5.71.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
एतत्स्कन्दपुरंनाम तव नाम्ना भविष्यति ..
चमत्कारपुरं तद्वत्सांप्रतं सुरसत्तम .. 38 ..
5.71.m: The seers said: / This will be called Skandapura after your name, / as well as Camatkārapura, O best of gods, right now.

5.71.s:
pūjāṃ tava kariṣyāmaḥ kṛtvā prāsādamutta mam ..
tathaiva devatāḥ sarvāścatasro'pi tvayā dhṛtāḥ .. 39 ..
5.71.d:
पूजां तव करिष्यामः कृत्वा प्रासादमुत्त मम् ..
तथैव देवताः सर्वाश्चतस्रोऽपि त्वया धृताः .. 39 ..
5.71.m: Having constructed an excellent temple, we shall perform worship to you, / and likewise to all the four goddesses sustained by you.

5.71.s:
sarvāḥ saṃpūjayiṣyāmaḥ sarvakṛtyeṣu sādaram..
etāṃ caṃ tāvakīṃ śaktiṃ sadā suravarottama ..
viśeṣātpūjayiṣyāmaḥ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ śraddhāsamanvitāḥ .. 6.71.40 ..
5.71.d:
सर्वाः संपूजयिष्यामः सर्वकृत्येषु सादरम्..
एतां चं तावकीं शक्तिं सदा सुरवरोत्तम ..
विशेषात्पूजयिष्यामः षष्ठ्यां श्रद्धासमन्विताः .. 6.71.40 ..
5.71.m: We shall respectfully worship all of them in every rite. / And this spear of yours, O best of the foremost gods, / we shall especially worship with faith on the sixth lunar day.

5.71.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ sa brāhmaṇaiḥ prokto mahāseno mahābalaḥ ..
sthitastatraiva tadvā kyājjñātvā tatkṣetramuttamam .. 41 ..
5.71.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं स ब्राह्मणैः प्रोक्तो महासेनो महाबलः ..
स्थितस्तत्रैव तद्वा क्याज्ज्ञात्वा तत्क्षेत्रमुत्तमम् .. 41 ..
5.71.m: Sūta said: / Thus addressed by the brahmins, the mighty Mahāsena / remained right there according to their word, knowing that to be an excellent sacred field.

5.71.s:
yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā caitraṣaṣṭhyāṃ subhāvataḥ ..
śuklāyāṃ tasya saṃtuṣṭiṃ kurute barhivāhanaḥ .. 42 ..
5.71.d:
यस्तं पूजयते भक्त्या चैत्रषष्ठ्यां सुभावतः ..
शुक्लायां तस्य संतुष्टिं कुरुते बर्हिवाहनः .. 42 ..
5.71.m: Whoever worships him with devotion and pure intention on the sixth day / of the bright fortnight of Caitra, the one who rides the peacock brings him contentment.

5.71.s:
tasyāṃ śaktau naro yaśca kuryātpṛṣṭhinigharṣaṇam..
pūjayitvā tu puṣpādyaiḥ samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ ..
sa na syādrogasaṃyukto yāvatsaṃvatsaraṃ dvijāḥ .. 43 ..
5.71.d:
तस्यां शक्तौ नरो यश्च कुर्यात्पृष्ठिनिघर्षणम्..
पूजयित्वा तु पुष्पाद्यैः सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमन्वितः ..
स न स्याद्रोगसंयुक्तो यावत्संवत्सरं द्विजाः .. 43 ..
5.71.m: And whatever man should rub his back against that spear, / having worshipped it with flowers and the like, endowed with proper faith, / he will not be afflicted with illness for a whole year, O twice-born.

5.71.s:
evaṃ tatra dhṛtā śaktistena skandena dhīmatā ..
raktaśṛṃgasya rakṣārthaṃ tatpurasya viśeṣataḥ .. 44 ..
5.71.d:
एवं तत्र धृता शक्तिस्तेन स्कन्देन धीमता ..
रक्तशृंगस्य रक्षार्थं तत्पुरस्य विशेषतः .. 44 ..
5.71.m: Thus was the spear installed there by the wise Skanda, / for the protection of Raktaśṛṅga, and especially of that city.

5.71.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye skandasthāpitaśaktimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 71 .. .. dha ..
5.71.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये स्कन्दस्थापितशक्तिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः .. 71 .. .. ध ..
5.71.m: Thus ends the seventy-first chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of the Spear Installed by Skanda,' in the glorification of the sacred field of Hāṭakeśvara, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection in the glorious Skandapurāṇa.

5.72.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tatraiva sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭreṇa bhūbhujā ..
duryodhanena cālokya sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 1 ..
5.72.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तत्रैव स्थापितं लिंगं धृतराष्ट्रेण भूभुजा ..
दुर्योधनेन चालोक्य सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते .. 1 ..
5.72.m: Sūta said: / Right there a liṅga was installed by King Dhṛtarāṣṭra / and Duryodhana; by beholding it one is freed from all sins.

5.72.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
kasminkāle narendreṇa dhṛtarāṣṭreṇa bhūbhujā ..
tatra saṃsthāpitaṃ ligaṃ vada tvaṃ raumaharṣaṇe .. 2 ..
5.72.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
कस्मिन्काले नरेन्द्रेण धृतराष्ट्रेण भूभुजा ..
तत्र संस्थापितं लिगं वद त्वं रौमहर्षणे .. 2 ..
5.72.m: The seers said: / At what time was the liṅga installed there / by King Dhṛtarāṣṭra, the ruler of men? Tell us, O son of Romaharṣaṇa!

5.72.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
āsīdbhānumatīnāma balabhadrasutā purā ..
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannā rūpau dāryaguṇānvitā .. 3 ..
5.72.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
आसीद्भानुमतीनाम बलभद्रसुता पुरा ..
सर्वलक्षणसंपन्ना रूपौ दार्यगुणान्विता .. 3 ..
5.72.m: Sūta said: / Formerly there was a daughter of Balabhadra named Bhānumatī, / endowed with all auspicious marks and possessing the virtues of beauty and generosity.

5.72.s:
tāṃ dadāvatha patnyarthe dhārtarāṣṭrāya dhīmate ..
duryodhanāya saṃmantrya viṣṇunā saha yādavaḥ .. 4 ..
5.72.d:
तां ददावथ पत्न्यर्थे धार्तराष्ट्राय धीमते ..
दुर्योधनाय संमन्त्र्य विष्णुना सह यादवः .. 4 ..
5.72.m: Then, having consulted with Viṣṇu, that Yādava gave her / as a wife to the wise son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra, Duryodhana.

5.72.s:
atha nāgapurātsarve bhīṣma droṇādayaśca ye ..
kauravāḥ prasthitāstūrṇaṃ purīṃ dvāravatīṃ prati ..5..
5.72.d:
अथ नागपुरात्सर्वे भीष्म द्रोणादयश्च ये ..
कौरवाः प्रस्थितास्तूर्णं पुरीं द्वारवतीं प्रति ..5..
5.72.m: Then all the Kauravas from Nāgapura, headed by Bhīṣma and Droṇa, / set out swiftly toward the city of Dvāravatī.

5.72.s:
tathā pāṃḍusutāḥ paṃca parivārasamanvitāḥ..
saubhrātraṃ manyamānāste duryodhanasamanvi tāḥ ..
jagmurdvāravatīṃ hṛṣṭāḥ sainyena mahatānvitāḥ ..6..
5.72.d:
तथा पांडुसुताः पंच परिवारसमन्विताः..
सौभ्रात्रं मन्यमानास्ते दुर्योधनसमन्वि ताः ..
जग्मुर्द्वारवतीं हृष्टाः सैन्येन महतान्विताः ..6..
5.72.m: Likewise the five sons of Pāṇḍu, accompanied by their retinue, / regarding good brotherhood, joined with Duryodhana / and went, rejoiced, toward Dvāravatī, accompanied by a great army.

5.72.s:
atha krameṇa gacchaṃtaste sarve kurupāṇḍavāḥ ..
ānartaviṣayaṃ prāptā dhanadhānyasamākulam ..7..
5.72.d:
अथ क्रमेण गच्छंतस्ते सर्वे कुरुपाण्डवाः ..
आनर्तविषयं प्राप्ता धनधान्यसमाकुलम् ..7..
5.72.m: Then, proceeding in due course, all those Kurus and Pāṇḍavas / reached the Ānarta country, which was filled with wealth and grain,

5.72.s:
sarvapāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ yatra tatkṣetramuttamam..
hāṭakeśvaradevasya vikhyātaṃ bhuvanatraye .. 8 ..
5.72.d:
सर्वपापहरं पुण्यं यत्र तत्क्षेत्रमुत्तमम्..
हाटकेश्वरदेवस्य विख्यातं भुवनत्रये .. 8 ..
5.72.m: which removes all sins, is holy, and where lies that excellent sacred field / of the god Hāṭakeśvara, renowned throughout the three worlds.

5.72.s:
atha prāha viśuddhātmā vṛddhaḥ kurupitāmahaḥ ..
dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ mahīpālaṃ saputraṃ prahasanniva .. 9 ..
5.72.d:
अथ प्राह विशुद्धात्मा वृद्धः कुरुपितामहः ..
धृतराष्ट्रं महीपालं सपुत्रं प्रहसन्निव .. 9 ..
5.72.m: Then the pure-minded elder, the grandfather of the Kurus, / addressed King Dhṛtarāṣṭra along with his sons, smiling as it were: 9

5.72.s:
.. bhīṣma uvāca .. ..
etadvatsa purā dṛṣṭaṃ mayā kṣetramanuttamam..
hāṭakeśvaradevasya sarvapātakanāśanam .. 6.72.10 ..
5.72.d:
.. भीष्म उवाच .. ..
एतद्वत्स पुरा दृष्टं मया क्षेत्रमनुत्तमम्..
हाटकेश्वरदेवस्य सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 6.72.10 ..
5.72.m: Bhīṣma said: / "Child, previously I saw this unequalled sacred field / of the god Hāṭakeśvara, which destroys all sins. 10

5.72.s:
atrāhaṃ caiva ni rmuktaḥ strīhatyodbhavapātakāt ..
tasmādatraiva rājeṃdra tiṣṭhāmaḥ paṃcavāsarān ..11..
5.72.d:
अत्राहं चैव नि र्मुक्तः स्त्रीहत्योद्भवपातकात् ..
तस्मादत्रैव राजेंद्र तिष्ठामः पंचवासरान् ..11..
5.72.m: And here I was freed from the sin arising from the murder of a woman. / Therefore, O king of kings, let us stay right here for five days, 11

5.72.s:
yena sarvāṇi paśyāmastīrthānyāyatanāni ca..
yānyatra saṃti puṇyāni munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām ..12..
5.72.d:
येन सर्वाणि पश्यामस्तीर्थान्यायतनानि च..
यान्यत्र संति पुण्यानि मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम् ..12..
5.72.m: so that we may see all the sacred fords and temples / of the sages of cultivated minds that exist here as sacred sites." 12

5.72.s:
atha tadvacanādrājā dhṛtarāṣṭroṃ'bikāsutaḥ ..
śatasaṃkhyaiḥ sutaiḥ sārdhaṃ kautūhalasamanvitaḥ ..13..
5.72.d:
अथ तद्वचनाद्राजा धृतराष्ट्रोंऽबिकासुतः ..
शतसंख्यैः सुतैः सार्धं कौतूहलसमन्वितः ..13..
5.72.m: Then, at his word, King Dhṛtarāṣṭra, the son of Ambikā, / filled with curiosity together with his one hundred sons, 13

5.72.s:
jagāma satvaraṃ tatra yatra tatkṣetramuttamam ..
tapasvigaṇasaṃkīrṇaṃ yuktaṃ caivāśramaiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 14 ..
5.72.d:
जगाम सत्वरं तत्र यत्र तत्क्षेत्रमुत्तमम् ..
तपस्विगणसंकीर्णं युक्तं चैवाश्रमैः शुभैः .. 14 ..
5.72.m: went swiftly to where that excellent sacred field was, / crowded with hosts of ascetics and endowed with auspicious hermitages, 14

5.72.s:
brahmaghoṣeṇa mahatā nāditaṃ sarvatodiśam ..
vahnipūjotthadhūmreṇa kaluṣīkṛtapāda pam ..
krīḍāmṛgaiśca saṃkīrṇaṃ dhāvadbhirbahubhistathā .. 15 ..
5.72.d:
ब्रह्मघोषेण महता नादितं सर्वतोदिशम् ..
वह्निपूजोत्थधूम्रेण कलुषीकृतपाद पम् ..
क्रीडामृगैश्च संकीर्णं धावद्भिर्बहुभिस्तथा .. 15 ..
5.72.m: resounding on every side with the great sound of the Vedas, / its trees darkened by the smoke arising from fire worship, / and crowded with many running pet deer. 15

5.72.s:
tato nivārya sainyaṃ svamupadravabhayānnṛpaḥ ..
pañcabhiḥ pāṃḍavaiḥ sārdhaṃ śatasaṃkhyaistathā sutaiḥ .. .. 16 ..
5.72.d:
ततो निवार्य सैन्यं स्वमुपद्रवभयान्नृपः ..
पञ्चभिः पांडवैः सार्धं शतसंख्यैस्तथा सुतैः .. .. 16 ..
5.72.m: Then, having halted his army out of fear of causing disturbance, the king, / accompanied by the five Pāṇḍavas and likewise his one hundred sons, 16

5.72.s:
bhīṣmeṇa somadattena bāhlīkena samanvitaḥ..
droṇācāryeṇa vīreṇa tatputreṇa kṛpeṇa ca ..17..
5.72.d:
भीष्मेण सोमदत्तेन बाह्लीकेन समन्वितः..
द्रोणाचार्येण वीरेण तत्पुत्रेण कृपेण च ..17..
5.72.m: joined by Bhīṣma, Somadatta, Bāhlīka, / heroic Droṇācārya, his son, and Kṛpa, 17

5.72.s:
saubalena ca karṇena tathānyairapi pārthivaiḥ..
parivāraparityaktaistasminkṣetre cacāra saḥ .. 18 ..
5.72.d:
सौबलेन च कर्णेन तथान्यैरपि पार्थिवैः..
परिवारपरित्यक्तैस्तस्मिन्क्षेत्रे चचार सः .. 18 ..
5.72.m: and by Śakuni, Karṇa, and other kings, / leaving behind his retinue, walked through that sacred field. 18

5.72.s:
te'pi sarve mahātmānaḥ kṣatriyāstatra saṃsthitāḥ ..
cakrurdharmakriyāḥ sarvāḥ śraddhāpūtena cetasā .. 19 ..
5.72.d:
तेऽपि सर्वे महात्मानः क्षत्रियास्तत्र संस्थिताः ..
चक्रुर्धर्मक्रियाः सर्वाः श्रद्धापूतेन चेतसा .. 19 ..
5.72.m: All those noble kṣatriyas stationed there / performed all righteous rites with minds purified by faith. 19

5.72.s:
snānaṃ cakrurvidhānena tīrtheṣu dvijasattamāḥ ..
bhrāṃtvābhrāṃtvā supuṇyeṣu śrutvāśrutvā dvijanmanām .. 6.72.20 ..
5.72.d:
स्नानं चक्रुर्विधानेन तीर्थेषु द्विजसत्तमाः ..
भ्रांत्वाभ्रांत्वा सुपुण्येषु श्रुत्वाश्रुत्वा द्विजन्मनाम् .. 6.72.20 ..
5.72.m: O best of brahmins, they performed ritual ablution according to rule in the sacred fords, / having wandered again and again through the very holy [places], having listened again and again to the twice-born. 20

5.72.s:
dānāni ca viśiṣṭāni daduriṣṭāni cāpare ..
dīnebhyaḥ kṛpaṇebhyaśca tapasvibhyo viśeṣataḥ .. 21 ..
5.72.d:
दानानि च विशिष्टानि ददुरिष्टानि चापरे ..
दीनेभ्यः कृपणेभ्यश्च तपस्विभ्यो विशेषतः .. 21 ..
5.72.m: And others gave distinguished and desired gifts / to the poor, the wretched, and especially to ascetics. 21

5.72.s:
cakruḥ śrāddhakriyāścānye pitṝnuddiśya bhaktitaḥ ..
pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ cānye tilamiśra jalena ca .. 22 ..
5.72.d:
चक्रुः श्राद्धक्रियाश्चान्ये पितॄनुद्दिश्य भक्तितः ..
पितॄणां तर्पणं चान्ये तिलमिश्र जलेन च .. 22 ..
5.72.m: Others performed śrāddha rites dedicated to the ancestors with devotion, / and others offered tarpaṇa to the ancestors with water mixed with sesame seeds. 22

5.72.s:
anye homakriyā bhūpā japamanye nirargalam ..
svādhyāyamapare śāntāḥ samyakchraddhāsamanvitāḥ .. 23 ..
5.72.d:
अन्ये होमक्रिया भूपा जपमन्ये निरर्गलम् ..
स्वाध्यायमपरे शान्ताः सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमन्विताः .. 23 ..
5.72.m: Other kings performed fire oblations; others, uninterrupted recitation of mantras; / other tranquil ones, completely endowed with faith, engaged in personal study of the Vedas. 23

5.72.s:
devatāyatanānyanye māhātmyasahitāni ca ..
śrutvā pūrvanṛpāṇāṃ ca pūjayaṃti viśeṣataḥ .. 24 ..
5.72.d:
देवतायतनान्यन्ये माहात्म्यसहितानि च ..
श्रुत्वा पूर्वनृपाणां च पूजयंति विशेषतः .. 24 ..
5.72.m: Others, having heard the temples of the deities along with their māhātmyas, / and [those] of former kings, worshipped them especially, 24

5.72.s:
balidānaiḥ suvastraiśca gandhapuṣpopalepanaiḥ ..
mārjanaidhvajadānaiśca tathā prekṣaṇakaiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 25 ..
5.72.d:
बलिदानैः सुवस्त्रैश्च गन्धपुष्पोपलेपनैः ..
मार्जनैध्वजदानैश्च तथा प्रेक्षणकैः शुभैः .. 25 ..
5.72.m: with offerings of food, fine clothes, fragrant substances, flowers, ointments, / sweeping, gifts of flags, and auspicious theatrical spectacles, 25

5.72.s:
maṃḍanaiḥ puṣpamālābhiḥ samaṃtāddvijasattamāḥ ..
hastyaśvarathadānaiśca gorbhirvastraiśca kāṃcanaiḥ ..
kṛtārthā brāhmaṇāḥ sarve kṛtāstai statra bhaktitaḥ .. 26 ..
5.72.d:
मंडनैः पुष्पमालाभिः समंताद्द्विजसत्तमाः ..
हस्त्यश्वरथदानैश्च गोर्भिर्वस्त्रैश्च कांचनैः ..
कृतार्था ब्राह्मणाः सर्वे कृतास्तै स्तत्र भक्तितः .. 26 ..
5.72.m: with decorations and flower garlands all around, O best of brahmins! / And all the brahmins were made content by them there with devotion / through gifts of elephants, horses, chariots, cattle, garments, and gold. 26

5.72.s:
evaṃ snātvā tathā'bhyarcya devānviprānnṛpottamāḥ ..
dhṛtarāṣṭrasamāyuktā jagmuḥ svaśibiraṃ tataḥ .. 27 ..
5.72.d:
एवं स्नात्वा तथाऽभ्यर्च्य देवान्विप्रान्नृपोत्तमाः ..
धृतराष्ट्रसमायुक्ता जग्मुः स्वशिबिरं ततः .. 27 ..
5.72.m: Having thus bathed and worshipped the gods and the brahmins, / the excellent kings, accompanied by Dhṛtarāṣṭra, then went to their camp, 27

5.72.s:
śaṃsanto vismayā viṣṭāstīrthānyāyatanāni ca ..
tasminkṣetre dvijāṃścaiva tāpasānsaṃśitavratān .. 28 ..
5.72.d:
शंसन्तो विस्मया विष्टास्तीर्थान्यायतनानि च ..
तस्मिन्क्षेत्रे द्विजांश्चैव तापसान्संशितव्रतान् .. 28 ..
5.72.m: filled with wonder, praising the sacred fords and temples, / and the brahmins and ascetics of strict vows in that sacred field. 28

5.72.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṃḍe śrīhāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye dhṛtarāṣṭrādikṛtahāṭakeśvarakṣetradarśanavarṇanaṃnāma dvisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 72 .. .. cha ..
5.72.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखंडे श्रीहाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये धृतराष्ट्रादिकृतहाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रदर्शनवर्णनंनाम द्विसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः .. 72 .. .. छ ..
5.72.m: Thus ends the seventy-second chapter, titled "Description of the Darśana of the Sacred Field of Hāṭakeśvara by Dhṛtarāṣṭra and Others," in the Māhātmya of the Sacred Field of Śrī Hāṭakeśvara in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, in the sixth [part] of the Śrī Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, in the collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. 72.

5.73.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
evaṃ te kauravāḥ sarve pāṃḍoḥ putrāśca śālinaḥ ..
tasmātsthānāttato jagmuryatra dvāravatī purī .. 1 ..
5.73.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एवं ते कौरवाः सर्वे पांडोः पुत्राश्च शालिनः ..
तस्मात्स्थानात्ततो जग्मुर्यत्र द्वारवती पुरी .. 1 ..
5.73.m: Sūta said: / Thus all those Kauravas and the illustrious sons of Pāṇḍu / went from that place to where the city of Dvāravatī was. 1

5.73.s:
tatra gatvā vivāhaṃ tu cakruḥ saṃhṛṣṭamānasāḥ ..
duryodhanasya bhūpasya bhānumatyā samaṃ tadā .. 2 ..
5.73.d:
तत्र गत्वा विवाहं तु चक्रुः संहृष्टमानसाः ..
दुर्योधनस्य भूपस्य भानुमत्या समं तदा .. 2 ..
5.73.m: Having gone there, with rejoiced minds they celebrated the wedding / of King Duryodhana with Bhānumatī at that time, 2

5.73.s:
nānāvāditraghoṣeṇa vedadhvaniyutena ca ..
gītairmanoharaiḥ pāṭhairbandināṃ ca sahasraśaḥ .. 3 ..
5.73.d:
नानावादित्रघोषेण वेदध्वनियुतेन च ..
गीतैर्मनोहरैः पाठैर्बन्दिनां च सहस्रशः .. 3 ..
5.73.m: with the sounding of various musical instruments, accompanied by the sound of the Vedas, / with delightful songs, and recitations by thousands of bards. 3

5.73.s:
evaṃ mahotsavo jajñe tatra yāvaddināṣṭakam ..
yādavānāṃ kurūṇāṃ ca militānāṃ parasparam .. 4 ..
5.73.d:
एवं महोत्सवो जज्ञे तत्र यावद्दिनाष्टकम् ..
यादवानां कुरूणां च मिलितानां परस्परम् .. 4 ..
5.73.m: Thus a great festival took place there for eight days, / with the Yādavas and Kurus assembled together. 4

5.73.s:
kṛtārthāstatra saṃjātāḥ sūtamāgadha bandinaḥ ..
cāraṇā brāhmaṇeṃdrāśca tathānye'pi ca tārkikāḥ .. 5 ..
5.73.d:
कृतार्थास्तत्र संजाताः सूतमागध बन्दिनः ..
चारणा ब्राह्मणेंद्राश्च तथान्येऽपि च तार्किकाः .. 5 ..
5.73.m: The bards, heralds, panegyrists, / wandering minstrels, eminent brahmins, and other logicians were made content there. 5

5.73.s:
tatastu navame prāpte divase kurupāṃḍavāḥ ..
bhīṣmādyāḥ puṃḍarīkākṣamidamūcuḥ sasauhṛ dam .. 6 ..
5.73.d:
ततस्तु नवमे प्राप्ते दिवसे कुरुपांडवाः ..
भीष्माद्याः पुंडरीकाक्षमिदमूचुः ससौहृ दम् .. 6 ..
5.73.m: Then, when the ninth day arrived, the Kurus and Pāṇḍavas, / led by Bhīṣma, affectionately said this to the lotus-eyed one: 6

5.73.s:
na vayaṃ puṃḍarīkākṣa tava rāmasya cāśrayam ..
kathaṃcittyaktumicchāmaḥ snehapāśaniyaṃtritāḥ .. 7 ..
5.73.d:
न वयं पुंडरीकाक्ष तव रामस्य चाश्रयम् ..
कथंचित्त्यक्तुमिच्छामः स्नेहपाशनियंत्रिताः .. 7 ..
5.73.m: "O lotus-eyed one, bound by the cords of affection, / we do not in any way wish to leave the shelter of you and Rāma. 7

5.73.s:
tathāpi ca pragantavyaṃ svapuraṃ prati mādha va ..
balabhadrasamāyuktastasmānnaḥ kuru mokṣaṇam .. 8 ..
5.73.d:
तथापि च प्रगन्तव्यं स्वपुरं प्रति माध व ..
बलभद्रसमायुक्तस्तस्मान्नः कुरु मोक्षणम् .. 8 ..
5.73.m: Nevertheless, O Mādhava, we must go forward to our own city; / therefore, joined with Balabhadra, grant us release." 8

5.73.s:
.. viṣṇuruvāca .. ..
na tāvadvatsaro jāto na māsaḥ pakṣa eva ca ..
sthitānāmatra yuṣmākaṃ tatkimautsukyamāgatam .. 9 ..
5.73.d:
.. विष्णुरुवाच .. ..
न तावद्वत्सरो जातो न मासः पक्ष एव च ..
स्थितानामत्र युष्माकं तत्किमौत्सुक्यमागतम् .. 9 ..
5.73.m: Viṣṇu said: / "Not a year, nor a month, nor even a fortnight has passed / since you have been staying here; so why has this eagerness [to leave] come upon you? 9

5.73.s:
tasmādatraiva tiṣṭhāmaḥ sahitāḥ kurupāṃḍavāḥ ..
yūyaṃ vayaṃ vinodena mṛgayākṣodbhavena ca .. 6.73.10 ..
5.73.d:
तस्मादत्रैव तिष्ठामः सहिताः कुरुपांडवाः ..
यूयं वयं विनोदेन मृगयाक्षोद्भवेन च .. 6.73.10 ..
5.73.m: Therefore, let us stay right here together, Kurus and Pāṇḍavas, / you and we, taking delight in hunting and playing with dice, 10

5.73.s:
śastraśikṣākriyābhiśca damanena ca dantinām ..
tathābhivāṃchitairanyaiḥ sneho'sti yadi vo mayi .. 11 ..
5.73.d:
शस्त्रशिक्षाक्रियाभिश्च दमनेन च दन्तिनाम् ..
तथाभिवांछितैरन्यैः स्नेहोऽस्ति यदि वो मयि .. 11 ..
5.73.m: in weapon-training exercises, in taming elephants, / and in other desired [pursuits], if you have affection for me." 11

5.73.s:
.. bhīṣma uvāca .. ..
upapannamidaṃ viṣṇo yattvayā vyāhṛtaṃ vacaḥ ..
paraṃ śṛṇuṣva me vākyaṃ yadarthaṃ hyutsukā vayam .. 12 ..
5.73.d:
.. भीष्म उवाच .. ..
उपपन्नमिदं विष्णो यत्त्वया व्याहृतं वचः ..
परं शृणुष्व मे वाक्यं यदर्थं ह्युत्सुका वयम् .. 12 ..
5.73.m: Bhīṣma said: / "Appropriate is this word that has been spoken by you, O Viṣṇu; / but hear my statement, on account of which indeed we are eager [to go]. 12

5.73.s:
ānartaviṣaye'smābhirāgacchadbhistavāṃtikam ..
dṛṣṭamatyadbhutaṃ kṣetraṃ hāṭakeśvarajaṃ mahat ..
tatra liṃgāni dṛṣṭāni bhūpatīnāṃ mahātmanām .. 13 ..
5.73.d:
आनर्तविषयेऽस्माभिरागच्छद्भिस्तवांतिकम् ..
दृष्टमत्यद्भुतं क्षेत्रं हाटकेश्वरजं महत् ..
तत्र लिंगानि दृष्टानि भूपतीनां महात्मनाम् .. 13 ..
5.73.m: While coming to your presence through the country of Ānarta, / we saw the great, most wonderful sacred field belonging to Hāṭakeśvara; / there were seen the liṅgas of high-souled kings, 13

5.73.s: sūryacandrānvayotthānāmanyeṣāṃ ca mahātmanām .. 14 ..
5.73.d: सूर्यचन्द्रान्वयोत्थानामन्येषां च महात्मनाम् .. 14 ..
5.73.m: descended from the solar and lunar dynasties, and of other noble persons, 14

5.73.s:
devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca munīnāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ..
sākārāṇi sutejāṃsi nānāprāsādabhoji ca .. 15 ..
5.73.d:
देवानां दानवानां च मुनीनां च विशेषतः ..
साकाराणि सुतेजांसि नानाप्रासादभोजि च .. 15 ..
5.73.m: and especially of the gods, dānavas, and sages— / endowed with form, possessing great splendor, and occupying various mansions. 15

5.73.s:
tataśca kurumukhyānāṃ pāṃḍavānāṃ ca mādhava ..
liṃgasaṃsthāpanārthāya tatra jātā matirdṛḍhā .. 16 ..
5.73.d:
ततश्च कुरुमुख्यानां पांडवानां च माधव ..
लिंगसंस्थापनार्थाय तत्र जाता मतिर्दृढा .. 16 ..
5.73.m: And from that, O Mādhava, a firm intention arose among the chiefs of the Kurus / and the Pāṇḍavas to install liṅgas there. 16

5.73.s:
te vayaṃ tatra gatvāśu yathāśaktyā yathecchayā ..
liṃgāni sthāpayiṣyāmaḥ svānisvāni pṛthakpṛthak .. 17 ..
5.73.d:
ते वयं तत्र गत्वाशु यथाशक्त्या यथेच्छया ..
लिंगानि स्थापयिष्यामः स्वानिस्वानि पृथक्पृथक् .. 17 ..
5.73.m: Going there quickly according to our ability and desire, / we will install our own respective liṅgas separately. 17

5.73.s:
etasmātkāraṇāttūrṇaṃ calitā vayamacyuta ..
na vayaṃ tava saṃgasya tṛpyāmo'bdaśatairapi .. 18 ..
5.73.d:
एतस्मात्कारणात्तूर्णं चलिता वयमच्युत ..
न वयं तव संगस्य तृप्यामोऽब्दशतैरपि .. 18 ..
5.73.m: For this reason, O Acyuta, we set out in haste; / we would not be satiated with your company even in hundreds of years. 18

5.73.s:
tasmādājñāpayasvādya kṛtvā cittaṃ dṛḍhaṃ vibho ..
bhūyo'pyatrāgamiṣyāmastava darśanalālasāḥ .. 19 ..
5.73.d:
तस्मादाज्ञापयस्वाद्य कृत्वा चित्तं दृढं विभो ..
भूयोऽप्यत्रागमिष्यामस्तव दर्शनलालसाः .. 19 ..
5.73.m: Therefore give permission today, making your mind firm, O Lord; / we shall come here again, eager for your darśana." 19

5.73.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
ahaṃ jānāmi tatkṣetraṃ supuṇyaṃ pāpanāśanam ..
tāpasaiḥ kīrtitaṃ nityaṃ mamānyaistīrthayātrikaiḥ .. 6.73.20 ..
5.73.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
अहं जानामि तत्क्षेत्रं सुपुण्यं पापनाशनम् ..
तापसैः कीर्तितं नित्यं ममान्यैस्तीर्थयात्रिकैः .. 6.73.20 ..
5.73.m: The Blessed Lord said: / "I know that very holy sacred field that destroys sin; / it has always been praised to me by ascetics and other pilgrims visiting sacred fords. 20"

5.73.s:
tasmāttatra sameṣyāmo yuṣmābhiḥ sahitā vayam ..
liṃga saṃsthāpanārthāya kṣetradarśanavāṃchayā .. 21 ..
5.73.d:
तस्मात्तत्र समेष्यामो युष्माभिः सहिता वयम् ..
लिंग संस्थापनार्थाय क्षेत्रदर्शनवांछया .. 21 ..
5.73.m:
"Therefore we will go there together with you,
for the sake of installing a liṅga, desiring to see the sacred field."

5.73.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
tacchutvā kauravāḥ sarve paraṃ harṣamupāgatāḥ ..
tathā pāṃḍusutāścaiva ye cānye tatra pārthivāḥ .. 22 .
5.73.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तच्छुत्वा कौरवाः सर्वे परं हर्षमुपागताः ..
तथा पांडुसुताश्चैव ये चान्ये तत्र पार्थिवाः .. 22 .
5.73.m:
Sūta said:
Hearing that, all the Kauravas experienced supreme joy,
as well as the sons of Pāṇḍu and the other rulers of the earth who were there.

5.73.s:
te tu saṃprasthitāḥ sarve militāḥ kurupāṃḍavāḥ ..
gajavājivimardena kampayanto vasundharām .. 23 ..
5.73.d:
ते तु संप्रस्थिताः सर्वे मिलिताः कुरुपांडवाः ..
गजवाजिविमर्देन कम्पयन्तो वसुन्धराम् .. 23 ..
5.73.m:
All of them set forth, the Kurus and Pāṇḍavas assembled together,
making the earth tremble beneath the stampede of elephants and horses.

5.73.s:
atha tatkṣetramāsādya dūre kṛtvā niveśanam ..
kauravā yādavā mukhyāścamatkārapuraṃ gatāḥ .. 24 ..
5.73.d:
अथ तत्क्षेत्रमासाद्य दूरे कृत्वा निवेशनम् ..
कौरवा यादवा मुख्याश्चमत्कारपुरं गताः .. 24 ..
5.73.m:
Then, having reached that sacred field and encamped at a distance,
the Kauravas, the Yādavas, and the leading men went to Camatkārapura.

5.73.s:
tatra sarvānsamāhūya brāhmaṇānvinayānvitāḥ ..
procurdattvā vicitrāṇi bhūṣaṇācchādanāni ca .. 25 ..
5.73.d:
तत्र सर्वान्समाहूय ब्राह्मणान्विनयान्विताः ..
प्रोचुर्दत्त्वा विचित्राणि भूषणाच्छादनानि च .. 25 ..
5.73.m:
Calling together all the brahmins there, endowed with humility,
and presenting them with diverse ornaments and garments, they said:

5.73.s:
vayaṃ sarve'tra vāṃchāmo ligasaṃsthāpanakriyām ..
kartuṃ prāsādamukhyānāṃ pṛthaktvena svaśaktitaḥ .. 26 ..
5.73.d:
वयं सर्वेऽत्र वांछामो लिगसंस्थापनक्रियाम् ..
कर्तुं प्रासादमुख्यानां पृथक्त्वेन स्वशक्तितः .. 26 ..
5.73.m:
"We all desire to perform here the rite of installing a liṅga,
[and] of principal temples individually, according to our capacity.

5.73.s:
tasmātkṛtvā prasādaṃ no dayāṃ ca dvijasattamāḥ ..
ājñāpayata śīghraṃ hi yena karma pravartate .. 27 ..
5.73.d:
तस्मात्कृत्वा प्रसादं नो दयां च द्विजसत्तमाः ..
आज्ञापयत शीघ्रं हि येन कर्म प्रवर्तते .. 27 ..
5.73.m:
Therefore, best of the twice-born, showing us grace and compassion,
give your command swiftly, so that the work may begin.

5.73.s:
bhaviṣyatha tathā yūyaṃ hotāraḥ sarvakarmasu ..
na cānyo brāhmaṇo bāhyo yadyapi syādbṛhaspatiḥ .. 28 ..
5.73.d:
भविष्यथ तथा यूयं होतारः सर्वकर्मसु ..
न चान्यो ब्राह्मणो बाह्यो यद्यपि स्याद्बृहस्पतिः .. 28 ..
5.73.m:
Likewise, you alone shall be the hotṛ priests in all the rites;
no other brahmin from outside [shall officiate], even if he were Bṛhaspati.

5.73.s:
yato'smābhiḥ śrutā vārtā kīrtyamānā purātanī ..
viṣṇunā tasya rājarṣeḥ pretaśrāddhasamudbhavā .. 29 ..
5.73.d:
यतोऽस्माभिः श्रुता वार्ता कीर्त्यमाना पुरातनी ..
विष्णुना तस्य राजर्षेः प्रेतश्राद्धसमुद्भवा .. 29 ..
5.73.m:
For an ancient report was heard by us, narrated
by Viṣṇu, concerning the royal seer's śrāddha performed for a ghost,

5.73.s:
yathā tena kṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ pituḥ pretasya yatnataḥ ..
brāhmaṇānāṃ puro'nyeṣāṃ yathoktānāmapi dvijāḥ .. 6.73.30 ..
5.73.d:
यथा तेन कृतं श्राद्धं पितुः प्रेतस्य यत्नतः ..
ब्राह्मणानां पुरोऽन्येषां यथोक्तानामपि द्विजाः .. 6.73.30 ..
5.73.m:
how, although a śrāddha was carefully performed by him for his deceased father,
in the presence of other brahmins who were well-versed [in rites], O twice-born,

5.73.s:
yathoktavidhinā tīrthe nāgānāṃ paṃcamīdine ...
śrāvaṇe māsi no muktaḥ pitā tasya tathāpi saḥ .. 31 ..
5.73.d:
यथोक्तविधिना तीर्थे नागानां पंचमीदिने ...
श्रावणे मासि नो मुक्तः पिता तस्य तथापि सः .. 31 ..
5.73.m:
according to the prescribed rules at the sacred ford on the fifth day [in honor] of the serpents,
in the month of Śrāvaṇa, his father was still not freed

5.73.s:
pretatvātsarpadoṣeṇa saṃjātā dvijasattamāḥ ..
devaśarmapuro yāvattatkṛtaṃ śrāddhamādarāt ..
tāvatpitā vinirmuktaḥ pretatvāddāruṇāddvijāḥ .. 32 ..
5.73.d:
प्रेतत्वात्सर्पदोषेण संजाता द्विजसत्तमाः ..
देवशर्मपुरो यावत्तत्कृतं श्राद्धमादरात् ..
तावत्पिता विनिर्मुक्तः प्रेतत्वाद्दारुणाद्द्विजाः .. 32 ..

5.73.s:
yadatra kriyate kiṃcitkarma dharmyaṃ dvijottamāḥ ..
tadbāhyaṃ ca bhavedvyarthametadvidmaḥ sphuṭaṃ vayam .. .. 33 ..
5.73.d:
यदत्र क्रियते किंचित्कर्म धर्म्यं द्विजोत्तमाः ..
तद्बाह्यं च भवेद्व्यर्थमेतद्विद्मः स्फुटं वयम् .. .. 33 ..
5.73.m:
Whatever religious act is performed here, O best of the twice-born,
if done by an outsider, becomes useless—this we clearly know.

5.73.s:
prārthayāmo viśeṣeṇa tena dainyaṃ samāgatāḥ ..
prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ tasmādājñāṃ yacchata mā ciram .. 34 ..
5.73.d:
प्रार्थयामो विशेषेण तेन दैन्यं समागताः ..
प्रसादः क्रियतां तस्मादाज्ञां यच्छत मा चिरम् .. 34 ..
5.73.m:
Therefore, approaching you with humility, we especially make our entreaty:
let your grace be granted, and give your command without delay."

5.73.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā brāhmaṇāste parasparam ..
mantraṃ cakrustadarthaṃ hi kiṃ kṛtaṃ sukṛtaṃ bhavet .. 35 ..
5.73.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ब्राह्मणास्ते परस्परम् ..
मन्त्रं चक्रुस्तदर्थं हि किं कृतं सुकृतं भवेत् .. 35 ..
5.73.m:
Sūta said:
Hearing their speech, those brahmins held counsel
among themselves regarding the matter: "What would be the proper thing to do?"

5.73.s:
eke procurna dāsyāmaḥ prāsādārthaṃ vasundharām ..
eteṣāmapi caikasya tasmādgacchaṃtu satvaram .. 36 ..
5.73.d:
एके प्रोचुर्न दास्यामः प्रासादार्थं वसुन्धराम् ..
एतेषामपि चैकस्य तस्माद्गच्छंतु सत्वरम् .. 36 ..
5.73.m:
Some said: "We shall not give land for a temple,
not even to one among them; therefore let them depart at once.

5.73.s:
paṃcakrośapramāṇena kṣetrametadvyavasthitam ..
pūrveṣāmapi devānāṃ prāsādaistatsamāvṛtam .. 37 ..
5.73.d:
पंचक्रोशप्रमाणेन क्षेत्रमेतद्व्यवस्थितम् ..
पूर्वेषामपि देवानां प्रासादैस्तत्समावृतम् .. 37 ..
5.73.m:
This sacred field extends to a measure of five krośas;
it is already covered by the temples of earlier deities."

5.73.s:
anye procurdhanomattā yūyaṃ ca sukhamāśritāḥ ..
dāridyārtiṃ na jānītha brūtha tena bhṛśaṃ vacaḥ .. 38 ..
5.73.d:
अन्ये प्रोचुर्धनोमत्ता यूयं च सुखमाश्रिताः ..
दारिद्यार्तिं न जानीथ ब्रूथ तेन भृशं वचः .. 38 ..
5.73.m:
Others said: "Intoxicated by wealth, you are ensconced in comfort;
you do not know the affliction of poverty, and therefore you speak harsh words.

5.73.s:
tasmādvayaṃ pradāsyāma eteṣāṃ hi vasu ndharām ..
arthasiddhirbhavedyena bhūṣā sthānasya jāyate .. 39 ..
5.73.d:
तस्माद्वयं प्रदास्याम एतेषां हि वसु न्धराम् ..
अर्थसिद्धिर्भवेद्येन भूषा स्थानस्य जायते .. 39 ..
5.73.m:
Therefore we shall indeed grant them land,
by which our financial ends may be accomplished, and the place adorned."

5.73.s:
tathānye madhyamāḥ procuryatra sākṣājjanārdanaḥ ..
svayaṃ prārthayate bhūmiṃ tatkasmānna pradīyate .. 6.73.40 ..
5.73.d:
तथान्ये मध्यमाः प्रोचुर्यत्र साक्षाज्जनार्दनः ..
स्वयं प्रार्थयते भूमिं तत्कस्मान्न प्रदीयते .. 6.73.40 ..
5.73.m:
Likewise, other moderate ones said: "Where Janārdana in person
himself requests land, why should it not be granted?

5.73.s:
tasmādyatra samāyātāḥ kurupāṃḍavayādavāḥ ..
prādhānyena prakurvaṃtu prāsādāṃstena cāpare .. 41 ..
5.73.d:
तस्माद्यत्र समायाताः कुरुपांडवयादवाः ..
प्राधान्येन प्रकुर्वंतु प्रासादांस्तेन चापरे .. 41 ..
5.73.m:
Therefore, since the Kurus, Pāṇḍavas, and Yādavas have arrived together,
let them, and others through them, build temples in order of precedence.

5.73.s:
yācate yatra gāṃgeyaḥ svayameva tathā paraḥ ..
dhṛtarāṣṭraḥ saputraśca pāṃḍavāśca mahābalāḥ ..
liṃgasaṃsthāpanārthāya niṣedhastatra nārhati .. 42 ..
5.73.d:
याचते यत्र गांगेयः स्वयमेव तथा परः ..
धृतराष्ट्रः सपुत्रश्च पांडवाश्च महाबलाः ..
लिंगसंस्थापनार्थाय निषेधस्तत्र नार्हति .. 42 ..
5.73.m:
Where Gāṅgeya himself begs, and another,
Dhṛtarāṣṭra with his sons, and the mighty Pāṇḍavas,
for the sake of installing a liṅga, a refusal is not fitting."

5.73.s:
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā pratipannaṃ dvijottamaiḥ ..
nirdhanaiḥ sadhanaiścāpi saspṛhairniḥspṛhairapi .. 43 ..
5.73.d:
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रतिपन्नं द्विजोत्तमैः ..
निर्धनैः सधनैश्चापि सस्पृहैर्निःस्पृहैरपि .. 43 ..
5.73.m:
Hearing their words, consent was given by the best of the twice-born,
both poor and rich, both desiring and free of desire.

5.73.s:
tataḥ sametya te sarve brāhmaṇāḥ kurusattamān ..
yādavānpāṃḍavānprocuḥ kṛtvā vai mantraniścayam .. 44 ..
5.73.d:
ततः समेत्य ते सर्वे ब्राह्मणाः कुरुसत्तमान् ..
यादवान्पांडवान्प्रोचुः कृत्वा वै मन्त्रनिश्चयम् .. 44 ..
5.73.m:
Then, having gathered together and made a firm decision in council,
all those brahmins addressed the best of the Kurus, the Yādavas, and the Pāṇḍavas:

5.73.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
etatsvalpataraṃ kṣetraṃ sarveṣāmapi bhūbhujām ..
prāsādaiḥ sarvato vyāptaṃ tatkiṃ brūmo'dhunā vayam .. 45 ..
5.73.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
एतत्स्वल्पतरं क्षेत्रं सर्वेषामपि भूभुजाम् ..
प्रासादैः सर्वतो व्याप्तं तत्किं ब्रूमोऽधुना वयम् .. 45 ..

5.73.s:
tadbhavaṃtaḥ prakurvaṃtu prādhānyena yadṛcchayā ..
kṣetre'traivābhimukhyena prāsādānsumanoharān ..
yathājyeṣṭhaṃ yathāśreṣṭhaṃ pṛthaktvena vyavasthitāḥ .. 46 ..
5.73.d:
तद्भवंतः प्रकुर्वंतु प्राधान्येन यदृच्छया ..
क्षेत्रेऽत्रैवाभिमुख्येन प्रासादान्सुमनोहरान् ..
यथाज्येष्ठं यथाश्रेष्ठं पृथक्त्वेन व्यवस्थिताः .. 46 ..
5.73.m:
Nevertheless, let your honors construct according to precedence, at your will,
very charming temples facing toward this sacred field,
situated individually according to seniority and according to pre-eminence."

5.73.s:
atha harṣasamāyuktā dhṛtarāṣṭramukhāḥ kramāt ..
prādhānyena yathāśreṣṭhaṃ cakruḥ prāsādapaddhatim .. 47 ..
5.73.d:
अथ हर्षसमायुक्ता धृतराष्ट्रमुखाः क्रमात् ..
प्राधान्येन यथाश्रेष्ठं चक्रुः प्रासादपद्धतिम् .. 47 ..
5.73.m:
Then, filled with joy, Dhṛtarāṣṭra and the others in succession,
according to precedence and according to pre-eminence, laid out the row of temples.

5.73.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye dhṛtarāṣṭrādikṛtaprāsādasthāpanodyamavarṇanaṃnāma trisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 73 .. ....
5.73.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये धृतराष्ट्रादिकृतप्रासादस्थापनोद्यमवर्णनंनाम त्रिसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः .. 73 .. ....
5.73.m: Thus ends the seventy-third chapter, named 'The Description of the Endeavor to Establish Temples by Dhṛtarāṣṭra and Others,' in the Māhātmya of the Hāṭakeśvara Sacred Field, in the Nāgarakhaṇḍa, the sixth [part] of the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.74.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
dhṛtarāṣṭreṇa bhūpena śataputrānvitena ca ..
liṃgānāṃ sthāpitaṃ tatra śatamekottaraṃ dvijāḥ .. 1 ..
5.74.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
धृतराष्ट्रेण भूपेन शतपुत्रान्वितेन च ..
लिंगानां स्थापितं तत्र शतमेकोत्तरं द्विजाः .. 1 ..
5.74.m:
Sūta said:
By King Dhṛtarāṣṭra together with his hundred sons,
one hundred and one liṅgas were installed there, O twice-born.

5.74.s:
tathā ca pāṃḍavaiḥ sarvaiḥ sthāpitaṃ liṃgapaṃcakam ..
draupadyā cā'tha kuntyā'tha gāṃdhāryā'tha yadṛcchayā .. 2 ..
5.74.d:
तथा च पांडवैः सर्वैः स्थापितं लिंगपंचकम् ..
द्रौपद्या चाऽथ कुन्त्याऽथ गांधार्याऽथ यदृच्छया .. 2 ..
5.74.m:
And likewise a group of five liṅgas was installed by all the Pāṇḍavas;
and by Draupadī, and Kuntī, and Gāndhārī at their pleasure,

5.74.s:
bhānumatyā ca gaurīṇāṃ sthāpitaṃ ca catuṣṭayam ..
vidureṇātha śalyena kaliṃ gena yuyutsunā .. 3 ..
5.74.d:
भानुमत्या च गौरीणां स्थापितं च चतुष्टयम् ..
विदुरेणाथ शल्येन कलिं गेन युयुत्सुना .. 3 ..
5.74.m:
and by Bhānumatī, a group of four Gaurīs was installed.
Then by Vidura, and Śalya, Kaliṅga, and Yuyutsu,

5.74.s:
bāhlīkena saputreṇa karṇenātha sasūnunā ..
tathā śakuninā tatra droṇena ca kṛpeṇa ca .. 4 ..
5.74.d:
बाह्लीकेन सपुत्रेण कर्णेनाथ ससूनुना ..
तथा शकुनिना तत्र द्रोणेन च कृपेण च .. 4 ..
5.74.m:
by Bāhlīka with his son, and by Karṇa with his son,
likewise there by Śakuni, Droṇa, and Kṛpa,

5.74.s:
aśvatthāmnā pṛthaktvena liṅgamekaikamuttamam ..
sthāpitaṃ parayā bhaktyā varaprāsādamāśritam .. 5 ..
5.74.d:
अश्वत्थाम्ना पृथक्त्वेन लिङ्गमेकैकमुत्तमम् ..
स्थापितं परया भक्त्या वरप्रासादमाश्रितम् .. 5 ..
5.74.m:
and by Aśvatthāman, individually, one excellent liṅga each
was installed with supreme devotion, placed in an excellent temple.

5.74.s:
tathā saṃsthāpitaṃ tatra viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā ..
liṃgaṃ prāsādamādhāya prottuṃgaśikharānvitam .. 6 ..
5.74.d:
तथा संस्थापितं तत्र विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना ..
लिंगं प्रासादमाधाय प्रोत्तुंगशिखरान्वितम् .. 6 ..
5.74.m:
Likewise, a liṅga was installed there by all-powerful Viṣṇu,
placed in a temple endowed with an exceedingly lofty spire.

5.74.s:
sātvatenāpi sāṃbena balabhadreṇa dhīmatā ..
pradyumenāniruddhena tathānyairmukhyayādavaiḥ .. 7 ..
5.74.d:
सात्वतेनापि सांबेन बलभद्रेण धीमता ..
प्रद्युमेनानिरुद्धेन तथान्यैर्मुख्ययादवैः .. 7 ..
5.74.m:
By the Sātvata [Kṛṣṇa] as well, by Sāmba, by wise Balabhadra,
by Pradyumna, by Aniruddha, and by the other principal Yādavas,

5.74.s:
cārudeṣṇādibhiḥ putrai rukmiṇyā daśabhiḥ sutaiḥ ..
liṃgānāṃ daśakaṃ mukhyaṃ sthāpitaṃ śraddhayānvitaiḥ .. 8 ..
5.74.d:
चारुदेष्णादिभिः पुत्रै रुक्मिण्या दशभिः सुतैः ..
लिंगानां दशकं मुख्यं स्थापितं श्रद्धयान्वितैः .. 8 ..
5.74.m:
by the ten sons of Rukmiṇī headed by Cārudeṣṇa,
a prominent group of ten liṅgas was installed with faith.

5.74.s:
evaṃ saṃsthāpya liṅgāni te sarve kurupāṃḍavāḥ ..
yādavāśca susaṃhṛṣṭā kṛtakṛtyāstadā. 'bhavan .. 9 ..
5.74.d:
एवं संस्थाप्य लिङ्गानि ते सर्वे कुरुपांडवाः ..
यादवाश्च सुसंहृष्टा कृतकृत्यास्तदा. ऽभवन् .. 9 ..
5.74.m:
Having thus installed the liṅgas, all those Kurus, Pāṇḍavas,
and Yādavas were exceedingly rejoiced and felt their purpose accomplished.

5.74.s:
tatra sthitvā ciraṃ kālaṃ dattvā dānānyanekaśaḥ ..
dhanāḍhyānbrāhmaṇānkṛtvā camatkārapurodbhavān .. 6.74.10 ..
5.74.d:
तत्र स्थित्वा चिरं कालं दत्त्वा दानान्यनेकशः ..
धनाढ्यान्ब्राह्मणान्कृत्वा चमत्कारपुरोद्भवान् .. 6.74.10 ..
5.74.m:
Remaining there for a long time, granting gifts in various ways,
making the brahmins born in Camatkārapura wealthy,

5.74.s:
dattvā tebhyo varānnāgānha yāñjātyānanekaśaḥ..
sadgrāmāṇi vicitrāṇi kṣetrāṇi ca sudhenavaḥ .. 11 ..
5.74.d:
दत्त्वा तेभ्यो वरान्नागान्ह याञ्जात्याननेकशः..
सद्ग्रामाणि विचित्राणि क्षेत्राणि च सुधेनवः .. 11 ..
5.74.m:
giving them excellent elephants, many horses of noble breed,
prosperous and diverse villages, fields, and fine milk-cows,

5.74.s:
mahokṣāṃśca suvastrāṇi bhūsthānānyāśrayāṃstathā ..
dāsīdāsāṃstathā bhṛtyāndānāni vividhāni ca .. 12 ..
5.74.d:
महोक्षांश्च सुवस्त्राणि भूस्थानान्याश्रयांस्तथा ..
दासीदासांस्तथा भृत्यान्दानानि विविधानि च .. 12 ..
5.74.m:
great bulls, fine garments, plots of land, and residences,
female and male slaves, servants, and various kinds of gifts.

5.74.s:
tata āmantrya tānsarvānpraṇipatya muhurmuhuḥ ..
svasthānaṃ prati saṃhṛṣṭāḥ prajagmuḥ sarva eva te .. 13 ..
5.74.d:
तत आमन्त्र्य तान्सर्वान्प्रणिपत्य मुहुर्मुहुः ..
स्वस्थानं प्रति संहृष्टाः प्रजग्मुः सर्व एव ते .. 13 ..
5.74.m: Then, having taken leave of them all and bowed down repeatedly, / all of them departed with great delight to their respective homes.

5.74.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
etadvaḥ sarvamākhyātaṃ sthāpitaṃ tena bhūbhujā ..
tathā taddhṛtarāṣṭreṇa liṃgaṃ pātakanāśanam .. 14 ..
tathānyairapi bhūpālaiḥ prādhānyena vyavasthitaiḥ ..
pāṇḍavairyādavaiścaiva pṛthaktvena vyavasthitaiḥ ...5..
5.74.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
एतद्वः सर्वमाख्यातं स्थापितं तेन भूभुजा ..
तथा तद्धृतराष्ट्रेण लिंगं पातकनाशनम् .. 14 ..
तथान्यैरपि भूपालैः प्राधान्येन व्यवस्थितैः ..
पाण्डवैर्यादवैश्चैव पृथक्त्वेन व्यवस्थितैः ...5..
5.74.m:
Sūta said: / All this has been narrated to you, [concerning] what was established by that king; / likewise the liṅga installed by Dhṛtarāṣṭra, which destroys sins,
as well as by other rulers who were positioned as prominent, / and by the Pāṇḍavas and Yādavas, each stationed separately.

5.74.s:
yastāni puruṣaḥ samyakpūjayedbhaktibhāvitaḥ ..
sa labheccākhilānkāmānvāṃchitānsvena cetasā .. 16 ..
5.74.d:
यस्तानि पुरुषः सम्यक्पूजयेद्भक्तिभावितः ..
स लभेच्चाखिलान्कामान्वांछितान्स्वेन चेतसा .. 16 ..
5.74.m: Whatever man properly worships them, filled with devotion, / shall obtain all desires longed for in his own heart.

5.74.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhenāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye kauravapāṇḍavayādavakṛtaliṃga pratiṣṭhāvṛttāṃtavarṇanaṃnāma catuḥsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 74 ..
5.74.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठेनागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कौरवपाण्डवयादवकृतलिंग प्रतिष्ठावृत्तांतवर्णनंनाम चतुःसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः .. 74 ..
5.74.m: Thus ends the seventy-fourth chapter, titled 'Description of the Account of the Installation of Liṅgas by the Kauravas, Pāṇḍavas, and Yādavas,' in the glorification of Hāṭakeśvara sacred field, in the sixth Nāgarakhaṇḍa of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

5.75.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
purā kalpe bhagavatā etatkṣetramanuttamam ..
rudreṇa brahmaṇe dattaṃ tuṣṭena dvijasattamāḥ .. 1 ..
5.75.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
पुरा कल्पे भगवता एतत्क्षेत्रमनुत्तमम् ..
रुद्रेण ब्रह्मणे दत्तं तुष्टेन द्विजसत्तमाः .. 1 ..
5.75.m: Sūta said: / Formerly, in an earlier aeon, this peerless sacred field, O best of twice-born, / was given to Brahmā by the pleased Lord Rudra.

5.75.s:
yadā tu sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃjñitam ..
devaiḥ prītena rudreṇa pradattaṃ brahmaṇe punaḥ .. 2 ..
5.75.d:
यदा तु स्थापितं लिंगं हाटकेश्वरसंज्ञितम् ..
देवैः प्रीतेन रुद्रेण प्रदत्तं ब्रह्मणे पुनः .. 2 ..
5.75.m: When the liṅga named Hāṭakeśvara was established, / it was again given to Brahmā by Rudra, pleased with the gods.

5.75.s:
etatkṣetraṃ tadā dattaṃ śaṃbhunā ṣaṇmukhasya ha ..
rakṣaṇārthaṃ hi viprāṇāṃ kalikālādidoṣataḥ ..3..
5.75.d:
एतत्क्षेत्रं तदा दत्तं शंभुना षण्मुखस्य ह ..
रक्षणार्थं हि विप्राणां कलिकालादिदोषतः ..3..
5.75.m: Then this sacred field was bestowed by Śambhu upon the Six-faced One (Skanda) / for the protection of brahmins against the blemishes of the Kali age and other evils.

5.75.s:
brahmaṇā prārthitenedaṃ svayamādimamuttamam ..
pitrādiṣṭastu gāṃgeyastatra vāsamathākarot .. 4 ..
5.75.d:
ब्रह्मणा प्रार्थितेनेदं स्वयमादिममुत्तमम् ..
पित्रादिष्टस्तु गांगेयस्तत्र वासमथाकरोत् .. 4 ..
5.75.m: Requested by Brahmā, this primal, supreme [field was given by him personally]; / and commanded by his father, the Son of Gaṅgā then made his dwelling there.

5.75.s:
kārtikyāṃ kṛttikāyoge yaḥ kuryātsvāmidarśanam ..
saptajanma bhavedvipro dhanāḍhyo vedapāragaḥ ..5..
5.75.d:
कार्तिक्यां कृत्तिकायोगे यः कुर्यात्स्वामिदर्शनम् ..
सप्तजन्म भवेद्विप्रो धनाढ्यो वेदपारगः ..5..
5.75.m: Whoever has darśana of the Master on the full moon of Kārttika during the conjunction with Kṛttikā, / becomes a wealthy brahmin who has mastered the Vedas for seven lifetimes.

5.75.s:
mahāsenasya devasya prāsādaṃ sumanoharam..
uccaiḥ sthitaṃ sarvaloke pātukāmamivāṃbaram .. 6 ..
5.75.d:
महासेनस्य देवस्य प्रासादं सुमनोहरम्..
उच्चैः स्थितं सर्वलोके पातुकाममिवांबरम् .. 6 ..
5.75.m: There is a very charming temple of the god Mahāsena, / standing high above all the world, as though wishing to drink the sky.

5.75.s:
tacchrutvā vibudhāḥ sarve kautukādetya satvaram ..
vīkṣāṃcakrustato gatvā dṛṣṭvā medhyatamaṃ puram .. 7 ..
5.75.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा विबुधाः सर्वे कौतुकादेत्य सत्वरम् ..
वीक्षांचक्रुस्ततो गत्वा दृष्ट्वा मेध्यतमं पुरम् .. 7 ..
5.75.m: Hearing of that, all the gods quickly arrived out of curiosity; / they went and gazed upon it, beholding the most sacred city.

5.75.s:
prāsādasyottare deśe prācye deśe tathā dvijāḥ ..
yajñakriyāsamāraṃbhāṃścakurviprairyathoditān ..8..
5.75.d:
प्रासादस्योत्तरे देशे प्राच्ये देशे तथा द्विजाः ..
यज्ञक्रियासमारंभांश्चकुर्विप्रैर्यथोदितान् ..8..
5.75.m: To the north of the temple and to the east, O twice-born, / they began the performances of sacrifices as prescribed by the brahmins.

5.75.s:
iṣṭvā ca vibudhāḥ sarve dattvā tebhyaśca dakṣiṇām ..
jagmustriviṣṭapaṃ hṛṣṭā labdhvā tatsthānajaṃ phalam .. 9 ..
5.75.d:
इष्ट्वा च विबुधाः सर्वे दत्त्वा तेभ्यश्च दक्षिणाम् ..
जग्मुस्त्रिविष्टपं हृष्टा लब्ध्वा तत्स्थानजं फलम् .. 9 ..
5.75.m: Having sacrificed and given sacrificial gifts to them, all the gods / went rejoiced to heaven, having obtained the fruit born of that place.

5.75.s:
tatastu devayajanaṃnāma tasya babhūva ha ..
yadanyatra śataṃ kṛtvā kratūnāṃ phalamāpnuyāt ..
tadatraikena labhate kratunā dakṣiṇāvatā .. 6.75.10 ..
5.75.d:
ततस्तु देवयजनंनाम तस्य बभूव ह ..
यदन्यत्र शतं कृत्वा क्रतूनां फलमाप्नुयात् ..
तदत्रैकेन लभते क्रतुना दक्षिणावता .. 6.75.10 ..
5.75.m: From then on, it indeed became known as Devayajana; / the fruit that one would obtain elsewhere by performing a hundred sacrifices, / that one obtains here by a single sacrifice accompanied by sacrificial gifts.

5.75.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhe nāgarakhaṇḍe hāṭakeśvarakṣetramāhātmye yajña bhūmimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 75 .. .. a ..
5.75.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां षष्ठे नागरखण्डे हाटकेश्वरक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये यज्ञ भूमिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चसप्ततितमोऽध्यायः .. 75 .. .. अ ..
5.75.m: Thus ends the seventy-fifth chapter, titled 'Description of the Glorification of the Sacrificial Ground,' in the glorification of Hāṭakeśvara sacred field, in the sixth Nāgarakhaṇḍa of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.
